item.title: The Coolest Dressers I Know Don't Stick to Black Heels—I Keep Spotting Them In This Elevated Alternative
item.dc:content:
If you ever want a read on the coolest things to wear right now, I suggest typing "Zoë Kravitz" into your Google search bar. Elevated, effortless and consistently on the mark with the unfussy trends that make the biggest impact, the actor and style icon is my go-to for styling inspiration all year round. Now, as we charge towards party season, I've been thinking about the non-black shoe trends worth adding to my rotation. As usual, Zoë was right on the money.

Out filming in New York, I spotted the actor styling a knee-skimming midi skirt in the glossiest shade of chartreuse green, paired with a brown knee-length wool coat slung over her shoulders. Picking up on the rich chocolate hue, she eschewed the usual black heels in favour of a glossy dark brown pair.

A rich, decadent colour that feels a little less expected than black, dark brown heels offer the depth and sophistication you could want from a winter shoe. Whilst Zoë wore hers with a vibrant green skirt, the deep brown shade lends itself to so many other colour combinations. I can already picture them working so well with blue denim, too.

Just as at home alongside a winter palette of greys, burgundies and chocolate browns, dark brown heels also bring an interesting contrast to lighter shades, adding depth and dimension in a way that black doesn't always achieve.

One of the chicest shoe alternatives to try this season, read on to shop the Zoë-inspired brown heels I'm recommending below.

Shop Brown Heels:
H&M
Heeled Slingbacks

Style these with a green satin skirt to get Zoe's look.
Reformation
Wells Slingback Heel

The kitten heel finish ensures a comfortable stride.
Mango
Stiletto Heel Shoe

Whilst I love this in the dark brown, it also comes in three other shades.
Jonak
Slingback Pumps

The slingback heels trend isn't showing any signs of slowing down.
Charles & Keith
Kaia Satin Slingback Pumps

The satin composition gives these an elevated edge.
Zara
Limited Edition Ruched Leather Heeled Shoes

I'd easily believe you if you told me these were designer.
The Row
Ornella D'orsay Pump Brown

Be quick! These are on their way to selling out.
item.dc:creator: Natalie Munro
item.dc:description: <p>Natalie Munro is Who What Wear UK’s news writer. Having worked in the fashion industry since her time at university—where she obtained a BA in Journalism from University of the Arts London, Natalie&#39;s experience spans journalistic and styling roles. In the early stages of her career Natalie predominately worked on editorial shoots for fashion publications such as British Vogue, Vogue Ukraine, AnOther Magazine and Elle UK, before moving into journalism roles.</p><p>On completion of her degree she interned in the editorial team at British Vogue and <a href="https://www.vogue.co.uk/profile/natalie-munro">later went on to freelance for the publication</a>. Here, she developed her interest in reporting on the latest fashion news and trends. Inspired by the dynamic nature of the industry, Natalie went on to write for other lifestyle brands and publications before taking on the role as News Writer for Who What Wear.</p><p>With an interest in uncovering the latest fashion trends, Natalie takes a leading role in identifying news for Who What Wear UK. Focusing on trends on and off the runway, as well as street style and celebrity fashion, Natalie reports on a daily basis, ensuring that she remains ahead of the trends. Natalie also creates content for Who What Wear’s social channels including TikTok and Instagram on a weekly basis.</p>

item.title: My New Year-Closet Is Looking Like a Lot of Free People—28 Cyber Week Deals I’m Loving
item.dc:content:
I've been in a Free People state of mind lately. The relaxed silhouettes and romantic details are exactly what I need to upgrade my closet in the new year. Good thing it's Black Friday. As I stock up on lace slips and corduroy pants, I'll save 50% on select styles. I'll be doing a double take at any Intimately styles I find, Free People's in-house intimate label, which makes up, I'd say, over half of my sleepwear. It's just so comfortable and looks so chic!

Come with me as I make the most of Free People's Black Friday sale. Scroll down for a look at the nighties, sweaters, and athletic pieces I'll be adding to my wardrobe in 2027.

item.author: josephine.hadjiloucas@futurenet.com (Josephine Hadjiloucas)
item.dc:creator: Josephine Hadjiloucas
item.dc:description: <p>Josephine Hadjiloucas is a New York–based writer. She first interned at Who What Wear UK in 2024 on the editorial team, where she worked on video production and social media content creation. After graduating from the Fashion Institute of Technology in 2025 with a degree in advertising, marketing, and communications, she accepted her current position as an assistant shopping editor at Who What Wear U.S. In her stories, Josephine covers everything from the latest fashion trends, outfit inspiration, and standout affordable finds to must-read celebrity interviews with industry icons like Paris Hilton and Carolina Herrera. Her thoughtful approach to affordable style stems from her belief that fashion should be accessible to all. When she isn’t writing about the latest Gen Z trends or updating her under-$100 Nordstrom wish list, you can find her browsing the racks of NYC’s best vintage stores or rewatching <em>Moonstruck</em> for the 50th time. “Snap out of it!”</p>

item.title: I Scrolled Through Over 6,347 Black Friday Deals—These Are Hands Down The Best Basics
item.dc:content:
I woke up at 6 AM to get a head start on today's deals. I perused over 6,347 deals, and here's what inspired me this morning. Mango is offering up to 50% off select items; spoiler: it's lots of cute coats and tees. Use code CYBER20 at Net-a-Porter to save an extra 20% on denim, sweaters, and more. Oh, and how could I forget 25% off everything at Reformation? There are plenty more deals at Almina Concept (an editor go-to), COS, Aligne, Naadam, ALO—the list goes on.

item.title: 20 Anti-Trend Black Friday Buys My 59-Year-Old Mum and I Would Actually Spend Our Money On
item.dc:content:
Those who know me know that I rarely buy anything without my mum's approval. There are a few reasons for this, but the main one is that she has over 30 years of experience in the fashion industry and exceptionally good taste (far, far better than mine). Whether it's an investment handbag, a high-street knit, a beauty product or something for the home, if it hasn't been approved by Debbie, it does not get ordered.

My approach to this year's Black Friday sales is no different. It's easy to get swept up in tempting discounts, but, as always, I'm only buying pieces I wanted before they went on sale, that I know I'll wear for years to come, and, of course, that my mum has signed off on.

In fact, just this morning, we compared the pieces sitting in our respective baskets and discovered we'd gravitated towards many of the same things. The result? A rather stylish edit, if I say so myself. And it's perfect timing, as the 2026 Black Friday sales have officially begun! While many retailers launched their offers earlier this week, all the sales are now live, although some deals are only available today, November 27. So, scroll on to see the 2026 Black Friday buys my mum and I have both approved.

Shop My Mum and I's Black Friday Basket:
Reformation
Cove Cashmere Oversized Crew

Cashmere makes for an ideal sale purchase.
Maybelline
Instant Age Rewind Eraser Concealer

Both my mum and I swear by this concealer, which not only rivals some of the more expensive concealers I’ve tried, but is currently just £5. I use it to conceal my dark circles, whilst my mum swears by it as it’s one of the few concealers that doesn’t settle into lines.
Rise & Fall
Cashmere Merino Bandana

This is on my Christmas wish list, so hopefully my husband is seeing this!
abercrombie
Curve Love High Rise Barrel Jean

Once you try Abercrombie jeans, you never go back.

Wool and Cashmere Jacket

A sensationally good discount on this It jacket.

The dream Black Friday purchase.

Mary Jane Leather Ballet Flats

We've both been eyeing these up for weeks.

Wool Blend Coat With Funnel Neck

Mango's coat selection is such a standout this year.

Our perfume on sale! It would be silly not to stock up...

The Brooklyn

I think The Brooklyn is my favourite DeMellier bag of them all.

I tried this on in store a few weeks ago and am thrilled it's now reduced, as I was going to pay full price!

Another one of our go-to beauty products reduced.

The Ischia dress is a cult favourite. I've invested in this print for next spring/summer. Note: if you are also shopping this style, take a size down to your usual!

Already on the way!

A timeless pair of sunnies that will become a staple in my handbag.
Reformation
Aime Cape

We are both really obsessed with this top for party season, but also with shorts or white denim in summer.

A beauty.

Knitwear is never a bad sale buy!

This entire set would be my dream Boxing Day outfit.

Black Friday 2026 FAQs

What Is Black Friday?

Black Friday is an annual shopping event when brands and retailers offer discounts across fashion, beauty, homeware, technology and more. Originating in the United States, it takes place the day after Thanksgiving and has become one of the biggest shopping events of the year in the UK. Today, Black Friday sales often begin weeks before the official date, giving shoppers the opportunity to find deals on everything from wardrobe staples to Christmas gifts.

When Is Black Friday 2026?

Black Friday 2026 falls on Friday, 27 November. However, many brands launch their Black Friday sales in the weeks leading up to the date, with some offers available throughout November. The Black Friday shopping period typically continues over the weekend and into Cyber Monday on Monday, 30 November.

When do Black Friday Sales Start in 2026?

Black Friday sales in 2026 are expected to begin at different times depending on the brand or retailer. Whilst Black Friday itself takes place on Friday, 27 November, many brands launch early offers in the weeks beforehand. Check back regularly for the latest Black Friday deals from your favourite fashion and beauty retailers.

When Do Black Friday Sales End in 2026?

There is no official end date for Black Friday sales. Many retailers extend their offers throughout the Black Friday weekend and into Cyber Monday on Monday, 30 November 2026, whilst others may end their promotions earlier or continue discounting into December. Always check individual retailers for confirmed sale dates and terms.

Which Brands Are Taking Part in Black Friday 2026?

What Should I Buy During the Black Friday Sales?

Black Friday is a good opportunity to invest in fashion and beauty pieces you've had your eye on, replenish everyday essentials or get ahead with Christmas shopping. Look out for discounts on winter coats, boots, cashmere, bags, skincare, makeup and fragrance. Before buying, compare prices and check the terms of each offer to make sure you're getting a worthwhile deal.

Are Black Friday Deals Worth It?

From designer handbags to jewellery and beauty favourites, plenty of brands are offering discounts for Black Friday 2026. This year, you can shop deals from brands including Zara, DeMellier, Missoma, Dyson and Elemis, with offers across selected styles and collections. We might even have a few exclusive discounts up our sleeves for you, too! We've rounded up the sales worth knowing about to help you find the best fashion and beauty deals.

Black Friday can be a useful time to shop for fashion and beauty at reduced prices, but not every offer represents the best value. If there's a particular item you've been considering, check its price before the sale begins and compare offers across retailers. Shopping with a wish list in mind can also help you prioritise pieces you'll genuinely wear or use. Our recommendations are selected by our editors who weigh up all the options for you, so you can trust their selections are, in their opinion, worth it.

Where Can I Find the Best Black Friday Fashion and Beauty Deals?

For the best Black Friday fashion and beauty deals, start with the brands and retailers you already love, then compare prices across different stockists. Who What Wear UK will be rounding up standout discounts, editor-approved buys and the fashion and beauty pieces worth shopping. Check our latest Black Friday coverage for updates on the best deals.

When Is Black Friday 2027?

Black Friday 2027 falls on Friday, 26 November. The annual shopping event takes place on the Friday after U.S. Thanksgiving, so its date changes each year. Many retailers are likely to launch deals ahead of the official date, with Cyber Monday following on Monday, 29 November 2027.
item.dc:creator: Poppy Nash
item.dc:description: <p>Poppy joined the Who What Wear UK team as managing editor in 2022. After graduating from university with a degree in English literature, she worked for a number of print and digital publications, including Women's Health, The Times, Hello! and Marie Claire. In these roles she assisted the fashion teams with print content as well as digital shopping features, shoots and celebrity news. </p><p>Prior to Who What Wear, Poppy worked at SheerLuxe as the commercial content manager. There she oversaw all paid-for site content and inclusions, managed the visual assets and briefs for branded content, and ensured all content—whether editorial or commercial—was in line with overall brand guidelines and tone. She also supported the editorial team by looking after visual merchandising on site and reviewing the brand’s daily newsletters. </p><p>As WWW UK’s managing editor, Poppy spends most of her time looking after the content calendar and all output across the brand, in addition to working with contributors, supporting with social media planning, assisting with branded content and contributing to brand strategy. Poppy prides herself on being organised, and a keen eye for detail means she oversees the production of tentpole moments such as Who What Wear’s quarterly celebrity covers, the Wedding Issue, team shoots, events, industry-facing moments, gift guides and more. In addition to this, Poppy ensures processes across the brand are efficient and effective, and is always on the lookout for ways the team can work smarter, not harder! As someone who works behind the scenes (Poppy loves a spreadsheet!), you won’t find many articles by Poppy on site, but when you do there’s no doubt they will either be focused on dresses, handbags or classic high-street buys. Or better yet, all three!</p><p>Born and raised in London, Poppy is a true city girl. When she's not thinking about clothes (or raiding her mum’s wardrobe), Poppy fills her time walking along the river with her 11-year-old labradoodle, getting stuck in a good book and enjoying as many of the city’s amazing restaurants and bars as her purse will allow! Her favourite London spots are Caravel for dinner, the Ham Yard Hotel for a fancy pre-theatre drink, Daunt Books for a new read, 26Grains for breakfast and Coal Drop's Yard for a spot of shopping.</p>

Black Friday 2026 FAQs

What Is Black Friday?

Black Friday is an annual shopping event when brands and retailers offer discounts across fashion, beauty, homeware, technology and more. Originating in the United States, it takes place the day after Thanksgiving and has become one of the biggest shopping events of the year in the UK. Today, Black Friday sales often begin weeks before the official date, giving shoppers the opportunity to find deals on everything from wardrobe staples to Christmas gifts.

When Is Black Friday 2026?

Black Friday 2026 falls on Friday, 27 November. However, many brands launch their Black Friday sales in the weeks leading up to the date, with some offers available throughout November. The Black Friday shopping period typically continues over the weekend and into Cyber Monday on Monday, 30 November.

When do Black Friday Sales Start in 2026?

Black Friday sales in 2026 are expected to begin at different times depending on the brand or retailer. Whilst Black Friday itself takes place on Friday, 27 November, many brands launch early offers in the weeks beforehand. Check back regularly for the latest Black Friday deals from your favourite fashion and beauty retailers.

When Do Black Friday Sales End in 2026?

There is no official end date for Black Friday sales. Many retailers extend their offers throughout the Black Friday weekend and into Cyber Monday on Monday, 30 November 2026, whilst others may end their promotions earlier or continue discounting into December. Always check individual retailers for confirmed sale dates and terms.

Which Brands Are Taking Part in Black Friday 2026?

What Should I Buy During the Black Friday Sales?

Black Friday is a good opportunity to invest in fashion and beauty pieces you've had your eye on, replenish everyday essentials or get ahead with Christmas shopping. Look out for discounts on winter coats, boots, cashmere, bags, skincare, makeup and fragrance. Before buying, compare prices and check the terms of each offer to make sure you're getting a worthwhile deal.

Are Black Friday Deals Worth It?

From designer handbags to jewellery and beauty favourites, plenty of brands are offering discounts for Black Friday 2026. This year, you can shop deals from brands including Zara, DeMellier, Missoma, Dyson and Elemis, with offers across selected styles and collections. We might even have a few exclusive discounts up our sleeves for you, too! We've rounded up the sales worth knowing about to help you find the best fashion and beauty deals.

Black Friday can be a useful time to shop for fashion and beauty at reduced prices, but not every offer represents the best value. If there's a particular item you've been considering, check its price before the sale begins and compare offers across retailers. Shopping with a wish list in mind can also help you prioritise pieces you'll genuinely wear or use. Our recommendations are selected by our editors who weigh up all the options for you, so you can trust their selections are, in their opinion, worth it.

Where Can I Find the Best Black Friday Fashion and Beauty Deals?

For the best Black Friday fashion and beauty deals, start with the brands and retailers you already love, then compare prices across different stockists. Who What Wear UK will be rounding up standout discounts, editor-approved buys and the fashion and beauty pieces worth shopping. Check our latest Black Friday coverage for updates on the best deals.

When Is Black Friday 2027?

Black Friday 2027 falls on Friday, 26 November. The annual shopping event takes place on the Friday after U.S. Thanksgiving, so its date changes each year. Many retailers are likely to launch deals ahead of the official date, with Cyber Monday following on Monday, 29 November 2027.

item.title: My Mom and I Pored Over Black Friday Beauty Deals—15 That Immediately Won Us Both Over
item.dc:content:
Black Friday is here, and it's time to shop like you mean it. I'm not talking about pitiful 10% discounts or already low-priced items sporting a slightly lower price tag until Cyber Monday—I'm talking about discounts slashed by 50%, prestige beauty products with rare deals, and crowdpleaser purchases that will dominate as holiday presents. Which is exactly what my mom, 54, and I (plus my sister, 24, who peered over my shoulder at my buzzing computer screen) kept our eyes peeled for as we sleuthed for deals on skincare, makeup, and hair tools early. Thankfully, we struck Black Friday gold.

From savings on Charlotte Tilbury staples to coveted holiday sets and pricey at-home lasers that actually work (and are $1000 off!), we put our heads together to find the best beauty deals for Black Friday. Keep scrolling for the sales that are worth their salt.

The 15 Best Black Friday Beauty Deals, Per My Mom and I
CosRx
Snail Mucin 96% Repairing Face Serum

We're always on the hunt for new Korean skincare—especially when it's nearly 50% off. This TikTok-favorite snail mucin essence is deeply hydrating (essential for our skin in the dry Chicago winter) and works hard to calm inflamed skin (easy to develop in harsh weather and during periods of stress… ahem, the holidays). It's 46% off, so we suggest pouncing now.
Salt & Stone
Ambrette & Pear Eau de Parfum

I get compliments every time I wear this new perfume from Salt & Stone, so I'm adding it to cart now that it's 20% off (and because my sister conveniently just murmured that she wants perfume for Christmas).

Shark Beauty
Flexstyle Hair Blow Dryer & Multi-Styler

There's no better time to nab new hair tools than during Black Friday, so I'd suggest taking advantage of this deal on Shark's fan-favorite FlexStyle while it's $150 off.

MERIT x Erdem
Eye and Cheek Gift Set

I'm always on the hunt for cool-girl beauty sets to gift family and friends this time of year, and this collab from Merit and Erdem is the answer to my Secret Santa prayers. It comes with a chic curation of Merit's makeup products—including cream blush, a highlighter balm, mascara, and eye shadow—and only sets you back $54.
LYMA
Laser Pro

Okay, let's get the heavy hitters out of the way early. Yes, the Lyma Laser Pro may cost nearly $6000 at full price, but it's one of the few handheld, at-home devices editors everywhere agree actually works. You can take a whopping $1000 off if you grab it now—saving you thousands on not just this purchase, but the several laser appointments you'd need to book in order to see similar results. Act fast, because this sale is one that you may not see again until next year.
CurrentBody Skin
Face & Neck Kit: Series 3

My mom specifically requested an LED face, neck, and décolleté mask this year, which has me setting my sights on Currentbody's Series 3 Face and Neck Kit. It is equipped with red, near-infrared, deep near-infrared, blue, green, and yellow light for customized, truly effective treatments, and the additional masks ensure full-coverage treatment where it counts.

Nécessaire
The Body Duo

Elevating your shower experience can turn your daily routine into a spa-like experience, and this shower gel and lotion duo is the perfect way to get there.

PAUME
Hand & Foot Recovery Set

My mom told me that she already has this hand and foot-care kit in her cart. The nourishing mask, balm, gloves, and socks set is great for cracked skin, dry patches, and harsh winter weather all around.
Loving Tan
8-Hour Deluxe Platinum Self-Tanning Mousse

My sister requested a good self-tanner this year, so I'm grabbing Loving Tan's Deluxe Platinum Self-Tanning Mousse while it's 30% off.
DRMTLGY
FacialRx Daily Peel Pads

After testing these exfoliating pads this summer, my mom and I are convinced that they are one of the best products we've tried tried this year. We're taking full of advantage of this 29% discount to restock our skincare collections now.

Nécessaire
The Body Retinol

Anyone getting serious about their bodycare game this winter should consider Nécessaire's Body Retinol—especially since it's 20% off today.
Jo Malone London
Wood Sage & Sea Salt Fragrance Set

My mom is particular about her fragrances, which is why she exclusively asked me to find her a deal on Jo Malone's famous Wood Sage & Sea Salt Cologne. Not only did I find a bottle on sale, but this set from Saks Fifth Avenue includes two travel-sized bottles for just $115.
MAKEUP BY MARIO
Master Mattes Eyeshadow Palette: the Neutrals

We're both huge Makeup by Mario fans, so my mom is eyeing the 25% off sale happening on the brand's site today. The first item in her cart is the Master Mattes Eyeshadow Palette: the Neutrals—a cool-toned curation that complements her blue eyes.
Westman Atelier
Mini Sun Tone Bronze + Sheer Dewy Blush Gift Set

IMO, Westman Atelier makes some of the chicest products out there, so I'm jumping at the chance to snag their liquid bronzer and blush while they're both on sale.
Charlotte Tilbury
Airbrush Flawless Bronzer

"Oh, I also want that Charlotte Tilbury bronzer!" my mom yelled from the kitchen right before I returned to my laptop. Ask and you shall receive, mom.
item.description: You can save thousands (literally) on these finds.
item.dc:creator: Alyssa Brascia
item.dc:description: <p>Alyssa Brascia is an associate beauty editor at Who What Wear specializing in makeup, nail, and fragrance content. As a self-taught makeup artist and perfume savant, Brascia has personally tested more than a thousand beauty products and services—from the hottest new eye shadow palette to the buzzy manicure currently sweeping social media—reporting live from New York Fashion Week or fresh from her latest doomscroll. She is based in New York City and has 3+ years of industry experience, with rivers of content spanning from multigenerational lipstick reviews to celebrity style roundups. Brascia graduated with a BS in apparel, merchandising, and design from Iowa State University and went on to serve as a staff shopping writer at <a href="http://People.com" target="_blank"><u>People.com</u></a> for more than 2.5 years. Her earlier work can be found at InStyle, <em>Travel + Leisure</em>, <em>Shape</em>, and more. When Brascia isn’t writing, researching, and testing new beauty products, you can find her watching the latest movie to generate Oscar buzz, taking a workout class with friends, or updating her wardrobe post-shopping spree in her beloved city.</p>

item.title: Nordstrom’s Beauty Section Did Not Come to Play This Black Friday—23 Items I Bet Will Sell Out By Tomorrow
item.dc:content:
It's here, and it's bigger than ever. Nordstrom's Black Friday sale is in full swing, toting deals up to 50% off on luxury beauty, designer fragrances, techy skincare tools, and more today through December 1. Though the sale has been going on for nearly half of November, we spotted some of the very best deals this morning and couldn't wait a second longer to share the news. From celebrity-worn and editor-loved LED masks (shoutout to Bella Hadid's Omnilux Face Mask selfie) to the new and improved Dyson Airwrap, which is going for $150 less than usual, there is a cornucopia of deals for your post-Thanksgiving foraging. (Sorry for the multitude of puns. I'm done now.)

To streamline your shopping experience, I've separated our favorite finds into categories to make your scrolling, adding-to-cart, and purchasing experience a whole lot smoother. Below, find the skin-tightening microcurrent devices editors trust for snatched jawlines, fragrances that whisk you to the Italian Riviera no matter the weather outside your window, and thermal brushes that give you the coveted '90s supermodel blowout from home, every time. There's not a second to waste, so get scrolling to find the 23 Black Friday deals we're salivating over in Nordstrom's beauty section.

The 23 Best Black Friday Beauty Deals at Nordstrom in 2026, At a Glance

  • Editor-Vetted LED Mask: Omnilux Contour Face LED Mask, $315 (was $395)
  • 40% off Iconic Perfume: Armani Acqua di Gioia Eau de Parfum, $72 (was $120)
  • Upgraded Airwrap: Dyson Airwrap i.D. Multi-Styler, $499 (was $650)
  • Face-Sculpting Tool: NuFace Trinity+ Starter Kit, $257 (was $395)
  • 50% off Designer Blush: YSL Beauty Make Me Blush Liquid Blush, $20 (was $49)

Best Makeup Deals
Westman Atelier
The Lip Edition Set

Westman Atelier makes some of our very favorite lip products ever, and this discounted set combines them all at a knocked-down price. Snag the prestige brand's lipstick, lip liner, and lip treatment for just $55 total.
Clinique
Almost Lipstick in Black Honey

An iconic shade that deserves a spot in your winter glam rotation—especially now that it's less than $20.
Make Up For Ever
Artist Color Pencil Long-Lasting Liner

Perhaps one of celebrity makeup artists' favorite lip pencils ever is on sale for less than $20 in every shade.
OGEE
Crystal Contour Collection

Sculpt your complexion in 3, 2, 1 with this luxury blush, contour, and highlight trio.
Estée Lauder
Double Wear Stay-In-Place Matte Foundation

The buildable, oil-controlling, satin-matte foundation of your winter dreams.
YSL Beauty
Make Me Blush Liquid Blush

Act fast—this designer blush is 50% off.

Best Fragrance Deals
ARMANI
Acqua Di Gioia Eau de Parfum

So you can smell like summertime no matter the month.
MUGLER
Alien Goddess Eau de Parfum

Soft, floral, and ever so slightly sweet, Mugler Alien gets a sparkling upgrade.
TOM FORD
Private Blend Tobacco Vanille Eau de Parfum Set

A sweet and smoky fragrance primed for winter and designed to blur the lines between gender.
Dolce&Gabbana
Light Blue Eau de Toilette 3-Piece Set

This three-piece set is perfect for anyone searching for a signature scent—and two travel sizes to go wherever they do.
TOM FORD
Private Blend Lost Cherry Eau de Parfum Set

Spicy, sweet, and warm, this boozy, fruit-forward fragrance is a great winter scent for gourmand lovers.

Best Skincare Deals
OMNILUX
Contour Face Led Mask

A combination of red and near-infrared light firms, soothes, and evens the skin tone with continuous use. If you want to complete the whole set, the neck and décolleté devices are also discounted.
Augustinus Bader
The Rich Cream

Deeply nourishing and ideal for dry, winter skin.
Therabody
Theraface Depuffing Wand

If you want sculpted cheekbones, firmer skin, and the appearance of more rested eyes, consider this handheld device that oscillates between warm and cold treatments.
Dr. Dennis Gross Skincare
Alpha Beta Peel Extra Strength Formula

These at-home peel pads are your one-stop shop for smoother, brighter, more even-looking skin.
NuFACE
Trinity+ Starter Kit

This is my personal favorite microcurrent device, and it's 35% off if you shop today.

Best Hair Deals
Dyson
Airwrap I.D. Multi-Styler and Dryer

The Airwrap got a smart upgrade. This tool identifies your hair type (hence the name) through its connected Bluetooth app, which offers a more bespoke hairstyling routine in far less time.

Shark
Flexstyle Air Styling & Drying System

Not ready to shell out on the pricey Dyson? The Shark FlexStyle has fewer bells and whistles, but it is a tried-and-true editor favorite. Plus, it's on sale for 42% off.
Virtue
Full Shampoo

If you have limp or thin strands, this is the volumizing shampoo to grab while it's on sale. While you're at it, you may as well grab the also-discounted matching conditioner to get the full effect. (See what I did there?)
T3
Airebrush One-Step Smoothing and Volumizing Blow Dryer Brush

You can skip the blowout appointment when you have this tool in your arsenal.
DENMAN
D81M Medium Style & Shine Nylon & Natural Boar Bristle Finishing Brush

Almost every celebrity hairstylist who has styled my hair swears by Denman brushes, and this cute pink version is 25% off.
HigherDOSE
Red Light Hat

This is not your typical baseball cap. HigherDose's Red Light Hat is outfitted with 650nm red light LEDs for hair follicle rejuvenation and growth.
Oribe
Supershine Moisturizing Leave-In Hair Cream

Your summer leave-in conditioner does not pack the punch that your winter strands require. Switch it out for something more nourishing, like this luxe hair cream from Oribe.
item.description: Dyson, Armani, and Westman Atelier, oh my!
item.dc:creator: Alyssa Brascia
item.dc:description: <p>Alyssa Brascia is an associate beauty editor at Who What Wear specializing in makeup, nail, and fragrance content. As a self-taught makeup artist and perfume savant, Brascia has personally tested more than a thousand beauty products and services—from the hottest new eye shadow palette to the buzzy manicure currently sweeping social media—reporting live from New York Fashion Week or fresh from her latest doomscroll. She is based in New York City and has 3+ years of industry experience, with rivers of content spanning from multigenerational lipstick reviews to celebrity style roundups. Brascia graduated with a BS in apparel, merchandising, and design from Iowa State University and went on to serve as a staff shopping writer at <a href="http://People.com" target="_blank"><u>People.com</u></a> for more than 2.5 years. Her earlier work can be found at InStyle, <em>Travel + Leisure</em>, <em>Shape</em>, and more. When Brascia isn’t writing, researching, and testing new beauty products, you can find her watching the latest movie to generate Oscar buzz, taking a workout class with friends, or updating her wardrobe post-shopping spree in her beloved city.</p>

item.title: The Fashion and Beauty Black Friday and Cyber Monday Sales to Take Note of This Year
item.dc:content:
It feels like just yesterday we were basking in Labor Day Weekend sales, and now Black Friday and Cyber Monday are upon us. The countless promotional emails in my inbox have me ready to toss my phone in the Hudson, but I've managed to round up the clear standouts of this shopping extravaganza. With these promotional windows going beyond just the holiday weekend, there is a lot to choose from—but not all sales are built the same. Below, you'll find major discounts on fashion brands such as J.Crew and H&M, haircare items from K18, and promotions from activewear favorites like Beyond Yoga and Club Recess. Keep scrolling to treat yourself to something new or stock up on gifts for the holidays.

Up first is a sale I've already been shopping (I can't risk my wish list selling out!): J.Crew. This weekend, shop 40% off select items, 50% off most pajamas, and an additional 40% off sale items. Below, I've shared my favorite womenswear items for the season, but don't miss out on the men's and children's sections too.

J.Crew
Luna Pant

J.Crew
Fair Isle Shrunken Crewneck

J.Crew
Perfect Rib Turtleneck
J.Crew
Esme Button-Up Flannel Shirt
J.Crew
Faux Fur-Collar Puffer Jacket

J.Crew
Long-Sleeve Pajama Pant Set

H&M already sells stylish clothes at accessible price points, so 50% sitewide feels like a real gift. Winterwear is the focus here—wool coats, fleece jackets, and corduroy pants are a few of my favorite picks of the bunch. If I were you, I'd stock up on every basic your winter wardrobe needs. Come January, you'll be pleased with your purchases.

H&M

H&M

I've yet to see a holiday wish list that doesn't include a pair of UGGs. This week, the brand is offering up to 50% off select styles, including the brand's signature boots, slippers, clogs, and sneakers. You can find gifts for the whole family with this one brand alone because, let's be honest, has anyone ever turned down a new pair of UGG slippers?

UGG

UGG
Classic Mini Taslyn
UGG
Lanah Clog

This next sale is all about haircare. Your loved ones need to know the good word about K18! The Airwash™ Dry Shampoo ($48) took the beauty community by storm with its magic-like ability to refresh greasy hair, but the brand has so much more to offer. From 11/27 through 11/30, shop 20% off sitewide and receive a free full-size Astrolift on orders over $150. Be sure to use code BF20.

K18
Futureiq Biomimetic Hair Longevity Serum
K18
Leave-In Molecular Repair Hair Mask

K18
Airwash™ Dry Shampoo

K18
Heatbounce Heat Protectant

K18
TripleBright Purple Shampoo
K18
Peptide Prep™ Detox Shampoo

As I write to you from my desk, I'm currently wearing my favorite activewear set from Beyond Yoga. If you're unfamiliar with the brand, start with the Spacedye™ collection. Buttery soft and supportive without feeling restrictive, this collection has been an editor favorite for nearly a decade now. The brand has since expanded into other apparel categories and fabrics, like Luxefleece 2.0™ and Glowzone™. No matter what you choose, the quality and style can't be beat.

Pickleball has effectively taken over the country, from my grandma's retirement community in L.A. to the dedicated clubs in Times Square. If you also have family members who have fallen in love with the sport, chances are they've heard of Club Recess. This brand has the cutest workout gear, paddles, and accessories. item.title: Stop Everything! I Just Texted Everyone I Know About This Space NK Advent Calendar Deal for Black Friday
item.dc:content:
I'm not just saying this, but this year's Black Friday beauty deals are out of this world. From LED masks to hair tools, the savings are so impressive, but as someone who's written about Black Friday discounts for years, beauty advent calendars are stealing the show in 2026.

I was rounding up the best Black Friday beauty advent calendar deals this morning when I came across a discount that stopped me in my tracks. If you've read any of my articles, you'll know by now that the Space NK beauty advent calendar is one of my top picks every single Christmas. The selection of brands, full-sized products and total savings are always amazing, so when I saw the calendar in the Black Friday sale, I immediately texted everyone I know.

Shop the Space NK Beauty Advent Calendar Black Friday Sale
Space NK
Beauty Advent Calendar

Products: 35 (26 full-size products)

Value: Over £1,200

Brands: Augustinus Bader, Charlotte Tilbury, Glossier, Hourglass, K18, La Mer, Medik8, Olaplex, Tatcha and more

Worth over £1,200, the calendar is now retailing for just £193, with 30% off this Black Friday. Inside, expect a whopping 35 beauty products, including 26 full-sized favourites. I didn't think last year's Space NK calendar could be beaten, but the brand has proved me wrong.

The selection of beauty brands within the calendar is one of the most impressive offerings I have seen, with products from the likes of Augustinus Bader, Charlotte Tilbury, Hourglass and La Mer. I don't want to spoil the surprise, but behind the calendar's doors are products such as a full-size Augustinus Bader The Body Cream, a full-size Caudalie Vinoperfect Brightening Dark Spot Serum and a full-size K18 HeatBounce Conditioning Heat Protectant. The body cream alone is worth £92, so you can already imagine the incredible savings on offer.

This calendar usually sells out in no time, so this deal won't be around for long. If you've been thinking about treating yourself or a loved one to a beauty advent calendar before the start of December, now is the time to snap up an incredible discount.

Shop Now:
Space NK
Beauty Advent Calendar

Why Trust Us

At Who What Wear UK, we know that beauty isn’t one-size-fits-all. Our editors have tested thousands of products, including some skincare, makeup, hair and nails, over the years and work closely with trusted experts—dermatologists, make-up artists and leading industry insiders—to ensure every guide is well-researched, inclusive and relevant to you.

We focus on formulas that deliver, whether they’re affordable favourites or luxury investments. Our product selection is based on tangible results, ingredient know-how and what we’d truly recommend to a friend.

item.dc:creator: Grace Lindsay
item.dc:description: <p>Grace Lindsay is the deputy beauty editor at Who What Wear UK. At the age of 18 she decided to train as a makeup artist before going on to study english and media at Goldsmiths University. It was during that time that she explored her love for journalism by interning at a small beauty start-up based in Shoreditch. Since then, she has worked at a number of publications including Marie Claire and Hello!, where her love for all things beauty continued to grow. </p><p>As Who What Wear UK's deputy beauty editor, she covers everything from the latest hair trends to the stand-out makeup products of the season. She has a particular love for fragrances, and has built up quite the collection of luxury perfumes and candles over the years. As well as writing beauty articles, Grace loves creating content for WWW UK's social channels, and is always sharing her latest beauty finds with readers. </p><p>When she's not filming videos, interviewing celebrities or typing away at her laptop, she will most likely be found scrolling on TikTok, doing a face mask or catching up on her never-ending list of books to read.</p>

The body cream alone is worth £92, so you can already imagine the incredible savings on offer.

This calendar usually sells out in no time, so this deal won't be around for long. If you've been thinking about treating yourself or a loved one to a beauty advent calendar before the start of December, now is the time to snap up an incredible discount.

Shop Now:
Space NK
Beauty Advent Calendar

Why Trust Us

At Who What Wear UK, we know that beauty isn’t one-size-fits-all. Our editors have tested thousands of products, including some skincare, makeup, hair and nails, over the years and work closely with trusted experts—dermatologists, make-up artists and leading industry insiders—to ensure every guide is well-researched, inclusive and relevant to you.

We focus on formulas that deliver, whether they’re affordable favourites or luxury investments. Our product selection is based on tangible results, ingredient know-how and what we’d truly recommend to a friend.

item.title: My Jeans Have Competition: These 6 Skirt Trends Look Even Chicer With Jumpers and Boots
item.dc:content:
With jeans, satin trousers and cigarette pants dominating for so long, it really felt like fashion people lost their love for skirts for a second there. But if you adore this elegant bottom style as much as I do, then you’ll be pleased to know that the spring/summer 2027 runways have spoken: skirts aren't just back, they're the main character for next season. Don't believe me: just ask Prada, who dedicated 60+ looks to skirts during its S/S 27 show.

Now, I’m certainly not going to wait until the temperatures rise to start wearing them. In fact, there are a number of 2026 winter skirt trends cropping up that are proving impossible to ignore. Not that you'd want to when they look this chic.

After hours of scrolling on the pages of my favourite fashion people across Instagram, Pinterest and TikTok, I kept seeing six winter skirt trends crop up over and over, and I'm now ready incorporate into my wardrobe. They all perfectly toe the line between looking on trend and in-the-know as we head into 2027, as well as being easy to style and classic enough that you’ll reach for them well beyond this winter.

From effortlessly sophisticated brown leather iterations that will never date to extremely elegant zebra print styles that will let everyone know you’re an It girl through and through, keep scrolling to see and shop the six skirt trends set to dominate winter 2026. And rest assured: these pairings will put you firmly ahead of the pack, well before the skirt trends become big fashion players next year.

6 Skirt Trends Set to Dominate Winter 2026 (and Beyond)

1. Black With a Difference

Style notes: As easy as a classic black skirt can be (I should know, I practically live in them all winter), I think we can all agree that they can start to feel “samey” and uninspiring when overdone. But if black is still the colour you feel most comfortable in, never fear, because I’ve found the trend that those with a classic palette are opting for this season, and it doesn’t rely on a bold colour or flashy pattern. Enter the elevated black skirt. Whether it be an opulent satin finish, romantically inspired ruffles or a dip into the tassel fringe trend that chic dressers can’t seem to get enough of, this skirt trend strikes the perfect balance between feeling well within my comfort zone and looking cool and in the know this winter.

Shop the Trend:

ZARA
Beaded Mesh Midi Skirt

I cannot believe this is a high-street find.

BERNADETTE
Callum Taffeta Maxi Skirt

Such an elegant silhouette.

ARRANGE
Textural Satin Loop Column Midi Skirt

This is perfect fo the upcoming party season.

2. Zebra Print

Style notes: It might initially feel daunting, but with the ability to be dressed up or down with ease, if you don’t already own a zebra-print skirt, I’d highly recommend investing in one. It’s one of those it-girl items that will let everyone know you’re a true and true fashion person. I’d personally keep things simple and style with tonal black or cream separates, but if you’re feeling brave, I’ve also seen a lot of cool print clashing going on amongst the fashion set this season.

Shop the Trend:

pull & bear
Zebra print midi skirt

This will pair with neutrals and bold colours alike.

Alaïa
Zebra-Printed High-Rise Midi Skirt

I'd style mine exactly like this.

River Island
Zebra Maxi Skirt

You'll reach for this throughout the warmer months as well.

3. Sheer Overlays

Style notes: Hearing the word “sheer” might feel initially intimidating but rest assured that the translucent skirts set to dominate winter 2026 remain elegant and polished. Think structured pencil silhouettes where the sections of sheer panels bring a sense of dimension to an outfit as opposed to feeling overly sexy or out there. Plus, the winter season is synonymous with layering, meaning you can add in some coverage in the form of tights or leggings, whilst still achieving the sheer look that will leave your outfit feeling elevated and fresh.

Shop the Trend:

KHAITE
Sybil Panelled Crepe Midi Skirt

I want the entire outfit, please!
COS
Lace-Overlay Midi Skirt

This sheer lace number would look so good styled with a chunky cashmere knit,
Massimo Dutti
Double-Layer Silk Midi Skirt

Easy elegance.

4. Espresso Leather

Style notes: Getting bored of reaching for the same black pencil skirt? Well, look no further than the stunning brown leather iterations that want dressers are opting for this season. Deep espresso brown leather skirts will act as a softer but no less versatile alternative to your classic black numbers this winter. Often, when I’m trying to style lighter neutrals such as cream or tan, black skirts can feel just a little too “corporate” when worn with them. So, I’ll be taking a cue From Fashion people and using this gorgeously deep brown hue to make my leather skirts feel a little more cohesive with my lighter winter palette. And I love that it’s still deep enough to remain well within the comfort zone of a minimalist.

Shop the Trend:

MANGO
Faux Leather A-Line Skirt

Simple, sleek and so easy to style.

NOUR HAMMOUR
Origami Croc-Effect Leather Midi Wrap Skirt

Nour Hammour never disappoints me.

H&M
Coated Skirt

So sleek!

5. Polka Dot

Style notes: Contrary to popular belief, polka dot skirts are not just for the warmer weather. It’s true; they do come into their own throughout the spring and summer seasons, but there’s something that feels particularly in the know about opting for one throughout winter. It’s pretty and playful, yet still comes with a vintage edge that will allow it to last in your wardrobe for years to come without feeling dated. Plus, with a few simple outfit tweaks, you’ll find yourself reaching for this same skirt when spring 2027 comes around.

Shop the Trend:

H&M
Midi Skirt

Wear with jumpers, cardigans and shirts alike.

Rixo
Ardith Polka-Dot Silk Midi Skirt

So pretty!
M&S
Polka Dot Maxi Slip Skirt

I'm very into this chocolate brown iteration.

6. Grey Pleats

Style notes: If you were savvy enough to hold onto your pleated midi skirt through the (many) years they were considered "dated", pat yourself on the back because this preppy trend is officially back for spring/summer 2027. And pairs well with just about any top and shoe combo you fancy, from cosy knits and riding boots to a classic tee and ballet flats. It’s one of those capsule wardrobe staples that you truly cannot go wrong with.

Shop the Trend:

BOSS
A-Line Skirt in Melange Flannel

Perfect for in or out of the office.

PRADA
Rush Stitch Pleated Skirt

The entire outfit is just so good.
Autograph
Pleated Midaxi Circle Skirt

Preppy chic at its finest.

She has a passion for all things fashion, beauty and lifestyle related, but is particularly fond of fragrance, with a personal collection to rival any beauty editor's!<br><br>Prior to Who What Wear, Brittany worked as the Shopping Assistant at Reach Plc and across a number of publications, including OK!, Notebook, S Mag and The Mirror. In this role, she was responsible for creating on-site beauty and fashion content, compiling shopping grids and filming and editing weekly video content for the brand’s social media account. </p>

item.dc:description: <p>Chinazor "Chichi" Offor is a Georgia-born, Los Angeles–based Shopping editor who relocated from Brooklyn, New York, in 2022 and joined Who What Wear's West Coast offices. At WWW, she utilizes over 10 years of editorial experience to dish out shopping advice to the masses and analyze key pop-cultural moments.</p><p>After graduating from the University of Georgia's Grady College of Journalism, Chichi moved to Brooklyn and began hustling to make it in the NYC media world. Before landing at WWW, she spent some time at Vice Media Group, where she helped revolutionize<a href="https://www.refinery29.com/en-us/author/chichi-offor"> Refinery29</a>'s plus-size and inclusive fashion coverage and even co-hosted a summer styling series. Before R29, she supported Bustle Digital Group's commerce team and freelanced for various publications. </p><p>Chichi is a multi-passionate, pop culture–obsessed television and music lover who enjoys a good concert and a yummy meal just as much as she loves analyzing cultural trends and throwing together a solid outfit. After work, you can probably find her bopping around the best L.A. restaurants talking about her latest ADHD-fueled hyper-fixation (e.g., Jesse McCartney's underrated career, the negative effects of bicoastal intellectual elitism, Gen Z’s loneliness epidemic, and theories on the emo-rock music revival).</p>

item.title: I’m a Self-Confessed Cashmere Snob—The Chicest Jumper in My Wardrobe Is 15% Off This Black Friday
item.dc:content:
Every fashion person has their peculiarities. Perhaps they only invest in jeans from a particular brand, or exclusively buy socks from a chic independent store that you have never heard of. For me, knitwear is the category that I can’t get enough of. And with Black Friday firmly upon us, I’m turning my attention to stocking up on some delicious cashmere jumpers as a top priority.

Blame it on the countless chunky cardigans I received as gifts in my childhood, but I’ve developed quite the aversion to anything ill-fitting, itchy or, frankly, matronly. But as I’ve discovered, you don’t need to spend a small fortune on investing in a great cashmere jumper. In fact, my favourite style is one from an under-the-radar brand that I hadn’t heard of until fairly recently. Indeed, the Quince Mongolian cashmere oversized crewneck jumper is an item that has only just entered my orbit.

A juggernaut of affordable fashion in the US, it’s just crossed the pond and begun selling in the UK. As a result, I was one of the first fashion editors to test the brand. And well, the rest is history. After trying a small selection of products from the brand, including the very chic, bucket-style Penelope Large Shoulder Bag, which has earned me an innumerable amount of compliments, I can firmly say that Quince lives up to its reputation.

Positioning itself as an accessibly priced brand that offers items that are just as high-quality as designer products, the Quince cashmere jumper in question is crafted from 100% Grade-A Mongolian cashmere, which is a fabric composition you’ll easily find at the likes of The Row, Toteme and even Reformation, albeit at nearly 50% off traditional retail prices. Their position in the marketplace is one that’s also of interest to me, especially as more mid-priced brands vie for a luxury consumer segment.

Having worn mine for several weeks non-stop, I’ve fallen head over heels with its slouchy yet structured shape, soft-as-butter feel and ribbed finishing. Best of all, it’s now available to shop in the Black Friday sale. (With a bonus 15% off.) Scroll through to shop the chic Quince Cashmere jumper for yourself.

Shop the Quince Cashmere Jumper in the 2026 Black Friday Sale:

item.dc:creator: Ava Gilchrist
item.dc:description: <p>Ava Gilchrist is the Fashion Writer at Who What Wear UK. Born in Sydney but now based in London, Ava has worked at some of the most prestigious women’s luxury and lifestyle publications, including ELLE, Marie Claire and most recently GRAZIA, where she held the title of Senior Fashion Features Writer. Ava has five years of industry experience, beginning her writing career after graduating with a Bachelor of Communication from the University of Technology, Sydney. Her words fuse style with substance, bringing readers insightful commentary on the latest fashion trends, runway shows, celebrity red carpet offerings, must-have shopping pieces, beauty hacks and pop culture moments. As an editor, Ava has interviewed everyone from Kendall Jenner, Margot Robbie, Zendaya, Emma Corrin, Kylie Minogue and Charli XCX.</p>

item.content:encoded:
Every fashion person has their peculiarities. Perhaps they only invest in jeans from a particular brand, or exclusively buy socks from a chic independent store that you have never heard of. For me, knitwear is the category that I can’t get enough of. And with Black Friday firmly upon us, I’m turning my attention to stocking up on some delicious cashmere jumpers as a top priority.

Blame it on the countless chunky cardigans I received as gifts in my childhood, but I’ve developed quite the aversion to anything ill-fitting, itchy or, frankly, matronly. But as I’ve discovered, you don’t need to spend a small fortune on investing in a great cashmere jumper. In fact, my favourite style is one from an under-the-radar brand that I hadn’t heard of until fairly recently. Indeed, the Quince Mongolian cashmere oversized crewneck jumper is an item that has only just entered my orbit.

A juggernaut of affordable fashion in the US, it’s just crossed the pond and begun selling in the UK. As a result, I was one of the first fashion editors to test the brand. And well, the rest is history. After trying a small selection of products from the brand, including the very chic, bucket-style Penelope Large Shoulder Bag, which has earned me an innumerable amount of compliments, I can firmly say that Quince lives up to its reputation.

Positioning itself as an accessibly priced brand that offers items that are just as high-quality as designer products, the Quince cashmere jumper in question is crafted from 100% Grade-A Mongolian cashmere, which is a fabric composition you’ll easily find at the likes of The Row, Toteme and even Reformation, albeit at nearly 50% off traditional retail prices. Their position in the marketplace is one that’s also of interest to me, especially as more mid-priced brands vie for a luxury consumer segment.

Having worn mine for several weeks non-stop, I’ve fallen head over heels with its slouchy yet structured shape, soft-as-butter feel and ribbed finishing. Best of all, it’s now available to shop in the Black Friday sale. (With a bonus 15% off.) Scroll through to shop the chic Quince Cashmere jumper for yourself.

item.title: You Can Keep Your Black Court Shoes—This "Dated" Heel Is the Only Style I Want to Wear Now
item.dc:content:
If, like me, you spent your formative years tottering around in "princess" heels at least two sizes too big, well, this week's column is going to be music to your ears. The vintage-inspired peep-toe mule is officially back, but its roots run deeper than the whimsical, pop-girl wardrobes of our youth.

For all of their party-starter charm, their origins go deeper. What started during the Great Depression as an accessible touch of glamour has evolved throughout the ages. During the ‘50s, the silhouette was the favourite of Hollywood starlets, crafted from satin uppers and marabou feathers. Then in the '70s, they were re-imagined in chunky cork and wood, making them a great deal more bohemian. Finally, in the ‘90s, we arrived at the exact shape we know and love today. A sleek, vampish shoe balanced on a dainty kitten heel that flashes your pedicure. All at once, shoes were at the front of the cultural conversation, and Sarah Jessica Parker's Carrie Bradshaw spoke the immortal words, “I spent $40,000… on shoes?!”

By the turn of the century, the mule had moved into its minimalist era—picture Carolyn Bessette Kennedy in Manolo Blahnik’s sleek patent black Callasli, or Chloë Sevigny in strappy, open-toe heeled sandals with those graphic zebra-print tights. Although the early iterations were all about Barbie-doll Americana, they were almost always universally black—that is until Y2K maximalism arrived.

Towering platform peep-toes were in almost every early-noughties paparazzi shot (think Britney Spears, Paris Hilton, Beyoncé and Christina Aguilera climbing out of cars in 6-inch heels), and the style quickly became the envy of every fashionable dresser around. Bold in colour and heavy on embellishment, these pumps were dopamine-inducing by design, although equally risk-prone. These shoes were all about video-vixen allure and were not designed with wallflowers (or 1950s housewives) in mind.

With 64% of Gen Z preferring to shop secondhand first (according to Fashion United), and nostalgia for Y2K reaching a fever pitch, the style set is officially back in heels, and it's these slender, vintage-inspired peep-toes that are leading the charge. Alexia Ioannou, founder of shoe brand Nou (whose pumps are proving particularly popular), shares how her affinity for archival fashion has directly inspired the brand.

“I spent years as a vintage dealer, and thousands of designer shoes passed through my hands. I knew exactly what I wanted in a heel, and could never find it new. Everything in stores was either beautifully made and out of reach or mass-produced in synthetic materials. So I made it myself. I basically 'Frankensteined' my three best vintage designer pairs from my archive into one shoe: a curved slope and a sturdy 3-inch heel. The leopard ponyhair is a wink to my Jersey roots: loud and unapologetic. I took it from idea to finished shoe in under four months,” she shares.

Whilst ‘90s Manolo Blahniks continue to tickle Alexia’s creative itch, today designers are drawing inspiration for the peep-toe-mules revival from every corner of pop culture. Chloé’s viral Jelly Mule (championed by Kylie Jenner) channels pure Barbie nostalgia, whilst Adéla's patent sky-high peep-toe pumps for Quenlin Blackwell's Feeding Starving Celebrities serve paparazzi-era drama. And Iris Law's cherry pair? Well, they look plucked straight from Carrie Bradshaw's shoe-drobe.

I'm officially convinced: the peep-toe is the perfect finishing touch to jeans-and-a-nice-top or for adding a playful pop to slogan T-shirts and capris. So, if you’re in the market, scroll down to shop my edit of the best peep-toe mules.

With a degree in Fashion Communications, she brings a well-rounded background across editorial, marketing and digital media. She has previously held roles at Women & Home, worked in marketing for jewellery brands such as Lara Heems and Tara Rosenbaum and gained event experience with British Vogue, Glamour and GQ. Imani also has a strong grasp of social media, having worked as Influencer Assistant to Pia Mance and, most recently, having served as Fashion and Beauty Assistant at social-first publisher Eliza.co.uk. At Who What Wear UK Imani will support the fashion team in creating engaging Gen-Z-aligned editorial content and brand try-ons, as well as be a regular face on the brand’s social media, with a weekly video franchise that sees her try some of the biggest trends or discuss her favourite celebrity looks. </p>

item.title: Live From London: These Are the 13 Best Looks in Fashion Awards History
item.dc:content:
The Royal Albert Hall is one of Britain’s premier Victorian masterpieces, bequeathed with an ornate terracotta façades and grand dome. Yet it is on the Queen Elizabeth II Diamond Jubilee Steps where the most impressive feats are showcased. At least that is the case each year with the arrival of the annual Fashion Awards.

The United Kingdom’s premier sartorial event, the evening is a celebration of impeccable British style and thrusts emerging and established designers into the international spotlight. Hosted annually since 1989, with Princess Diana attending the first-ever iteration in a sculptural, high-collar Catherine Walker gown, the event gathers tastemakers and trendsetters from both sides of the pond.

Under the shadows of the red velvet-covered royal circle, it’s the only night in London where up-and-coming fashion darlings can mingle with legendary stalwarts, and perhaps risk a run-in with an aristocrat or two. (It is thrown in the centre of South Kensington, after all.)

Notable past attendees include David and Victoria Beckham, Harry Styles, Mick Jagger and Madonna, meaning the dress code can run the gamut from eccentric Alessandro Michele tailoring to a little black Gucci number from Tom Ford’s tenure at the brand.

Now, ahead of the 2026 edition, which will be held on Monday, November 30, it’s high time to revisit the best red carpet moments at the Fashion Awards of all time. With a storied history, selecting the crème de la crème looks was by no means an easy feat.

And with so many personal styles on display—dare we mention French fashion commentator Lyas’s nearly-naked Jean Paul Gaultier bodysuit from Duran Lantink’s spring/summer 2026 collection—the beauty of the event is the amalgamation of posh refinement, haunting glamour and gothic deconstruction. Truly the most apt descriptor for great British style. So, without further ado, keep scrolling through to revisit the best dressed in the history of Fashion Awards.

Before you dive in, test your knowledge of Fashion Awards history with our quiz below!

The Best Fashion Awards Looks of All Time:

Who: Rihanna and A$AP Rocky
What: The Fashion Awards, 2019
Wear: Custom Fenty.

Who: Maya Jama
What: The Fashion Awards, 2024
Wear: A custom Demi-couture tapestry gown by Conner Ives.

Who: Sienna Miller
What: The Fashion Awards, 2025
Wear: Look 37 from Sarah Burton's debut SS26 collection for Givenchy.

Who: Pinkpantheress
What: The Fashion Awards, 2025
Wear: Custom Chopova Lowena inspired by the SS26.

Who: Princess Diana
What: The Fashion Awards, 1989
Wear: A white silk couture evening gown and cropped jacket designed by Catherine Walker, nicknamed the "Elvis" dress.

Who: Lila Moss
What: The Fashion Awards, 2024
Wear: A custom floor-length sheer slip dress by Nensi Dojaka, inspired by Kate Moss's naked dress from the 1993 Elite Model party.

Who: Anok Yai
What: The Fashion Awards, 2025
Wear: Custom corseted Dilara Findikoğlu.

Who: Harry Styles
What: The Fashion Awards, 2013
Wear: Saint Laurent by Hedi Slimane.

Who: Rihanna and A$AP Rocky
What: The Fashion Awards, 2024
Wear: An archival fur coat from Christian Lacroix's Fall 2002 collection.

Who: Jodie Turner-Smith
What: The Fashion Awards, 2024
Wear: Burberry

Who: Alex Consani
What: The Fashion Awards, 2025
Wear: A black strapless corset and ruffled maxi skirt by Alexander McQueen, featuring red skull monogram inspired by the SS03 'Irere

Who: Simone Ashley
What: The Fashion Awards, 2024
Wear: Custom Prada.

Who: Lewis Hamilton and Grace Wales Bonner
What: The Fashion Awards, 2023
Wear: A bespoke suit inspired by Wales Bonner's SS24 collection.

Born in Sydney but now based in London, Ava has worked at some of the most prestigious women’s luxury and lifestyle publications, including ELLE, Marie Claire and most recently GRAZIA, where she held the title of Senior Fashion Features Writer. Ava has five years of industry experience, beginning her writing career after graduating with a Bachelor of Communication from the University of Technology, Sydney. Her words fuse style with substance, bringing readers insightful commentary on the latest fashion trends, runway shows, celebrity red carpet offerings, must-have shopping pieces, beauty hacks and pop culture moments. As an editor, Ava has interviewed everyone from Kendall Jenner, Margot Robbie, Zendaya, Emma Corrin, Kylie Minogue and Charli XCX.</p>

item.title: I Asked an Expert—Beauty Insiders Will Be Wearing These 6 Makeup Trends This Winter
item.dc:content:
I have to admit, although I’m a beauty editor, I tend to stick to the same makeup trends year-round. My biggest transformation this year was switching from my usual glowy foundation to a soft matte base and, while I’d say the effect was subtle, there was something invigorating about embracing a new look.

In light of this, to close the year, I’ve made it my mission to challenge myself and introduce a few new makeup trends to my rotation. I turned to an expert, Naana Adu Serwaah, makeup artist and founder of Muse by Naana, for her predictions on which makeup trends beauty insiders will be wearing this season (and consequently, which ones I should be recreating). Coincidentally, velvet skin was already on her radar alongside pretty berry tones and, of course, a few party season makeup trends, too.

Keep scrolling to see the six makeup trends she predicts will be everywhere this winter, and why not set yourself the challenge of stepping out of your beauty comfort zone too?

6 Winter Makeup Trends to Try in 2026

1. Winter Flush

When it comes to blusher, Adu Serwaah told me there’s only one way to go. “Berry and plum blushes will be everywhere, giving that just-came-in-from-the-cold glow. On deeper skin tones, rich berries and wine shades look absolutely stunning." To recreate the look, Adu Serwaah tells me cream blush works best. “Tap it high on the cheeks and lightly across the nose," she says.

Get the Look:
Rhode
Pocket Blush
YSL BEAUTY
Make Me Blush Cream
Maybelline
Cheek & Lip Mousse Twilight Berry

2. Velvet Skin

“This winter, it's all about skin that looks like skin, with a soft, velvety finish instead of heavy matte or high shine,” Adu Serwaah says. “Prep with a rich moisturiser, then press a light foundation or skin tint into the skin with your fingers or a damp sponge.” And her top tip for a flawless finish? “Only conceal where you really need it."

Get the Look:
Nars
Soft Matte Complete Foundation
Danessa Myricks
Beauty Yummy Skin Blurring Balm
CHANEL
Velvet Blurring Foundation

3. Frosted Eyes

Party season is calling, and Adu Serwaah is predicting an eye makeup trend that perfectly fits the festive mood. “Icy, metallic lids in silver, champagne and copper are perfect for the party season, and they catch the light beautifully in photos,” she says. “For an easy version at home, press a shimmer shadow, like Victoria Beckham’s Lid Lustre, onto the centre of the lid with your fingertip. It gives instant glamour in seconds.”

Get the Look:
Victoria Beckham Beauty
Lid Lustre in Mirror
Lisa Eldridge
Liquid Lurex Eyeshadow in Anjelica
MAC Cosmetics
Dazzleshadow Liquid Eyeshadow

4. Burgundy Lashes

"Coloured mascara is having a moment, and burgundy is the most wearable shade," says Adu Serwaah. "It's subtle in daylight but makes eyes look brighter and warmer, especially brown eyes. Just swap your usual black mascara for a burgundy or plum one, or apply it over the top of black for a softer effect."

Get the Look:
Maybelline
Burgundy Haze Sky High Mascara
Clinique
Black Honey Mascara
Kiko
Plum Maxi Mod Colour Mascara

5. Blurred Bordeaux Lips

“Deep wine and Bordeaux lips are a winter classic,” Adu Serwaah explains, “but this year they're softer and diffused rather than sharp. For a soft-focused finish, dab the lipstick on with your finger and blur the edges for a 'just-bitten' stain that's much easier to wear day to night."

Get the Look:
Summer Fridays
Flushed Lip Stain Plum
REFY
Lip Blush in Canyon
Glow Recipe
Lip Blur Balm in Say It Anyway

6. Toffee Tones

If dark red lips aren’t for you, Adu Serwaah recommends switching to a toffee or chocolate brown shade instead. “Warm caramel and chocolate lips are back, and they're flattering on every skin tone,” she told me. “Line with a brown lip liner slightly deeper than your natural lip colour, then top with a creamy toffee or a touch of brown lip gloss (like Fenty’s Hot Chocolit) for a modern take on the '90s look.”

Get the Look:
Fenty Beauty
Hot Chocolit Gloss Bomb
Glossier
Lip Line Enhancing Pencil in Bare
e.l.f.
Hot as Fudge Lip Oil

item.title: I Just Got Sent a Secret Link for 20% Off Margot Robbie's Favourite Skincare Tool—Here It Is
item.dc:content:
If there's one thing I recommend shopping for during the Black Friday sales, it's beauty tech. There are some seriously impressive skincare tools out there, but it's no secret they can set you back a small fortune. This kind of tech doesn't often go on sale, but when it does, it's the perfect time to invest. I've been keeping an eye out for deals on my favourite tools, and thanks to my job as a beauty editor, I've been sent a secret link for 20% off my ride-or-die skincare gadgets. What gadgets am I talking about, you ask? None other than the ZIIP Halo and the CurrentBody LED Mask.

If you want glowing, snatched skin this Christmas, trust me when I say these are the tools that will deliver. Even Margot Robbie is a fan. Yes, in an interview with The Telegraph, the star revealed that she loves using the ZIIP Halo in her skincare routine. Below, I've detailed why these tools are worth the investment, and in the spirit of giving, I've even shared my secret links so that you can shop the incredible discounts yourself. You are welcome...

The Best ZIIP Black Friday Deals 2026

  • Best Microcurrent Device Deal: ZIIP Halo, was £380, now £304
  • Best Skincare Deal: ZIIP Glass Skin Complete Routine, was £150, now £102
  • Best Bundle: ZIIP Halo Pro Collagen Routine, was £530, now £360

1. ZIIP Halo
ZIIP
Halo

You can currently save an impressive 20% on Margot Robbie's go-to skincare tool. After testing it myself, I can confirm it's like having a professional facial at home. It combines microcurrent and nanocurrent technology to lift and tone the skin. The best bit? The device connects to an app where you can choose from a range of facial treatments and plans, and the app will guide you through the entire thing. The microcurrent technology can feel a little strange at first, but you soon get used to it. When I use this consistently, my skin always looks lifted and rejuvenated.

2. ZIIP Glass Skin Complete Routine
ZIIP
Glass Skin Complete Routine

If you didn't know, ZIIP recently launched its own skincare products, with four ranges targeting different concerns. I have my eyes on the "Glass Skin" collection, which features a cleanser, a serum and a moisturiser, all designed to boost luminosity. The serum is particularly impressive, exfoliating and smoothing the skin with a blend of AHA, PHA and DCA.

3. ZIIP Halo Pro Collagen Routine
ZIIP
Halo Pro Collagen Routine

This bundle is the ultimate skincare routine upgrade. It features the ZIIP Halo device, four gels to pair with your device, the Reset Foaming Cleanser, the Firm Serum and the Bounce Moisturiser, all with an impressive saving of £170.

The Best CurrentBody Black Friday Deals 2026

  • Best LED Face Mask Deal: CurrentBody LED Red Light Therapy Face Mask: Series 3, was £500, now £400
  • Best LED Hair Tool Deal: CurrentBody Skin LED Hair Growth Helmet, was £650, now £520
  • Best Bundle: CurrentBody LED Face & Hair Kit: Series 3, was £1,150, now £828

4. CurrentBody LED Red Light Therapy Face Mask: Series 3
CurrentBody
LED Red Light Therapy Face Mask: Series 3

If you're after an LED mask this Black Friday, this device is one of the most impressive on the market. The new CurrentBody Series 3 LED Mask offers six wavelengths (including red, near-infrared, deep near-infrared, blue, green and yellow) and is completely customisable, so you can choose which areas to target with which lights. How clever is that? Beauty editor Eleanor Vousden has been testing it out and is already impressed. "The option to customise your treatment sets it apart from anything else out there, and with CurrentBody's technology, I can confidently recommend it to anyone who is looking to invest in a good LED mask."

5. CurrentBody Skin LED Hair Growth Helmet
CurrentBody
Skin LED Hair Growth Helmet

Believe it or not, you can also save 20% on the brand's popular LED hair device. This clever helmet utilises red light therapy to stimulate hair follicles and encourage thicker, fuller-looking strands. It has 120 LED lights in total, covering your entire scalp, and each treatment lasts just ten minutes.

6. CurrentBody LED Face & Hair Kit: Series 3
CurrentBody
LED Face & Hair Kit: Series 3

If you really want to step up your skincare and haircare routines in 2027 and like the sound of both devices, the brand is offering an impressive £322 saving on this LED Face & Hair Kit. It features the new Series 3 LED mask and Hair Growth Helmet, meaning you're fully kitted out for the year ahead.

What Is Black Friday?

Black Friday is an annual shopping event when brands and retailers offer discounts across fashion, beauty, homeware, technology and more. Originating in the United States, it takes place the day after Thanksgiving and has become one of the biggest shopping events of the year in the UK. Today, Black Friday sales often begin weeks before the official date, giving shoppers the opportunity to find deals on everything from wardrobe staples to Christmas gifts.

When Is Black Friday 2026?

Black Friday 2026 falls on Friday 27 November. However, many brands launch their Black Friday sales in the weeks leading up to the date, with some offers available throughout November. The Black Friday shopping period typically continues over the weekend and into Cyber Monday on Monday 30 November.

When Do Black Friday Sales Start in 2026?

Black Friday sales in 2026 are expected to begin at different times depending on the brand or retailer. While Black Friday itself takes place on Friday 27 November, many brands launch early offers in the weeks beforehand. Check back regularly for the latest Black Friday deals from your favourite fashion and beauty retailers.

When Do Black Friday Sales End in 2026?

There is no official end date for Black Friday sales. Many retailers extend their offers throughout the Black Friday weekend and into Cyber Monday on Monday, 30 November 2026, while others may end their promotions earlier or continue discounting into December. Always check individual retailers for confirmed sale dates and terms.

Which Brands Are Taking Part in Black Friday 2026?

A number of fashion and beauty brands are expected to take part in Black Friday 2026, with discounts on everything from wardrobe basics to jewellery and skincare. In previous years, we've seen brands including DeMellier, Missoma, Dyson and Elemis offer Black Friday deals, so we're keeping an eye out for their return this year. We might even have a few exclusive discounts up our sleeves for you, too! We'll be rounding up the brands to know and the offers worth shopping as more sales are announced.

What Should I Buy During the Black Friday Sales?

Black Friday is a good opportunity to invest in fashion and beauty pieces you've had your eye on, replenish everyday essentials or get ahead with Christmas shopping. Look out for discounts on winter coats, boots, cashmere, bags, skincare, make-up and fragrance. Before buying, compare prices and check the terms of each offer to make sure you're getting a worthwhile deal.

Are Black Friday Deals Worth It?

Black Friday can be a useful time to shop for fashion and beauty at reduced prices, but not every offer represents the best value. If there's a particular item you've been considering, check its price before the sale begins and compare offers across retailers. Shopping with a wish list in mind can also help you prioritise pieces you'll genuinely wear or use. Our recommendations are selected by our editors who weigh up all the options for you, so you can trust their selections are, in their opinion, worth it.

Where Can I Find the Best Black Friday Fashion and Beauty Deals?

For the best Black Friday fashion and beauty deals, start with the brands and retailers you already love, then compare prices across different stockists. Who What Wear UK will be rounding up standout discounts, editor-approved buys and the fashion and beauty pieces worth shopping. Check our latest Black Friday coverage for updates on the best deals.

When Is Black Friday 2027?

Black Friday 2027 falls on Friday 26 November. The annual shopping event takes place on the Friday after US Thanksgiving, so its date changes each year. Many retailers are likely to launch deals ahead of the official date, with Cyber Monday following on Monday 29 November 2027.

Why Trust Us

At Who What Wear UK, we know that beauty isn’t one-size-fits-all. Our editors have tested thousands of products, including some skincare, makeup, hair and nails, over the years and work closely with trusted experts—dermatologists, make-up artists and leading industry insiders—to ensure every guide is well-researched, inclusive and relevant to you.

We focus on formulas that deliver, whether they’re affordable favourites or luxury investments. Our product selection is based on tangible results, ingredient know-how and what we’d truly recommend to a friend.
item.dc:creator: Grace Lindsay
item.dc:description: <p>Grace Lindsay is the deputy beauty editor at Who What Wear UK. At the age of 18 she decided to train as a makeup artist before going on to study english and media at Goldsmiths University. It was during that time that she explored her love for journalism by interning at a small beauty start-up based in Shoreditch. Since then, she has worked at a number of publications including Marie Claire and Hello!, where her love for all things beauty continued to grow. </p><p>As Who What Wear UK's deputy beauty editor, she covers everything from the latest hair trends to the stand-out makeup products of the season. She has a particular love for fragrances, and has built up quite the collection of luxury perfumes and candles over the years. As well as writing beauty articles, Grace loves creating content for WWW UK's social channels, and is always sharing her latest beauty finds with readers. </p><p>When she's not filming videos, interviewing celebrities or typing away at her laptop, she will most likely be found scrolling on TikTok, doing a face mask or catching up on her never-ending list of books to read.</p>
