item.title: It’s Suddenly Freezing, and I’ve Never Seen Puffer Coats Look So Chic—9 Styles I’d Buy This Black Friday
item.dc:content:
We’re currently in the depths of winter, and getting dressed to leave the house in near-zero temperatures has become something of a sartorial challenge. Trying not to resemble the Michelin Man beneath my seemingly endless layers is proving increasingly difficult, so I’ve set myself a task that few fashion editors would relish: finding a genuinely chic, dare I say cool, puffer jacket in the Black Friday sales. I know, I know—a gripping undertaking, but one that the plummeting temperatures have made all the more pressing.

When it comes to finding a genuinely chic puffer, there are a few things I look for. First and foremost, it’s all in the details. Think waist-cinching belts, exaggerated funnel necklines and even built-in scarves (yes, scarf puffers do exist). Checked prints, reversible designs and faux-fur trims also earn extra sartorial points. Next up is composition. A quality down filling can offer excellent insulation without unnecessary bulk, whilst weather-resistant finishes make all the difference when braving the elements. Finally, there’s the question of price. A really good puffer tends to command a slightly higher price tag, which is precisely why I’d recommend investing in one during the Black Friday sales.

With that in mind, I’ve scoured the sales to find the chicest puffer coats that deliver on both style and substance. From Massimo Dutti, to Mango, keep scrolling to shop my edit of the very best.

Shop The Best Puffer Coats In The Black Friday Sales
MANGO
Belt Puffer Coat

Mango’s belted puffer is proof that practical outerwear needn’t come at the expense of style.

Uniqlo
Seamless Down Long Coat

When it comes to outerwear that can withstand a British winter without costing a small fortune, Uniqlo rarely disappoints.

Massimo Dutti
Down Jacket With Toggle Detail

Leave it to Massimo Dutti to make a down jacket look this sophisticated.

& Other Stories
Funnel-Collar Down Coat - Black

If I were to invest in just one puffer this winter, this would be a strong contender.
Uniqlo
Seamless Down Parka

Practical yet polished.
MANGO
Checked Anorak With Funnel Neck

Between the heritage-inspired check and exaggerated funnel neckline, this Mango anorak feels decidedly more fashion-forward than your average puffer.
MANGO
Padded Anorak With Funnel Neck

The funnel neckline lends this puffer a particularly elevated feel.

Massimo Dutti
Quilted Bomber Jacket With Scarf

Given my penchant for scarf coats, it was only a matter of time before a scarf puffer made its way onto my wish list.
Damson Madder
Reversible Opal Puffer- Mix Gingham

The gingham print lends it plenty of personality, and the reversible design means you’re essentially getting two coats for the price of one.
Massimo Dutti
Down Jacket With Plaid Interior Detail

It’s the little details that set Massimo Dutti’s outerwear apart, and the heritage-inspired checked lining on this down jacket is a case in point.
MANGO

Brown Long Puffer Coat

We’re currently in the depths of winter, and getting dressed to leave the house in near-zero temperatures has become something of a sartorial challenge. Trying not to resemble the Michelin Man beneath my seemingly endless layers is proving increasingly difficult, so I’ve set myself a task that few fashion editors would relish: finding a genuinely chic, dare I say cool, puffer jacket in the Black Friday sales. I know, I know—a gripping undertaking, but one that the plummeting temperatures have made all the more pressing.

When it comes to finding a genuinely chic puffer, there are a few things I look for. First and foremost, it’s all in the details. Think waist-cinching belts, exaggerated funnel necklines and even built-in scarves (yes, scarf puffers do exist). Checked prints, reversible designs and faux-fur trims also earn extra sartorial points. Next up is composition. A quality down filling can offer excellent insulation without unnecessary bulk, whilst weather-resistant finishes make all the difference when braving the elements. Finally, there’s the question of price. A really good puffer tends to command a slightly higher price tag, which is precisely why I’d recommend investing in one during the Black Friday sales.

With that in mind, I’ve scoured the sales to find the chicest puffer coats that deliver on both style and substance. From Massimo Dutti, to Mango, keep scrolling to shop my edit of the very best.

Shop The Best Puffer Coats In The Black Friday Sales
MANGO
Belt Puffer Coat

Mango’s belted puffer is proof that practical outerwear needn’t come at the expense of style.

Uniqlo
Seamless Down Long Coat

When it comes to outerwear that can withstand a British winter without costing a small fortune, Uniqlo rarely disappoints.

Massimo Dutti

Leave it to Massimo Dutti to make a down jacket look this sophisticated.

If I were to invest in just one puffer this winter, this would be a strong contender.

item.title: I Asked My Chicest Colleagues What They’re Shopping This Black Friday—31 Elegant Items They Sent My Way
item.dc:content:
Whilst the stakes of being a shopping editor are considerably lower than those of being a doctor, I'm equally fond of seeking a second opinion. After spending the best part of November meticulously curating my Black Friday wish list, the next step in my (very serious) shopping process was to consult the experts. After all, when you work alongside some of the most discerning shoppers in the industry, it would be remiss not to tap into their expertise. What, exactly, do my fellow fashion, shopping and beauty editors have their eyes on this Black Friday? There was only one way to find out.

After quizzing the team, not only did I notice plenty of crossover with my own wish list (great taste is contagious, I suppose), but I also found myself adding a few more things to it. From DeMellier's coveted, designer-looking handbags and Rise & Fall's sumptuous knitwear and suede jackets to Heaven Mayhem's cult jewellery, there was no shortage of inspiration. Interestingly, many of my colleagues are also using the sales as an opportunity to bolster their wardrobe foundations, turning to Quince for accessibly priced cashmere, Abercrombie & Fitch and Levi's for excellent denim and Reformation for impossibly chic knitwear. On the beauty front, Shark’s CryoGlow LED face mask came up time and time again, offering the ultimate indulgence for an evening of self-care. Aesop’s cult hand wash—one of those little everyday luxuries editors love to stock up on during the sales—and Merit’s viral Flush Balm blush also featured prominently on our beauty editors’ wish lists.

So, if you're looking to cut through the Black Friday noise, consider this your insider's guide. Keep scrolling to discover the sales our editors genuinely rate and, more importantly, the pieces they're willing to spend their own money on.

Our Top Black Friday Deals 2026

  • Reformation: 25% off everything
  • Rise & Fall: 20% off everything
  • DeMellier: 25% off everything
  • Strathberry: 25% off everything
  • Amazon: up to 75% off
  • & Other Stories: 25% off everything
  • Monica Vinader: up to 50% off everything
  • Heaven Mayhem: up to 60% off everything

Shop The Best Black Friday Editor Picks

Florrie Alexander, Shopping Editor
demellierlondon
Stockholm

From its sculptural silhouette to its sumptuous suede finish, DeMellier’s Stockholm has all the hallmarks of the ultimate winter It bag, and has been sitting firmly at the top of my wish list for some time now.
Reformation
Clara Cashmere Crew Cardigan

Every Black Friday, without fail, I add another Clara cardigan to my collection courtesy of Reformation’s sale. It’s arguably the most versatile piece in my wardrobe, and with so many chic shades to choose from, there’s always another iteration on my wish list.
High Rise 90s Straight Jean

Allow me to introduce you to what might just be the perfect straight-leg jeans. Simply add a pair of loafers and a sumptuous cashmere knit for an effortlessly polished winter look.

Marina Avraam, Senior Shopping Editor
Reformation
Cove Cashmere Oversized Crew

With its generous proportions and understated silhouette, Reformation’s Cove cardigan feels effortlessly chic and distinctly The Row-coded. This year, it’s the grey iteration that has caught my eye.
Heaven Mayhem
Baby Knot Earrings

Anyone who knows me knows I have a penchant for sculptural earrings, and Heaven Mayhem’s Baby Knot pair strikes the perfect balance between statement-making and timeless.
Rise & Fall
Suede Trench Coat

Another item that's been on my wish list for months; I love the navy as a softer alternative to black this winter, and the suede adds the perfect amount of texture to any outfit.

Maxine Eggenberger, Deputy Editor
Rixo
Joann Leopard Coat in Brown Bohemia Leopard

I’m always on the lookout for my next statement coat, and Rixo’s Joann has all the vintage-inspired charm of the brand’s cult Milly coat, just in a slightly shorter silhouette.
Demellier
New York Tote

A dream bag in every sense of the term, DeMellier’s New York tote has all the makings of a forever investment: clean lines, understated elegance and a silhouette that transcends trends.
BIODANCE
Biodance Bio-Collagen Hydrogel Overnight Face Mask. 4 Pcs

Biodance’s sheet masks are a non-negotiable in my self-care routine. Not only do they deliver a generous dose of hydration, but they also help to refine skin texture and support the skin barrier, leaving my complexion looking plump, fresh and radiant.

Shannon Lawlor, Beauty Director
OPI
Nail Envy® Pink to Envy Nail Strengthener

2026 has proved the year of the bare(ish) nail—and I’ve revelled in it. Back-to-back gel appointments left my nails thin, brittle and weak earlier this year, but over the past few months I’ve been leaning on this nail strengthener instead. Not only are my nails now the strongest they’ve ever been, but they look undeniably healthy, too. They’re so healthy, in fact, my manicurist complimented me on them last time I went into the salon.
Shark
Shark Cryoglow Under-Eye Cooling and Led Anti-Ageing & Blemish Repair Mask

My most asked question as a beauty editor of over a decade is, hands down, what LED mask is the best in the business, and I stand firm in my Shark Cryoglow recommendation. With a whopping £72 off right now, you really can’t go wrong. In fact, I don’t think I’ve seen this mask with such a notable discount since it launched. With red light, infrared light, blue light and cooling under-eye cryo, it’s good skin in one handy device.
Escentric Molecules
Escentric Molecules Molecule 01 Eau De Toilette 30ml

Snoop on the shelves of any beauty or fashion editor around and I promise you that a bottle of Eccentric Molecules Molecule 01 will feature somewhere. This is the ultimate cool-girl scent, and it’s not often in the sale. It has a clean-smelling crispness that oozes effortless chicness, and you better believe I’m stocking up while it’s 25% off. Not just for myself, either, but for my mum, my best friend and my sister, too—it’s the most foolproof perfume gift around. You can’t go wrong.

Remy Farrell, Fashion Editor
& Other Stories
Belted Wool Coat

With the cold weather officially upon us, I’m on the hunt for a coat that’s equal parts cosy and chic. Not always an easy feat, I know, but this elegant wool funnel-neck style from & Other Stories ticks every single box.
Monica Vinader
Gold Vermeil Round Diamond Tennis Bracelet 1.1mm - Lab Grown Diamond

Few pieces of jewellery are quite as timeless as a tennis bracelet, and this elegant Monica Vinader style has been sitting firmly at the top of my wish list for months.
Rise & Fall
Women's Wool V-Neck Jumper

This winter, I’m looking to lend my trusty jeans-and-a-jumper formula a more polished feel, and Rise & Fall’s elegant V-neck knit in a particularly sumptuous shade of chocolate brown is just the ticket.

Natalie Munro, Fashion News Editor
Strathberry
Kite Hobo - Espresso

Strathberry’s Kite handbag strikes the perfect balance between timeless elegance and everyday practicality, thanks to its understated design and effortlessly chic, capacious silhouette.
Reformation
Jadey Cashmere Oversized V-Neck Sweater

A Reformation bestseller—and for good reason—the Jadey knit is both relaxed and polished, with a slouchy silhouette and exaggerated V-neckline that feels decidedly 2026.
Levi Strauss & Co.
Ribcage Full Length Jeans

I’m particularly fussy when it comes to denim, but I’ll never tire of Levi’s Ribcage jeans. Between their flattering high-rise fit, sharply cut silhouette and excellent quality, they’ve more than earned their place in my wardrobe.

Eleanor Vousden, Beauty Editor
Maybelline
Instant Eraser Eye Concealer

This concealer is a true drugstore icon. It’s been around for over 15 years, and yet it still holds its own against some of the best I’ve tried (including plenty of luxury formulas). The Maybelline Instant Eraser Concealer works wonders on dark circles, blurring and smoothing the under-eye area for a fresh, well-rested finish. Even better? It’s currently just £5 on Amazon. If it’s been a while since you last used it, consider this your reminder to revisit an old favourite. Trust me, you won’t be disappointed.
Merit Beauty
Flush Balm

Merit’s iconic Flush Balm is one of the hardest-working products in my makeup bag. So I’m taking advantage of it’s 20% off sale to try some new shades. I already own Bespoke (a cool, pinky-brown), but have my eye on Archival, which is the perfect mauve shade. I’m also planning on picking up a travel-sized version of New Wave, which has quickly become my most complimented winter perfume, with a resinous, smoky and impossibly chic scent that smoulders from your knitwear.
currentbody
LED Red Light Therapy Face Mask: Series 3

I test several LED masks every year, but the new CurrentBody Series 3 LED Mask is the one I’m recommending to colleagues and friends to invest in over the sale. What makes it stand out from other LED masks is its impressive range of six LED wavelengths. But perhaps even more impressive is that you can customise your treatment down to individual bulbs to personalise the treatment, address concerns in specific areas all in one go. Noticed a few breakouts around your chin? Add blue light to that area. Looking to support collagen production around your eyes? Red light is the way to go. It’s been a long time since a skincare device has genuinely excited me this much.

Ava Gilchrist, Fashion Writer
ALIGNE
Rafella Shearling Fur Coat

My current strategy for braving the cold involves wearing as many layers as humanly possible, but something tells me Aligne’s shearling coat will do much of the heavy lifting without compromising on that effortlessly cool aesthetic. A win-win, if you ask me.
Reformation
Olina Cropped Pant

Come winter, I love swapping my trusty jeans for satin trousers for evenings out, and Reformation’s cropped Olina style is particularly chic. Simply add a cashmere knit and kitten heels for an effortlessly elegant look.
Quince
Mongolian Cashmere Oversized Crewneck

Quince is one of my go-to destinations for quality cashmere without the hefty price tag, and this striking red jumper is calling my name.

Junior Fashion Editor, Imani-Nia Francis-Tsolaki
Massimo Dutti
100% Cashmere Knit Cardigan

Massimo Dutti’s cashmere is consistently excellent, and I’m particularly taken with this knit’s elegant oyster hue and subtle funnel neckline, both of which lend it an especially expensive-looking finish.
MANGO
Handmade Oversized Wool Coat

It’s officially coat season, and few pieces make winter dressing quite as effortless as a long wool coat. This elegant Mango style is precisely what I have in mind.
DeMellier
The Stockholm Shoulder

Between its softly structured silhouette and rich-looking finish, DeMellier’s Stockholm shoulder bag is the epitome of understated luxury.

Grace Lindsay, Deputy Beauty Editor
ghdhair
GHD Platinum Professional Hair Straightener

If there’s one beauty tool I’ve got my eyes on this Black Friday, it’s the GHD Platinum+ Hair Straightener. I recently watched my friend create the most incredible bouncy curls with the tool, and I love that you can use it to achieve multiple looks. I’ve had my trusty original GHD styler for over ten years now, so it’s definitely time for an upgrade.
Victoria Beckham Beauty
The Foundation Drops With Tfc8®

The Victoria Beckham Beauty Foundation Drops is one of my favourite base products of all time. The lightweight, serum-like formula creates the most luminous complexion. The only downside? The product will cost you a small fortune. I’m stocking up on my favourite shade whilst there’s 20% off this Black Friday.
Aesop
Aesop Reverence Aromatique Hand Wash 500ml

I couldn’t believe it when I saw this Aesop hand soap in the Black Friday sale. The brand rarely does discounts, so this is such a great find. I’m getting one for my bathroom and kitchen sink, as not only does the scent remind me of a luxury spa, but the stylish vessel immediately elevates any space.

Brittany Davy, Junior Fashion Writer
ALIGNE
Anouk Wool Blend Jacket

Aligne’s Anouk jacket is exactly the kind of piece I gravitate towards come winter. The rich chocolate-brown hue and understated double-faced design lend it an effortlessly polished feel.
Reformation
Jonie Cashmere Oversized Scoop Neck

I’m a sucker for an oversized cashmere knit, and Reformation’s Jonie is particularly chic. I love how the exaggerated scoop neckline lends a point of interest to an otherwise classic wardrobe staple.
This Works
Advanced Red Light System

I’ve been increasingly intrigued by red-light therapy, and This Works’ Advanced Red Light System is firmly on my beauty wish list. I love the idea of bringing a little salon-grade luxury to my at-home skincare routine.

What Is Black Friday?

Black Friday is an annual shopping event when brands and retailers offer discounts across fashion, beauty, homeware, technology and more. Originating in the United States, it takes place the day after Thanksgiving and has become one of the biggest shopping events of the year in the UK. Today, Black Friday sales often begin weeks before the official date, giving shoppers the opportunity to find deals on everything from wardrobe staples to Christmas gifts.

When Is Black Friday 2026?

Black Friday 2026 falls on Friday, 27 November. However, many brands launch their Black Friday sales in the weeks leading up to the date, with some offers available throughout November. The Black Friday shopping period typically continues over the weekend and into Cyber Monday on Monday, 30 November.

Which Brands Are Taking Part in Black Friday 2026?

From designer handbags to jewellery and beauty favourites, plenty of brands are offering discounts for Black Friday 2026. This year, you can shop deals from brands including DeMellier, Missoma, Dyson and Elemis, with offers across selected styles and collections. We might even have a few exclusive discounts up our sleeves for you, too! We've rounded up the sales worth knowing about to help you find the best fashion and beauty deals.

What Should I Buy During the Black Friday Sales?

Black Friday is a good opportunity to invest in fashion and beauty pieces you've had your eye on, replenish everyday essentials or get ahead with Christmas shopping. Look out for discounts on winter coats, boots, cashmere, bags, skincare, makeup and fragrance. Before buying, compare prices and check the terms of each offer to make sure you're getting a worthwhile deal.

When Do Black Friday Sales End in 2026?

There is no official end date for Black Friday sales. Many retailers extend their offers throughout the Black Friday weekend and into Cyber Monday on Monday, 30 November 2026, whilst others may end their promotions earlier or continue discounting into December. Always check individual retailers for confirmed sale dates and terms.

With the cold weather officially upon us, I’m on the hunt for a coat that’s equal parts cosy and chic. Not always an easy feat, I know, but this elegant wool funnel-neck style from & Other Stories ticks every single box.
Monica Vinader
Gold Vermeil Round Diamond Tennis Bracelet 1.1mm - Lab Grown Diamond

Few pieces of jewellery are quite as timeless as a tennis bracelet, and this elegant Monica Vinader style has been sitting firmly at the top of my wish list for months.
Rise & Fall
Women's Wool V-Neck Jumper

This winter, I’m looking to lend my trusty jeans-and-a-jumper formula a more polished feel, and Rise & Fall’s elegant V-neck knit in a particularly sumptuous shade of chocolate brown is just the ticket.

Natalie Munro, Fashion News Editor
Strathberry
Kite Hobo - Espresso

Strathberry’s Kite handbag strikes the perfect balance between timeless elegance and everyday practicality, thanks to its understated design and effortlessly chic, capacious silhouette.
Reformation
Jadey Cashmere Oversized V-Neck Sweater

A Reformation bestseller—and for good reason—the Jadey knit is both relaxed and polished, with a slouchy silhouette and exaggerated V-neckline that feels decidedly 2026.
Levi Strauss & Co.
Ribcage Full Length Jeans

I’m particularly fussy when it comes to denim, but I’ll never tire of Levi’s Ribcage jeans. Between their flattering high-rise fit, sharply cut silhouette and excellent quality, they’ve more than earned their place in my wardrobe.

Eleanor Vousden, Beauty Editor
Maybelline
Instant Eraser Eye Concealer

This concealer is a true drugstore icon. It’s been around for over 15 years, and yet it still holds its own against some of the best I’ve tried (including plenty of luxury formulas). The Maybelline Instant Eraser Concealer works wonders on dark circles, blurring and smoothing the under-eye area for a fresh, well-rested finish. Even better? It’s currently just £5 on Amazon. If it’s been a while since you last used it, consider this your reminder to revisit an old favourite. Trust me, you won’t be disappointed.
Merit Beauty
Flush Balm

Merit’s iconic Flush Balm is one of the hardest-working products in my makeup bag. So I’m taking advantage of it’s 20% off sale to try some new shades. I already own Bespoke (a cool, pinky-brown), but have my eye on Archival, which is the perfect mauve shade. I’m also planning on picking up a travel-sized version of New Wave, which has quickly become my most complimented winter perfume, with a resinous, smoky and impossibly chic scent that smoulders from your knitwear.
currentbody
LED Red Light Therapy Face Mask: Series 3

I test several LED masks every year, but the new CurrentBody Series 3 LED Mask is the one I’m recommending to colleagues and friends to invest in over the sale. What makes it stand out from other LED masks is its impressive range of six LED wavelengths. But perhaps even more impressive is that you can customise your treatment down to individual bulbs to personalise the treatment, address concerns in specific areas all in one go. Noticed a few breakouts around your chin? Add blue light to that area. Looking to support collagen production around your eyes? Red light is the way to go. It’s been a long time since a skincare device has genuinely excited me this much.

Ava Gilchrist, Fashion Writer
ALIGNE
Rafella Shearling Fur Coat

My current strategy for braving the cold involves wearing as many layers as humanly possible, but something tells me Aligne’s shearling coat will do much of the heavy lifting without compromising on that effortlessly cool aesthetic. A win-win, if you ask me.
Reformation
Olina Cropped Pant

Come winter, I love swapping my trusty jeans for satin trousers for evenings out, and Reformation’s cropped Olina style is particularly chic. Simply add a cashmere knit and kitten heels for an effortlessly elegant look.
Quince
Mongolian Cashmere Oversized Crewneck

Quince is one of my go-to destinations for quality cashmere without the hefty price tag, and this striking red jumper is calling my name.

Junior Fashion Editor, Imani-Nia Francis-Tsolaki
Massimo Dutti
100% Cashmere Knit Cardigan

Massimo Dutti’s cashmere is consistently excellent, and I’m particularly taken with this knit’s elegant oyster hue and subtle funnel neckline, both of which lend it an especially expensive-looking finish.
MANGO
Handmade Oversized Wool Coat

It’s officially coat season, and few pieces make winter dressing quite as effortless as a long wool coat. This elegant Mango style is precisely what I have in mind.
DeMellier
The Stockholm Shoulder

Between its softly structured silhouette and rich-looking finish, DeMellier’s Stockholm shoulder bag is the epitome of understated luxury.

Grace Lindsay, Deputy Beauty Editor
ghdhair
GHD Platinum Professional Hair Straightener

If there’s one beauty tool I’ve got my eyes on this Black Friday, it’s the GHD Platinum+ Hair Straightener. I recently watched my friend create the most incredible bouncy curls with the tool, and I love that you can use it to achieve multiple looks. I’ve had my trusty original GHD styler for over ten years now, so it’s definitely time for an upgrade.
Victoria Beckham Beauty
The Foundation Drops With Tfc8®

The Victoria Beckham Beauty Foundation Drops is one of my favourite base products of all time. The lightweight, serum-like formula creates the most luminous complexion. The only downside? The product will cost you a small fortune. I’m stocking up on my favourite shade whilst there’s 20% off this Black Friday.
Aesop
Aesop Reverence Aromatique Hand Wash 500ml

I couldn’t believe it when I saw this Aesop hand soap in the Black Friday sale. The brand rarely does discounts, so this is such a great find. I’m getting one for my bathroom and kitchen sink, as not only does the scent remind me of a luxury spa, but the stylish vessel immediately elevates any space.

Brittany Davy, Junior Fashion Writer
ALIGNE
Anouk Wool Blend Jacket

Aligne’s Anouk jacket is exactly the kind of piece I gravitate towards come winter. The rich chocolate-brown hue and understated double-faced design lend it an effortlessly polished feel.
Reformation
Jonie Cashmere Oversized Scoop Neck

I’m a sucker for an oversized cashmere knit, and Reformation’s Jonie is particularly chic. I love how the exaggerated scoop neckline lends a point of interest to an otherwise classic wardrobe staple.
This Works
Advanced Red Light System

I’ve been increasingly intrigued by red-light therapy, and This Works’ Advanced Red Light System is firmly on my beauty wish list. I love the idea of bringing a little salon-grade luxury to my at-home skincare routine.

What Is Black Friday?

Black Friday is an annual shopping event when brands and retailers offer discounts across fashion, beauty, homeware, technology and more. Originating in the United States, it takes place the day after Thanksgiving and has become one of the biggest shopping events of the year in the UK. Today, Black Friday sales often begin weeks before the official date, giving shoppers the opportunity to find deals on everything from wardrobe staples to Christmas gifts.

When Is Black Friday 2026?

Black Friday 2026 falls on Friday, 27 November. However, many brands launch their Black Friday sales in the weeks leading up to the date, with some offers available throughout November. The Black Friday shopping period typically continues over the weekend and into Cyber Monday on Monday, 30 November.

Which Brands Are Taking Part in Black Friday 2026?

From designer handbags to jewellery and beauty favourites, plenty of brands are offering discounts for Black Friday 2026. This year, you can shop deals from brands including DeMellier, Missoma, Dyson and Elemis, with offers across selected styles and collections. We might even have a few exclusive discounts up our sleeves for you, too! We've rounded up the sales worth knowing about to help you find the best fashion and beauty deals.

What Should I Buy During the Black Friday Sales?

Black Friday is a good opportunity to invest in fashion and beauty pieces you've had your eye on, replenish everyday essentials or get ahead with Christmas shopping. Look out for discounts on winter coats, boots, cashmere, bags, skincare, makeup and fragrance. Before buying, compare prices and check the terms of each offer to make sure you're getting a worthwhile deal.

When Do Black Friday Sales End in 2026?

There is no official end date for Black Friday sales. Many retailers extend their offers throughout the Black Friday weekend and into Cyber Monday on Monday, 30 November 2026, whilst others may end their promotions earlier or continue discounting into December. Always check individual retailers for confirmed sale dates and terms.

item.title: Less Shopping, Better Outfits: The 2027 Capsule Wardrobe to Know
item.dc:content:
After years of covering fashion, I've noticed that the outfits I get stopped for almost never revolve around the newest thing I bought. They're built on a handful of pieces I've owned for years and keep reaching for, and that's exactly why my resolution for 2027 is to shop less and wear what I own better.

That doesn't mean a closet full of beige basics. The 2027 capsule mixes classics I'll defend forever (a trench, a sharp blazer, black pants that actually fit) with a few pieces that feel fresh right now, like leather maxi skirts and vintage-inspired leather jackets. Below are the 10 pieces worth investing in, plus the outfit inspiration to wear them on repeat.

Leather Maxi Skirts

A leather maxi skirt has that slightly undone downtown energy, and it works with a chunky knit just as well as a silky camisole. Even the simplest top looks like you planned the whole thing.
Reformation
Lydia Skirt
NOUR HAMMOUR
Elyse Paneled Croc-Effect Leather Midi Skirt
ET OCHS
Pierre Skirt

Vintage Inspired Leather Jackets

Think broken-in leather that looks like it lived a whole life before you found it at a Paris flea market. Washed and slightly distressed finishes feel so much cooler than anything shiny and new, and they turn jeans and a white T-shirt into a real outfit.
Urban Outfitters
Romy Faux Leather Funnel Neck Bomber Jacket
SPRWMN
Arielle Leather Jacket
ZARA
Washed Leather Biker Jacket

Crewneck Sweater

A good crewneck is the piece I reach for most from October to March, tucked into a leather skirt or layered over a collared shirt. Choose a color you love, like a rich red, and it'll feel fresh every time you put it on.
Gap
Cashsoft Crew Sweater
J.Crew
Perfect Cashmere Crewneck
RÓHE
Wool-Blend Sweater

Trench Coat

The perfect trench looks right for almost every plan between September and May, and nothing makes jeans and sneakers look more pulled together.
Aritzia
The Finch Trench Coat
SNDYS
Mikkel Trench Coat
Massimo Dutti
Double-Breasted Trench Coat

Tailored Coat

This is the coat for theater nights and holiday parties, when you want to walk in looking like you have it all figured out. A sharp double-breasted or wrap style instantly polishes everything underneath, even if that's leggings.
ALIGNE
George Faux Fur Detachable Collar Wrap Coat
h&m
Handmade Wool-Blend Coat
COS
Tailored Wool-Blend Double-Breasted Coat

Black Pants

Office to the wine bar without a wardrobe change. Black tailored pants are the hardest-working thing in my closet, and the right pair looks just as good with loafers and a sweater as it does with heels and a going-out top.
DISSH
Cyrus Black Tailored Pant
Reformation
Gale Mid Rise Pant
Leset
Rio High Waist Straight Pant

Classic Blazer

A black blazer is my shortcut to looking put together, and this season's cinched waists and sharp shoulders make it feel a lot less corporate and a lot more fun.
ASOS
Ttya Lab Cinched Blazer With Seam Details
Aritzia
Standout Blazer
EAVES
Alia Crepe Blazer

Corduroy Pants

Apple picking upstate or a slow afternoon browsing a bookstore. Corduroy feels so right for 2027, especially in rich shades like chocolate and olive, and it's the easiest swap when you're tired of your jeans.
Agolde
Vintage Loose Corduroy Wide-Leg Pants
Still Here New York
Cool Jean in corduroy
sezane
Ari Trousers

Plaid Shirts

There's something so cozy about a soft flannel on a crisp fall weekend. I like mine worn open over a tank or layered under a crewneck with just the collar peeking out, so it feels more city than campground.
Gap
Oversized Straight-Hem Flannel Shirt
Everlane
Flannel Shirt

Madewell
The Easy Shirt

Good Jeans

The pair you'll pull on for a morning flight and still be wearing at dinner. Every capsule needs one great pair of jeans, and right now the straight-leg cuts with a clean cropped hem are the ones I keep seeing on the chicest women in New York.
FRAME
The Cigarette Crop Straight Leg Jeans
AGOLDE
Lana High Waist Straight Leg Jeans
PAIGE
Stevie High Waist Bootcut Jeans

item.dc:description: <p><a href="https://www.instagram.com/_sierramayhew">Sierra Mayhew</a> is a fashion editor at Who What Wear, bringing a decade of industry experience to the editorial team. Since joining in 2021, she has made her mark by blending luxury and accessible fashion, decoding runway trends, and curating must-have shopping lists. Before joining Who What Wear, Sierra sharpened her skills at Harper's Bazaar and Elle, with bylines in Bazaar.com and collaborated with iconic brands such as Gucci and Ferragamo. A graduate of the University of Notre Dame, Sierra translates editorial expertise into <a href="https://www.instagram.com/_sierramayhew">viral social content</a>, making fashion engaging for a new generation. Her unique perspective is rooted in her love for travel, music, and discovering the hidden gems that make New York City a constant source of inspiration.</p>

item.title: Suddenly, the Coolest Dressers Are Wearing Jeans and Skirts With This Important Boots Trend
item.dc:content:
I’m here to interrupt your scroll with an important update: there’s a new boot trend on the radar of the chicest winter dressers, and I think you ought to know about it.

Fresh on the scene for winter 2026, I keep spotting stylish dressers side-stepping simple black or brown glossy boots, in favour of the season's chicer two-tone designs.

Setting the scene for the trend, Chanel’s autumn/winter 2026 collection brought the elegant design to the fore. Defined by contrasting colours and a considered finish, two-tone boots offer an elevated alternative to the black and brown pairs that often dominate winter wardrobes, for a distinctive yet not overly statement-making design.

Where other boot trends rely on sculptural heels or thigh-grazing silhouettes to stand out, this one's appeal lies in its restraint. There's an unfussy chicness to the two-tone finish that makes me sure this design will stick around for seasons to come.

So, if you're considering investing in a new pair of boots this winter, read on to shop the pairs I've found below.

Shop Two-Tone Boots:
CHANEL
High Boots

Chanel's two-tone shoes will forever be a fashion person's favourites.
Zara
Combined Leather Heeled Ankle Boots

Be quick! These are on their way to selling out.
River Island
Beige Spliced Toe Cap Heeled Boots

Wear these with jeans or style them with tailored trousers.
Next
Western Toe Cap Ankle Boots

These are such an elevated alternative to your average ankle boots.
JUDE
Edita 100 Two-Tone Leather and Suede Knee Boots

Jude's boots are a fashion person's favourites.
Reformation
Remy Knee Boot

Shop these whilst they're on sale.
Herbert Levine
Two Faced Leather Knee-High Boots

The beige and black combination offers a sleek, timeless finish.

item.dc:description: <p>Natalie Munro is Who What Wear UK’s news writer. Having worked in the fashion industry since her time at university—where she obtained a BA in Journalism from University of the Arts London, Natalie&#39;s experience spans journalistic and styling roles. In the early stages of her career Natalie predominately worked on editorial shoots for fashion publications such as British Vogue, Vogue Ukraine, AnOther Magazine and Elle UK, before moving into journalism roles.</p><p>On completion of her degree she interned in the editorial team at British Vogue and <a href="https://www.vogue.co.uk/profile/natalie-munro">later went on to freelance for the publication</a>. Here, she developed her interest in reporting on the latest fashion news and trends. Inspired by the dynamic nature of the industry, Natalie went on to write for other lifestyle brands and publications before taking on the role as News Writer for Who What Wear.</p><p>With an interest in uncovering the latest fashion trends, Natalie takes a leading role in identifying news for Who What Wear UK. Focusing on trends on and off the runway, as well as street style and celebrity fashion, Natalie reports on a daily basis, ensuring that she remains ahead of the trends. Natalie also creates content for Who What Wear’s social channels including TikTok and Instagram on a weekly basis.</p>

item.title: Every Under-£11 Makeup Product Miley Used on Her Wedding Day
item.dc:content:
When it comes to celebrity brides, you would be forgiven for assuming that they would probably wear the most expensive makeup brands for one of the biggest days of their lives. However, when Miley Cyrus got married just a few days ago, she actually opted for a full face of makeup from one particular affordable drugstore makeup brand. In fact, her stunning wedding day makeup was shared in a post by her makeup artist, Janice Daoud, in which she's seen applying a Maybelline lip gloss to Miley's lips.

After doing some digging, her MUA told Page Six that she in fact used several Maybelline products for Miley's stunning bridal look. And what makes it even better is that every single product used is under £11. And if it's good enough for Miley, it's good enough for us. Scroll on for the low-down on the exact products and shades used.

Miley Cyrus Wedding Day Makeup Products
Maybelline
Serum Lipstick in Upstate

Miley Cyrus's makeup artist, Janice Daoud, said this is "Miley’s go-to shade" in an Instagram post, which she also wore for her album release party this year and as her wedding lipstick, she tells Page Six. Upstate is Miley's favourite shade, which is a very wearable pinky-brown hue with a moisturising satin finish.
Maybelline
Lifter Liner in Line Leader

According to Page Six, Daoud also used Maybelline's Lifter Liner in the shade Line Leader, which perfectly complements the lipstick shade for Miley's wedding-day lip combo. These lip liners are so creamy and long-lasting, so I'm not surprised Miley opted for it for her bridal look.
Maybelline
Lash Sensational Sky High Mascara

Miley's lashes always look incredible, and her MUA also used the iconic Maybelline Lash Sensational Sky High Mascara on her wedding day, which is undoubtedly one of the best Maybelline mascaras, and one of the best mascaras, full stop. In fact, Miley also wore this mascara to her album release party, too. "I finished with Lash Sensational Sky High Waterproof Mascara in Very Black to amplify Miley’s naturally long lashes with even more definition and separation," she says in an Instagram post.

Maybelline
Grippy Serum Makeup Primer

Primer is one of the most important products for long-lasting wedding makeup, and Miley opted for the Maybelline Grippy Serum Makeup Primer. This lightweight, serum-like primer sinks in with a hydrating texture that acts like Velcro for your foundation.
Maybelline
Lifter Plump and Glow Foundation

As for Miley's radiant glow, this was the exact foundation responsible. This plumping and radiance-boosting foundation was the exact one she wore on her wedding day. It offers light-to-medium coverage, making it great as a natural-looking base.
Maybelline
Lifter Concealer

Also paired with the foundation was this £10 concealer, which rivals some of its luxury counterparts. The Lifter Concealer is a great affordable concealer that is both lightweight and brightening, and won't make your bank account cry. If it's good enough for Miley, it's good enough for us,
Maybelline
Lifter Gloss

Now, whilst we don't know the exact shade used, her makeup artist posted a picture of Miley getting her makeup done in an Instagram post, and this is the lip gloss featured. I'm willing to bet that she used the shade Stone, which pairs beautifully with her lipstick and lip liner.
item.dc:creator: Eleanor Vousden
item.dc:description: <p><a href="https://www.eleanorvousden.com/"><u>Eleanor Vousden </u></a>is the beauty editor for <a href="https://www.whowhatwear.co.uk/author/eleanor-vousden"><u>Who What Wear UK</u></a>. She was previously deputy editor at <a href="https://hji.co.uk/author/eleanor"><u>Hairdressers Journal</u></a>, health writer at <a href="https://www.womanandhome.com/author/eleanor-vousden/"><u>Woman &amp; Home</u></a> and junior beauty editor at beauty website <a href="https://www.eleanorvousden.com/powder"><u>Powder. </u></a> She has also contributed to <a href="https://www.wallpaper.com/author/eleanor-vousden"><u>Wallpaper </u></a> and <a href="https://www.elle.com/uk/fashion/news/a24456/watch-elle-collections-x-central-st-martins-video/"><u>Elle </u></a><a href="https://www.elle.com/uk/fashion/news/a24456/watch-elle-collections-x-central-st-martins-video/"><u>Collections </u></a> with written and styling work.<br><br>Working as a beauty journalist since 2015 after graduating in fashion journalism at the London College of Fashion, she has been highly commended at the <a href="https://www.bsme.com/talent-awards-judge-comments"><u>BSME Talent Awards </u></a>for her work on Powder and also contributed to the title winning Website of the Year at the <a href="https://www.inpublishing.co.uk/articles/ppa-digital-awards-2016-the-winners-3808"><u>PPA Awards</u></a>. <br><br>Eleanor’s journalistic focus is to provide readers with honest and helpful beauty content. Through words, video and live broadcast, she has interviewed several celebrity makeup artists, hairstylists and top dermatologists throughout her career, as well as celebrities such as Hailey Bieber, Sarah Jessica Parker and Scarlett Johansson. <br><br>She has a particular interest in finding solutions for acne and eczema, which she has experienced firsthand. She has also amassed a large collection of fragrances and can never say no to a new candle. When she’s not writing or testing the latest beauty product or treatments, she’s on the seafront in her hometown of Brighton and Hove, where she lives with her partner and her miniature dachshund.</p>

According to Page Six, Daoud also used Maybelline's Lifter Liner in the shade Line Leader, which perfectly complements the lipstick shade for Miley's wedding-day lip combo. These lip liners are so creamy and long-lasting, so I'm not surprised Miley opted for it for her bridal look.
Maybelline
Lash Sensational Sky High Mascara

Miley's lashes always look incredible, and her MUA also used the iconic Maybelline Lash Sensational Sky High Mascara on her wedding day, which is undoubtedly one of the best Maybelline mascaras, and one of the best mascaras, full stop. In fact, Miley also wore this mascara to her album release party, too. "I finished with Lash Sensational Sky High Waterproof Mascara in Very Black to amplify Miley’s naturally long lashes with even more definition and separation," she says in an Instagram post.

Maybelline
Grippy Serum Makeup Primer

Primer is one of the most important products for long-lasting wedding makeup, and Miley opted for the Maybelline Grippy Serum Makeup Primer. This lightweight, serum-like primer sinks in with a hydrating texture that acts like Velcro for your foundation.
Maybelline
Lifter Plump and Glow Foundation

As for Miley's radiant glow, this was the exact foundation responsible. This plumping and radiance-boosting foundation was the exact one she wore on her wedding day. It offers light-to-medium coverage, making it great as a natural-looking base.
Maybelline
Lifter Concealer

Also paired with the foundation was this £10 concealer, which rivals some of its luxury counterparts. The Lifter Concealer is a great affordable concealer that is both lightweight and brightening, and won't make your bank account cry. If it's good enough for Miley, it's good enough for us,
Maybelline
Lifter Gloss

Now, whilst we don't know the exact shade used, her makeup artist posted a picture of Miley getting her makeup done in an Instagram post, and this is the lip gloss featured. I'm willing to bet that she used the shade Stone, which pairs beautifully with her lipstick and lip liner.

item.title: Not Leather, Not a Puffer—This Is the Elevated Jacket London’s It Girls Are Wearing With Jeans
item.dc:content:
I might be biased as a born-and-raised city girl, but I think Londoners do winter dressing better than most. Well-versed in the art of staying cosy in blustery surroundings whilst looking polished enough to keep up with the demands of city living, they're a constant source of styling inspiration. This week, however, I didn't even need to leave the house to find it. Stopping me mid-scroll, Alexa Chung was wearing the winter jacket trend that's just shot to the top of my wishlist.

Styling a black shearling fur jacket with a pair of high-contrast white jeans, Alexa crafted one of the chicest winter looks I've come across lately. Sidestepping the leather jackets and puffer styles that have been dominating London's streets this season, her fluffy iteration brought a little extra drama to her outfit, whilst delivering the cosy factor winter dressing demands.

More luxurious than your standard puffer and less ubiquitous than a leather jacket, shearling fur jackets tap into the wider move towards more opulent, glamorous dressing we're seeing this season. And whilst the plush finish brings the elegance, it's also practical enough to keep you warm without having to bundle yourself up in a floor-length coat.

One of the smartest—and chicest—buys you can make this season, read on to shop the shearling fur jackets I'm recommending below.

Shop Shearling Fur Jackets:
H&M
Reversible Shearling Jacket

Be quick! This is on its way to selling out.
COS
Fur-Effect Jacket

Bundle up in style.
hm
Faux Fur Jacket

Style this with jeans or dress it up with satin trousers.
Reformation
Ayla Coat

I'd easily believe you if you told me this was designer.
Mango
Faux-Fur Coat With Lapels

The chocolate brown colour trend isn't showing any signs of slowing down.
PRADA
Aspen Coar

This is amongst one of the chicest fur coats I've come across this season.
TOTEME
Silky Shearling Jacket Dark Brown

This cosy shearling jacket will keep you cosy during winter's coldest days.
Ami
Mongolian Lamb Shearling Jacket

Add some drama to your winter rotation.
item.dc:creator: Natalie Munro
item.dc:description: <p>Natalie Munro is Who What Wear UK’s news writer. Having worked in the fashion industry since her time at university—where she obtained a BA in Journalism from University of the Arts London, Natalie&#39;s experience spans journalistic and styling roles. In the early stages of her career Natalie predominately worked on editorial shoots for fashion publications such as British Vogue, Vogue Ukraine, AnOther Magazine and Elle UK, before moving into journalism roles.</p><p>On completion of her degree she interned in the editorial team at British Vogue and <a href="https://www.vogue.co.uk/profile/natalie-munro">later went on to freelance for the publication</a>. Here, she developed her interest in reporting on the latest fashion news and trends. Inspired by the dynamic nature of the industry, Natalie went on to write for other lifestyle brands and publications before taking on the role as News Writer for Who What Wear.</p><p>With an interest in uncovering the latest fashion trends, Natalie takes a leading role in identifying news for Who What Wear UK. Focusing on trends on and off the runway, as well as street style and celebrity fashion, Natalie reports on a daily basis, ensuring that she remains ahead of the trends. Natalie also creates content for Who What Wear’s social channels including TikTok and Instagram on a weekly basis.</p>

item.title: Hilary Duff’s Holiday Gift Guide Is What Beauty Dreams Are Made Of—Every Essential I’m Buying From $9
item.dc:content:
I expect certain things from Hilary Duff. Iconic Disney Channel original movies, for one ("Sing to me, Paolo!"). Catchy pop songs are another (I've been listening to her album, Luck... or Something, for almost a year now). And Y2K-inspired makeup looks. However, I didn't see a good-as-gold holiday gift guide coming. Today, she shared a 39-product-long gift guide on Instagram, across beauty, wellness, lifestyle, and home decor categories. She captioned it, "These are a few of my favorite things."

As a beauty editor, I was struck by...well, the beauty section (duh!). And her selections? Shockingly good. She includes an editor-approved French-girl lipstick. There's an IYKYK glow-boosting serum. There's an intoxicating perfume. There's a $9 face mist...Need I go on? See all of her personal beauty picks ahead.

VIOLETTE_FR
Bisou Balm Sheer Matte Lipstick - Chocolat

First, Duff listed this French-girl lipstick in shades Chocolat (cool brown) and Rose Latte (neutral pink). One of Team WWW's favorite lip products, it combines the hydration of a lip balm with the blurred color of a lipstick. It delivers soft, sheer, just-kissed color.

MAKEUP BY MARIO
Ultra Suede® Sculpting Lip Pencil - Toasty

Next, she notes her favorite lip liner—this full-coverage, long-wearing, matte formula. Her favorite shade is Toasty, a soft pink brown. New lip combo, unlocked.

MAKEUP BY MARIO
Hydrating Supershine™ Lip Gloss - Perfect Pink

Moisturizing with a glass-like finish, Makeup By Mario's Hydrating Supershine Lip Gloss in Perfect Pink also made the list.

Tinge
Body Makeup

In case you didn't know, celebrities often wear body makeup on stage and/or the red carpet. It's one of those tricks of the trade for creating the look of smooth, flawless, airbrushed limbs. Duff likes Tinge's Body Makeup, which is water and transfer-resistant.
YISE Beauty
Xtreme Glow Dewy Peptide Plumping Serum

As someone who loves this product immensely, I felt validated to see it make Duff's holiday gift guide. The "full-package" serum plumps, firms, smooths, and brightens, leaving a super-dewy finish on the skin for maximum glow and bounce.

INITIO Parfums Privés
Atomic Rose Eau De Parfum

Want to know what Hilary Duff smells like? Apparently, it's Initio Parfume Privés' Atomic Rose—an intoxicating floral fragrance built on Italian bergamot, Bulgarian rose. Turkish rose, Egyptian jasmine, and Madagascar vanilla. Yep, this is an obvious add-to-cart.

Allies of Skin
Sunless Tan SPF 50 Daily Sunscreen + Self-Tanner

If a sunscreen and a self-tanner had a baby, it would be Allies of Skin's Sunless Tan SPF 50. Sure, it protects the skin with broad-spectrum SPF 50, but it's also supercharged with a self-tanning agent, DHA, as well as active ingredients like vitamin C, goji berry extract, and green tea. The result? Skin that's protected, yet appears dewy and (safely) sun-kissed.

AORA MAKEUP
Inicia 12-Hour Illuminating Primer

Duff seems to love multitasking beauty products because she also listed this 2-in-1 primer and illuminator from Aora Makeup. As a primer, it smooths, hydrates, and brightens the skin for flawless makeup that lasts up to 12 hours. As an illuminator, it leaves the skin looking dewy, plump, and light-reflective with subtle shimmer. It even works as a body highlighter.

Magic Molecule
Hypochlorous Acid Spray

ICYMI, hypochlorous acid can refresh the skin, kill acne-causing bacteria, and soothe redness. That's why Magic Molecule's Hypochlorous Acid Spray is the perfect product to use while traveling, after a sweaty workout, or hopping off stage (I assume).

Beauty of Joseon
Relief Sun Organic SPF 50+ Pa++++ Rice and Probiotics

She recommends another sunscreen. This time, it's a Korean formula that's ultra-hydrating, silky smooth, and offers broad-spectrum SPF 50 plus probiotics.

Soft Services
Green Banana Buffing Bar (2 Pack)

This exfoliating body bar is packed with mineral micro-crystals that slough away dead skin and other residue. Meanwhile, glycerin and shea butter moisturize dry skin. Once you use it and step out of the shower, you'll be left with silky-smooth skin. The scent is incredible, too. It's fragranced to smell lush, tropical, and sweet, like cracking open a not-quite-ripe banana.

Clean Skin Club
Clean Towels Original Disposable Face Towels

Disposable towels help keep bacteria off the skin, which is why dermatologists often recommend them for acne-prone skin or other inflammatory skin conditions like eczema. These are dual-sided—one is smooth for sensitive areas, and the other offers gentle exfoliation. They're made from USDA bio-based fabric.

RŌZ
Milk Styling Texture Defining Hair Mousse With Heat Protectant

A texture-defining mousse that hydrates the hair and protects against heat up to 450°F? Yes, please.

R+Co
Dart Pomade Stick

R+Co's Dart Pomade Stick can be used to create effortless texture, sleek definition, or even just to tame fly-aways. It's easy to toss in your bag for on-the-go touch ups.

T3
Aire 360 Ceramic Air Styler Blowout Kit With Dual Voltage

This best-selling multi-styler works like a hair dryer, blow-out brush, and curling iron in one. Designed for all hair types, it styles without any heat damage.
item.description: From a French-girl lipstick to an IYKYK glow serum.
item.dc:creator: Kaitlyn McLintock
item.dc:description: <p>Kaitlyn McLintock is a Beauty Editor at Who What Wear. She has 10 years of experience in the editorial industry, having previously written for other industry-leading publications, like Byrdie, InStyle, The Zoe Report, Bustle, and others. She covers all things beauty and wellness-related, but she has a special passion for creating skincare content (whether that's writing about an innovative in-office treatment, researching the benefits of a certain ingredient, or testing the latest and greatest at-home skin device). Having lived in Los Angeles, California, and Austin, Texas, she has since relocated back to her home state, Michigan. When she's not writing, researching, or testing beauty products, she's working through an ever-growing book collection or swimming in the Great Lakes. </p>

item.title: I Can Save $2,109 on 37 of the Best Cyber Week Beauty Deals—Here's My Exhaustive Shopping List
item.dc:content:
As a sale-obsessed beauty editor, I prepare for Black Friday and Cyber Monday weeks ahead of time. I'm not kidding. Since early November, I've had a running list of products and items I plan on restocking for a deep discount. I take it seriously, refusing to miss out on a single money-saving opportunity.

That's why I'm officially auditioning to be your personal sale shopper. I spent a week (yep, seven days!) scrolling through the top beauty retailers, clicking on thousands of web pages, and combing through thousands of promotional emails to find the best, high-ticket beauty deals. I'm talking about Sephora, Nordstrom, Dermstore, Merit, Jones Road, and beyond. So, without further ado, read on to see the best beauty deals during Cyber Week 2026. You can thank me later.

Skincare
Augustinus Bader
The Cream

Augustinus Bader's The Cream is an iconic and celeb-approved face cream powered by a proprietary TFC8 complex. It targets everything from fine lines and wrinkles to tone, texture, and dryness for 360-degree skin renewal.

celimax
The Vita A Retinal Shot Tightening Booster

This IYKYK Korean skin treatment is spiked with nano-sized retinal, microspicules, and peptides—a trio of skin-renewing actives that firms, brightens, smooths, and minimizes pores in one swipe. There's a reason it was the most-purchased skincare product at WWW this season...just saying.

COSRX Official
Snail Mucin Trio

ICYMI, snail mucin is the hydrating, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant-rich ingredient that can give you glass skin. In my opinion, COSRX has the best snail mucin products in the game, which is why I'm adding this trio to my cart.

Kiehl's
Ultra Facial Cream

I've been using Kiehl's Ultra Facial Cream for over a decade, and I keep coming back to it. With squalane and glacial glycoproteins, it's a foolproof, ultra-hydrating formula that I use year-round, but especially in the cold winter months.

Medicube
Zero Pore Pad 2.0

Medicube's wildly popular Zero Pore Pads feature a dual-sided design. Glide the smooth side over your skin for soothing hydration, or flip it to the textured side for pore-refining exfoliation. They're soaked in 4.5% lactic acid, 0.45% salicylic acid, and cypress tree leaf to dissolve blackheads and clear clogged pores.
Medicube
One Day Exosome Shot 2000

This serum is an Amazon best seller. It uses spicules—tiny, spear-shaped structures that pierce the skin's surface and enhance product absorption. This "liquid microneedling," as it's called, refines skin texture and minimizes enlarged pores for a seamless, glassy look. The addition of exosomes (high-tech cell messengers) means you'll see smoother, brighter, incredible-looking skin so fast.

Bodycare
Brunel Beauty
Pearl Glow Body Oil

This shimmery, pearlescent body oil is like golden-hour light, bottled.

CYKLAR
Sacred Santal - Rituals Set

I'm 100% obsessed with Cyklar's bodycare products. This set includes a body wash, body cream, and body contour tool for smoother, softer, more sculpted skin.

Nécessaire
The Body Duo

Nécessaire's Body Wash and Lotion are editor-loved icons. Every scent is worth collecting, but Eucalyptus turns a standard shower into a spa-like experience.

SALT & STONE
Deluxe Body Set - Santal & Vetiver

My mom and I swear by Salt & Stone's Santal & Vetiver scent. Rich, luxurious, and hotel-worthy, it sits in both our showers. I'm going to gift her this on-sale set.

Sol de Janeiro
Brazilian Bum Bum Cream

Sol de Janeiro's Brazilian Bum Bum Cream is a gourmand dream. With notes of caramel, pistachio, and vanilla, it wraps the skin in an intoxicating scent—not to mention rich moisture. I don't know a single person who doesn't love this product.

Devices
LYMA
Laser Pro Starter Kit

A whopping $1000 off the incredibly effective Lyma Laser Pro? Yes, please.

Read WWW's full review of this ultra-powerful, skin-transforming device.

CurrentBody Skin
LED Red Light Therapy Face Mask: Series 3

The fact that this next-gen LED face mask is more than $100 off right now is almost unbelievable. It features six clinically proven wavelengths to target all visible skin concerns: red, near-infrared, deep near-infrared, blue, green, and yellow. Choose from four clinician-approved preset modes or build personalized treatments for targeted anti-aging, clearing, brightening, and more.

Dyson
Airwrap Id Multi-Styler and Dryer

I couldn't figure out how to replicate a salon blow-out until I used this hair tool. Now, big, bouncy blowouts are mine, thanks to high-speed air currents that self-wrap my hair and minimize damage. It's well worth the investment.

Medicube
Booster Pro X2 - 7 in 1 Glow Beauty Device

I first heard about Medicube's Age-R Booster after I saw Hailey Bieber use it on TikTok. The high-tech skincare device utilizes electrical pulses to enhance skin permeability and increase the penetration of skincare products by up to 490%. It can also boost radiance and elasticity, and minimize the look of pores, thanks to five skin-enhancing LED lights. The best part? It doesn't require any special conductive gel like a microcurrent device does. You can use any skincare product.
Shark Beauty
Cryoglow Red Blue & Infrared IQLED Face Mask With Under Eye Cooling

Shark's internet-viral LED mask provides red, blue, and deep-infrared light with interlocking tri-wick LEDs for 360-degree anti-aging effects and anti-acne benefits. It also provides cryo benefits, thanks to under-eye attachments that cool the skin, visibly tighten the eye area, and target dark circles. (They feel so good on tired eyes). You can track your progress with the smart remote.

For more in-depth info, read our senior beauty editor's full review.
ZIIP
All-In-One Microcurrent Facial Device

Ziip's Halo Device harnesses the power of microcurrent and nanocurrent to lift, tone, tighten, brighten, and smooth the skin. Use it consistently, and you'll see the same incredible results I've seen. The best part? It couldn't be easier to use. Simply download the Ziip app to peruse and follow various guided tutorials.

Therabody
Theraface Depuffing Wand

This is a hot-and-cold facial device, and you can use the temperatures interchangeably to reduce skin puffiness, improve radiance, and boost skin elasticity. It's so easy to toss in a carry-on or checked bag, which is why multiple WWW beauty editors consider it an SOS skin tool for curing puffy, jet-lagged skin. I, however, will be using it to revive my dull face on cold winter mornings.

Makeup
Armani Beauty
Luminous Silk Natural Glow Blurring Foundation

Armani's Luminous Silk Foundation is really as good as people say it is. Beauty editors, makeup artists, and celebrities all swear by it. It was recently reformulated to be even better than before. Smooth, silky, and seamless, it provides the perfect amount of glow without shine.

Glossier
Cloud Paint Plush Blush

I swear by this blush for soft, blurred, velvety matte color. It never misses.

Jones Road Beauty
Miracle Balm

The Jones Road Miracle Balm gives whole new meaning to a "multitasking" product. The light-reflecting balm is a highlighter, blush, bronzer, and so much more. Apply it to cheeks, lips, or as an all-over tint for a fresh, dewy glow.

Merit Beauty
The Minimalist Perfecting Complexion Stick

Smooth, creamy, and buttery, this complexion stick offers the most natural-looking coverage. In my opinion, it deserves every ounce of its internet-viral status.

REFY
Shimmer Lip Gloss & Cream Highlighter Duo Gift Set

I love Refy, and this Shimmer Set is high on my Cyber Week shopping list. It includes one cream highlighter and a matching shimmer lip gloss. So pretty.

Victoria Beckham Beauty
Satin Kajal Liner

Here at Who What Wear, we're obsessed with Victoria Beckham Beauty, and more specifically, the brand's Satin Kajal Eyeliners. I personally own at least eight of them, and fine, I'll say it: I use them more than any other eyeliner in my vast collection. They're creamy, forgiving, and set to a budge-proof finish.

Violette_FR
Bisou Balm Duo

Want that effortless French-girl blurred lip? It's easy to achieve with this duo.

Hair
BondiBoost
Thickening Therapy Volumizing Leave in Styling Spray

If you're a fine-haired person, like me, you need this. Trust me.

Briogeo
Don’t Despair, Repair! Deep Conditioning Mask

This is one of my favorite hair masks (there, I said it). It's brought my hair back from the brink after being over-processed. I keep it in my shower at all times.

OLAPLEX
No.3 Plus Complete Bond Repair Pre-Shampoo Hair Treatment

Olaplex's new and improved bond-building hair treatment is on sale? Say less.
RŌZ
Milk Hair Serum

The do-it-all formula detangles, smooths, and defines. Use it to achieve a frizz-free air-dry, a smooth blowout, or even to refresh your two- or three-day hair.
Virtue
Hydrating Healing Hair Oil

This editor-loved hair serum does it all. It instantly smooths, shines, softens, and moisturizes damaged hair. Shh—it's my little secret for preventing split ends.

Fragrance
BURBERRY
Her Blossom Eau De Toilette

Notes: Mandarin, plum blossom, sandalwood

Cyber Week is the best time to snag designer perfumes at a deep discount. I'll be putting my money towards Burberry's Her Blossom Eau de Toilette. It's a pretty fruity-floral that smells bright and elegant, like walking through an English garden.
byrosiejane
Remi Perfume

Notes: Mandarin, fresh cardamom, white amber

This scent is complex, AKA hard to describe, but I'll give it my best shot. It's soft, subtle, bright, and familiar, like a sun-dappled citrus grove. Inspired by "feeling grounded and completely at east in your own skin." The last time I wore it, my friend exclaimed, "You smell incredible" after hugging me. Enough said.

Henry Rose
Windows Down Eau De Parfum

Notes: Grapefruit, jasmine, musk

Henry Rose's Windows Down Eau de Parfum embodies the crisp and invigorating feel of an open-air road trip, thanks to a bright burst of grapefruit, zesty bergamot, and a hint of smooth Earl Grey tea. We think the brand puts it best when it says it invokes "subtle and casual elegance." Anyone who gravitates toward fresh laundry or just-out-of-the-shower scents is bound to fall in love with it.

MERIT Beauty
New Wave

Notes: Pink pepper, orange flower, ylang-ylang, labdanum, patchouli, musk, vetiver, tobacco accord, cedarwood, oakwood, vanilla bean, tonka bean

Merit's new fragrance, New Wave, was inspired by the feeling of power and sensuality. WWW associate beauty editor Alyssa Brascia put it to the test for 65 days. During that time, she collected an unbelievable number of compliments, including from strangers on the street. "I felt famous," she said. Expect a warm, deep, and resinous scent or, as Alyssa puts it, a perfume "built for cold weather."
Phlur
Vanilla Canyon Eau de Parfum

Notes: Velvet plum, tonka bean, jasmine petals, wild honey, Madagascar vanilla, patchouli, oak wood

Phlur's Vanilla Canyon isn't your traditional sweet vanilla scent. It's grounded in woody, oaky notes, and it smells "Like gazing into a vast canyon or driving toward the horizon on an open road." All I know is that it earns me limitless compliments.

SALT & STONE
Eau De Parfum - Ambrette & Pear

Notes: Pear, apple, orange blossom, ambrette, white musk, jasmine, moss, ambroxide

This, dear reader, is the perfect skin scent—clean, warm, and familiar all at once.

TOM FORD
Cafe Rose Eau De Parfum

Notes: Turkish rose, Bulgarian rose, coffee

This fragrance smells like walking into your favorite café. You breathe in the rich smell of espresso, intermingled with the flowers placed on the counter. With notes of Turkish rose, Bulgarian rose, and coffee, it's warm, moody, and oh-so elegant.

item.dc:description: <p>Kaitlyn McLintock is a Beauty Editor at Who What Wear. She has 10 years of experience in the editorial industry, having previously written for other industry-leading publications, like Byrdie, InStyle, The Zoe Report, Bustle, and others. She covers all things beauty and wellness-related, but she has a special passion for creating skincare content (whether that's writing about an innovative in-office treatment, researching the benefits of a certain ingredient, or testing the latest and greatest at-home skin device). Having lived in Los Angeles, California, and Austin, Texas, she has since relocated back to her home state, Michigan. When she's not writing, researching, or testing beauty products, she's working through an ever-growing book collection or swimming in the Great Lakes. </p>

item.content:encoded:
As a sale-obsessed beauty editor, I prepare for Black Friday and Cyber Monday weeks ahead of time. I'm not kidding. Since early November, I've had a running list of products and items I plan on restocking for a deep discount. I take it seriously, refusing to miss out on a single money-saving opportunity.

That's why I'm officially auditioning to be your personal sale shopper. I spent a week (yep, seven days!) scrolling through the top beauty retailers, clicking on thousands of web pages, and combing through thousands of promotional emails to find the best, high-ticket beauty deals. I'm talking about Sephora, Nordstrom, Dermstore, Merit, Jones Road, and beyond. So, without further ado, read on to see the best beauty deals during Cyber Week 2026. You can thank me later.

Skincare
Augustinus Bader
The Cream

Augustinus Bader's The Cream is an iconic and celeb-approved face cream powered by a proprietary TFC8 complex. It targets everything from fine lines and wrinkles to tone, texture, and dryness for 360-degree skin renewal.

celimax
The Vita A Retinal Shot Tightening Booster

This IYKYK Korean skin treatment is spiked with nano-sized retinal, microspicules, and peptides—a trio of skin-renewing actives that firms, brightens, smooths, and minimizes pores in one swipe. There's a reason it was the most-purchased skincare product at WWW this season...just saying.

COSRX Official
Snail Mucin Trio

ICYMI, snail mucin is the hydrating, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant-rich ingredient that can give you glass skin. In my opinion, COSRX has the best snail mucin products in the game, which is why I'm adding this trio to my cart.

Kiehl's
Ultra Facial Cream

I've been using Kiehl's Ultra Facial Cream for over a decade, and I keep coming back to it. With squalane and glacial glycoproteins, it's a foolproof, ultra-hydrating formula that I use year-round, but especially in the cold winter months.

Medicube
Zero Pore Pad 2.0

Medicube's wildly popular Zero Pore Pads feature a dual-sided design. Glide the smooth side over your skin for soothing hydration, or flip it to the textured side for pore-refining exfoliation. They're soaked in 4.5% lactic acid, 0.45% salicylic acid, and cypress tree leaf to dissolve blackheads and clear clogged pores.
Medicube
One Day Exosome Shot 2000

This serum is an Amazon best seller. It uses spicules—tiny, spear-shaped structures that pierce the skin's surface and enhance product absorption. This "liquid microneedling," as it's called, refines skin texture and minimizes enlarged pores for a seamless, glassy look. The addition of exosomes (high-tech cell messengers) means you'll see smoother, brighter, incredible-looking skin so fast.

Bodycare
Brunel Beauty
Pearl Glow Body Oil

This shimmery, pearlescent body oil is like golden-hour light, bottled.

CYKLAR
Sacred Santal - Rituals Set

I'm 100% obsessed with Cyklar's bodycare products. This set includes a body wash, body cream, and body contour tool for smoother, softer, more sculpted skin.

Nécessaire
The Body Duo

Nécessaire's Body Wash and Lotion are editor-loved icons. Every scent is worth collecting, but Eucalyptus turns a standard shower into a spa-like experience.

SALT & STONE
Deluxe Body Set - Santal & Vetiver

My mom and I swear by Salt & Stone's Santal & Vetiver scent. Rich, luxurious, and hotel-worthy, it sits in both our showers. I'm going to gift her this on-sale set.

Sol de Janeiro
Brazilian Bum Bum Cream

Sol de Janeiro's Brazilian Bum Bum Cream is a gourmand dream. With notes of caramel, pistachio, and vanilla, it wraps the skin in an intoxicating scent—not to mention rich moisture. I don't know a single person who doesn't love this product.

Devices
LYMA
Laser Pro Starter Kit

A whopping $1000 off the incredibly effective Lyma Laser Pro? Yes, please.

Read WWW's full review of this ultra-powerful, skin-transforming device.

CurrentBody Skin
LED Red Light Therapy Face Mask: Series 3

The fact that this next-gen LED face mask is more than $100 off right now is almost unbelievable. It features six clinically proven wavelengths to target all visible skin concerns: red, near-infrared, deep near-infrared, blue, green, and yellow. Choose from four clinician-approved preset modes or build personalized treatments for targeted anti-aging, clearing, brightening, and more.

Dyson
Airwrap Id Multi-Styler and Dryer

I couldn't figure out how to replicate a salon blow-out until I used this hair tool. Now, big, bouncy blowouts are mine, thanks to high-speed air currents that self-wrap my hair and minimize damage. It's well worth the investment.

Medicube
Booster Pro X2 - 7 in 1 Glow Beauty Device

I first heard about Medicube's Age-R Booster after I saw Hailey Bieber use it on TikTok. The high-tech skincare device utilizes electrical pulses to enhance skin permeability and increase the penetration of skincare products by up to 490%. It can also boost radiance and elasticity, and minimize the look of pores, thanks to five skin-enhancing LED lights. The best part? It doesn't require any special conductive gel like a microcurrent device does. You can use any skincare product.
Shark Beauty
Cryoglow Red Blue & Infrared IQLED Face Mask With Under Eye Cooling

Shark's internet-viral LED mask provides red, blue, and deep-infrared light with interlocking tri-wick LEDs for 360-degree anti-aging effects and anti-acne benefits. It also provides cryo benefits, thanks to under-eye attachments that cool the skin, visibly tighten the eye area, and target dark circles. (They feel so good on tired eyes). You can track your progress with the smart remote.

For more in-depth info, read our senior beauty editor's full review.
ZIIP
All-In-One Microcurrent Facial Device

Ziip's Halo Device harnesses the power of microcurrent and nanocurrent to lift, tone, tighten, brighten, and smooth the skin. Use it consistently, and you'll see the same incredible results I've seen. The best part? It couldn't be easier to use. Simply download the Ziip app to peruse and follow various guided tutorials.

Therabody
Theraface Depuffing Wand

This is a hot-and-cold facial device, and you can use the temperatures interchangeably to reduce skin puffiness, improve radiance, and boost skin elasticity. It's so easy to toss in a carry-on or checked bag, which is why multiple WWW beauty editors consider it an SOS skin tool for curing puffy, jet-lagged skin. I, however, will be using it to revive my dull face on cold winter mornings.

Makeup
Armani Beauty
Luminous Silk Natural Glow Blurring Foundation

Armani's Luminous Silk Foundation is really as good as people say it is. Beauty editors, makeup artists, and celebrities all swear by it. It was recently reformulated to be even better than before. Smooth, silky, and seamless, it provides the perfect amount of glow without shine.

Glossier
Cloud Paint Plush Blush

I swear by this blush for soft, blurred, velvety matte color. It never misses.

Jones Road Beauty
Miracle Balm

The Jones Road Miracle Balm gives whole new meaning to a "multitasking" product. The light-reflecting balm is a highlighter, blush, bronzer, and so much more. Apply it to cheeks, lips, or as an all-over tint for a fresh, dewy glow.

Merit Beauty
The Minimalist Perfecting Complexion Stick

Smooth, creamy, and buttery, this complexion stick offers the most natural-looking coverage. In my opinion, it deserves every ounce of its internet-viral status.

REFY
Shimmer Lip Gloss & Cream Highlighter Duo Gift Set

I love Refy, and this Shimmer Set is high on my Cyber Week shopping list. It includes one cream highlighter and a matching shimmer lip gloss. So pretty.

Victoria Beckham Beauty
Satin Kajal Liner

Here at Who What Wear, we're obsessed with Victoria Beckham Beauty, and more specifically, the brand's Satin Kajal Eyeliners. I personally own at least eight of them, and fine, I'll say it: I use them more than any other eyeliner in my vast collection. They're creamy, forgiving, and set to a budge-proof finish.

Violette_FR
Bisou Balm Duo

Want that effortless French-girl blurred lip? It's easy to achieve with this duo.

Hair
BondiBoost
Thickening Therapy Volumizing Leave in Styling Spray

If you're a fine-haired person, like me, you need this. Trust me.

Briogeo
Don’t Despair, Repair! Deep Conditioning Mask

This is one of my favorite hair masks (there, I said it). It's brought my hair back from the brink after being over-processed. I keep it in my shower at all times.

OLAPLEX
No.3 Plus Complete Bond Repair Pre-Shampoo Hair Treatment

Olaplex's new and improved bond-building hair treatment is on sale? Say less.
RŌZ
Milk Hair Serum

The do-it-all formula detangles, smooths, and defines. Use it to achieve a frizz-free air-dry, a smooth blowout, or even to refresh your two- or three-day hair.
Virtue
Hydrating Healing Hair Oil

This editor-loved hair serum does it all. It instantly smooths, shines, softens, and moisturizes damaged hair. Shh—it's my little secret for preventing split ends.

Fragrance
BURBERRY
Her Blossom Eau De Toilette

Notes: Mandarin, plum blossom, sandalwood

Cyber Week is the best time to snag designer perfumes at a deep discount. I'll be putting my money towards Burberry's Her Blossom Eau de Toilette. It's a pretty fruity-floral that smells bright and elegant, like walking through an English garden.
byrosiejane
Remi Perfume

Notes: Mandarin, fresh cardamom, white amber

This scent is complex, AKA hard to describe, but I'll give it my best shot. It's soft, subtle, bright, and familiar, like a sun-dappled citrus grove. Inspired by "feeling grounded and completely at east in your own skin." The last time I wore it, my friend exclaimed, "You smell incredible" after hugging me. Enough said.

Henry Rose
Windows Down Eau De Parfum

Notes: Grapefruit, jasmine, musk

Henry Rose's Windows Down Eau de Parfum embodies the crisp and invigorating feel of an open-air road trip, thanks to a bright burst of grapefruit, zesty bergamot, and a hint of smooth Earl Grey tea. We think the brand puts it best when it says it invokes "subtle and casual elegance." Anyone who gravitates toward fresh laundry or just-out-of-the-shower scents is bound to fall in love with it.

Notes: Pink pepper, orange flower, ylang-ylang, labdanum, patchouli, musk, vetiver, tobacco accord, cedarwood, oakwood, vanilla bean, tonka bean

During that time, she collected an unbelievable number of compliments, including from strangers on the street. "I felt famous," she said. Expect a warm, deep, and resinous scent or, as Alyssa puts it, a perfume "built for cold weather."

Notes: Velvet plum, tonka bean, jasmine petals, wild honey, Madagascar vanilla, patchouli, oak wood

SALT & STONE

Notes: Pear, apple, orange blossom, ambrette, white musk, jasmine, moss, ambroxide

This, dear reader, is the perfect skin scent—clean, warm, and familiar all at once.

TOM FORD

item.title: Colored Jeans Are Trending, But There's Only One Hue Fashion People Are Investing In
item.dc:content:
Blue and black denim will always have a place in my wardrobe, but lately, I've been paying more attention to a different color: red. As Riley Keough just demonstrated while out in New York City, it's surprisingly easy to style. She wore a pair of red jeans with a sumptuous brown suede trench coat, burgundy suede tote bag, velvet scarf, and brown boots, creating a rich, tonal look that made me want to rethink my usual denim rotation.

Colored jeans are having a moment, but red is the specific shade fashion people are gravitating toward most. Whether you style it with other trendy fall and winter colors as Keough did, or pair red jeans with understated neutrals, the color feels like a fresh alternative to garden-variety denim options that saturate the market. If you've been looking for a way to make your everyday outfits feel just a little more interesting, consider this your sign to give red denim a try. I'm sure Keough won't mind if you copy her.

item.dc:description: <p>Erin got her start as a Who What Wear intern in 2011—back when the site only published a single story per day. (We have since increased that number twentyfold.) She graduated magna cum laude from USC and lives in Los Angeles. In college, she also interned at Refinery29, where she was promoted to editorial assistant and then assistant editor. After nearly three years at R29, she came back to WWW in 2015, where she is now the Associate Director of Fashion News. From the Oscars to the Met Gala, she leads the site's entire red carpet coverage strategy. She specializes in celebrity and fashion news but also enjoys writing travel features and runway reports. She frequently contributes to WWW's social accounts and has a sizable following on <a href="https://www.tiktok.com/@fitz.erin">her personal TikTok</a>. </p>
