item.title: I Test Hundreds of Products a Year—These Are the Black Friday Beauty Deals I'd Put in Your Basket
item.dc:content:
Black Friday 2026 is here. I've already bookmarked the early Black Friday beauty deals over the past week, but as the Black Friday and Cyber Monday weekend has now arrived, more deals are launching as we speak, and I've been keeping an eye out for the deals that are actually worth your attention this year.

As a beauty editor, I put hundreds of products to the test every year. From the latest beauty launches to cult-favourite classics, testing and discovering the best products on the market is all part of my day job. Whether it's skincare tools, including LED masks, or the best hair tools, from hair multi-stylers to hot brushes, I spend my days finding the products that are genuinely worth investing in. So, when friends ask me what to shop for during the Black Friday sales, I always recommend taking advantage of the discounts on beauty tech and devices, which can often be a bigger investment. However, it's also a great time to stock up on your everyday essentials, whether that's your go-to shampoo and conditioner, makeup staples or the products you rely on in your skincare routine.

I've been keeping a close eye on the best Black Friday beauty deals for 2026, and have bookmarked the products that have caught my attention. From tried-and-tested favourites that I've personally used to more expensive beauty investments with particularly impressive discounts, these are the deals I'd recommend snapping up if you've had your eye on something special. I'll be updating this story with new deals and finds throughout the weekend to help take the stress out of your Black Friday shopping. Scroll on for the best deals I've found so far.

Best Black Friday Beauty Deals 2026

  • Best Makeup Deal: Maybelline Lash Sensational Sky High Mascara (Was £12, Now £7)
  • Best Body Care and Nails Deal: OPI Repair Mode Bond-Repairing Serum (Was £29, Now £19)
  • Best Hair Tool Deal: Dyson Airwrap Co-Anda 2x (Was £580, Now £450)
  • Best Beauty Tool Deal: CurrentBody Series 3 LED Mask (Was £500, Now £400)
  • Best Skincare Deal: Biodance Bio-Collagen Hydrogel Overnight Face Masks (Was £15, Now £9)
  • Best Fragrance Deal: Byredo Les Miniatures Set (Was £145, Now £116)

Best Black Friday Makeup Deals

Maybelline Lash Sensational Sky High Mascara
Maybelline
Lash Sensational Sky High Mascara

I spotted one of my favourite Maybelline mascaras on sale. Honestly, the Sky High formula remains one of the best mascaras I've ever tried. It's already an affordable buy, but over Black Friday, it comes with an extra-generous discount, making it a great time to top up or pick up a tube if it's been a while since you last tried it.

Victoria Beckham Beauty Satin Kajal Liner
Victoria Beckham Beauty
Satin Kajal Liner

Victoria Beckham Beauty is rarely discounted, so now is the prime time to pick up its iconic Satin Kajal Liners. These glide on unlike any other kohl eyeliners and blend out beautifully. Cocoa is my go-to shade (and VB's personal favourite) for a deep brown eyeliner shade, but I've got my eye on Cocoa Pavé for party season too.

Merit Beauty Flush Balm
Merit Beauty
Flush Balm

Merit only ever goes on sale once a year, so now is the time to take advantage of Merit's Black Friday 20% off deal. Our beauty team has collectively tested hundreds of blushers, and we agree that the Flush Balm (perhaps Merit's most iconic product) is one of the best out there. Sheer and creamy, these glide on to leave you with a natural-looking flush, and the dome applicator means you can apply effortlessly—no brush required.

Hourglass Ambient Lighting Edit Unlocked
Hourglass
Ambient Lighting Edit Unlocked

Each year, Hourglass's iconic (and limited-edition) Ambient Lighting Edit Unlocked palettes always sell out. And for good reason. Past being absolutely beautiful, inside are the illuminating powders that bestow the effect of great lighting on your skin—think blurring, smoothing and radiance-boosting all in one. Right now, all three of the palettes are in stock with a generous discount, and they make a great gift if you're looking to buy something for the beauty lover in your life.

Best Black Friday Hair Deals

GHD Chronos Curve Max Wand

GHD
Chronos Curve Max Wand

I'm often asked what hair tool I use to create my loose waves hairstyle, and this is the curling wand behind it. Featuring a large 38mm barrel, it creates larger curls that leave a soft bend in the hair (and they're particularly good if you have long hair). GHD's sale is particularly good for Black Friday, with up to 30% off, so it's a great time to invest in a pair of the iconic GHD hair straighteners or other hair tools, too.

Kérastase Gloss Absolu Shampoo and Conditioner Duo
Kérastase
Gloss Absolu Shampoo and Conditioner Duo

Black Friday is the time I often top up on my favourite shampoo and conditioners, and the best savings often come in bundles that include both. These two are my current favourites; they leave your hair with a healthy, mirror-like shine and come with good savings in the sale right now.

Dyson Airwrap Co-Anda 2x
Dyson
Airwrap Co-Anda 2x

The Dyson Airwrap is undoubtedly a huge investment purchase. But if you've been considering it, Dyson has some very impressive discounts on its latest model right now, with £130 off. Wondering if it's worth it? It takes a bit of know-how to learn how to use the Dyson Airwrap, but it still remains one of my favourite hair tools when I want a bouncy blowdry. It's not often that Dyson does discounts on its hair tools, so now is the time to get the best savings out of the whole year.

Color Wow Dream Coat Supernatural Spray
Color Wow
Dream Coat Supernatural Spray

If you want a hair product that really works, then my suggestion would be to pick up a bottle of Color Wow's Dream Coat. This smoothing mist acts like a raincoat for your hair, helping to defy frizz and humidity, leaving you with an incredible shine. It's heat-activated, so you need to use it with your hair dryer to lock it in, but it lasts through several hair washes, so you don't have to use it each time. It's one of my favourite products for my frizz-prone hair.

K18 Airwash™ Dry Shampoo
K18 HAIR
Airwash™ Dry Shampoo

Having tested numerous dry shampoos as a beauty journalist, this is the only one I've tried that actually leaves greasy hair feeling cleaner. Unlike powder-based dry shampoos that leave a chalky residue in the hair, this water-based dry shampoo eliminates grease and feels totally traceless in your hair. It's expensive, so one I'd buy on offer whilst it has a good discount.

Best Black Friday Skincare Deals

Biodance Bio-Collagen Hydrogel Overnight Face Masks
BIODANCE
Bio-Collagen Hydrogel Overnight Face Masks

Face masks are one of the skincare buys I always look out for in the sales at this time of year. I was initially sceptical that this sheet mask might be more of a gimmick than anything else (as many TikTok-viral products), but I was pleasantly surprised by just how much glow it delivered. These Korean masks gradually turn transparent as they sit on the skin, leaving your complexion with the kind of radiance you'd expect after a facial. Plus, with four in a pack, they work out at less than £2.50 each right now.

CurrentBody LED Red Light Therapy Face Mask: Series 3
CurrentBody
LED Red Light Therapy Face Mask: Series 3

I review several LED masks every year, but the new CurrentBody Series 3 LED Mask is easily my favourite skincare innovation of 2026, and it's currently available with a huge £100 off. What sets it apart from other LED masks is that it offers six different LED wavelengths (red, near-infrared, deep near-infrared, green, blue and yellow), which you can tailor to specific areas of your face within a single treatment. Using the app, you can customise your routine right down to individual bulbs. Dealing with breakouts on your chin? Add blue light to that area. Want to boost collagen around your eyes? Opt for red light. I haven't been this excited about a skincare tool in a long time, and it's already delivered some promising results, making it one of my top recommendations if you're looking to invest in an LED mask during the sales.

SkinCeuticals C E Ferulic
SkinCeuticals
C E Ferulic

This is the expensive vitamin C serum that I hate to recommend, because it's eye-wateringly expensive. But I'm yet to try anything else that rivals the glow-boosting benefits of SkinCeuticals C E Ferulic (which is also a favourite of Sienna Miller's, FYI). If you've been thinking about trying it, or want to stock up, the best deal I've found in the Black Friday sales is on Space NK, with nearly £34 off.

Shark Cryoglow Under-Eye Cooling & LED Mask
Shark
Cryoglow Under-Eye Cooling & LED Mask

Another LED mask I'd recommend is the Shark CryoGlow Plus. What sets this apart from other LED masks is the cryotherapy-inspired under-eye pads that cool and depuff your under-eyes as the LED gets to work. It combines both red and blue LED, helping to treat fine lines and wrinkles as well as breakouts, making it a great all-rounder to invest in during the sale.

Medik8 Crystal Retinal
Medik8
Crystal Retinal 3

My go-to retinol serum, Medik8 Crystal Retinal, is currently 25% off in the Black Friday sale, so now is the perfect time for me to stock up. I've used this for years, and it always gives me clear, radiant skin.

Best Black Friday Fragrance Deals

Byredo Les Miniatures Set
Byredo
Les Miniatures Set

Byredo perfumes are rarely, rarely discounted, so I was amazed to see that SpaceNK has 20% off all Byredo night now. Plus, if you spend £140, you also get a free Byredo Body Lotion worth £23. It makes a great time to pick up a new bottle of your favourite scent, or gifting the fragrance-lover in your life. How cute are these mini Byredo perfume bottles?

Escentric Molecules Molecule 01 Eau de Toilette
Escentric Molecules
Molecule 01 Eau de Toilette

Escentric Molecules Molecule 01 is the original skin scent, which enhances your natural scent with a single Iso E Super note. It creates a halo-like effect, radiating a clean-smelling, woody scent that is a total compliment-magnet. Many of our editors call this their signature scent, and it's a totally safe blind-buy as it's not only a crowd-pleaser, but can also be layered with other perfumes to enhance their scent, too.

Parfums de Marly Valaya
Parfums de Marly
Valaya Eau de Parfum

If you want to smell luxurious and attract multiple compliments, then there's no perfume I could recommend more than Parfums de Marly's Valaya or Valaya Exclusif. The former is the most goddess-coded mix of creamy florals and peach skin, whilst the Exclusif brings in an almond nuttiness that is so addictive. You can save 20% on both right now.

The White Company Winter Signature Candle
The White Company
Winter Signature Candle

The Who What Wear UK beauty team have been testing so many winter candles lately, and this one from The White Company is one of our all-time favourites thanks to the fragrant blend of cinnamon, clove and orange. With 30% off, this would also make the chicest Christmas gift.

Best Black Friday Nails and Body Care Deals

OPI Repair Mode Bond Building Nail Serum
OPI
Repair Mode™ Bond Building Nail Serum

This is the product I single-handedly credit for bringing my broken, weak and bendy nails back from the brink, and finally being able to grow them long as strong. This repairing serum makes a noticeable difference to the strength of my nails, and I usually see results in a couple of weeks. It's a great one to have to hand if you get regular gel nails, or want to help grow your nails longer and stronger. I'm never without a bottle, and you can see my before and after pics in my review of the OPI Repair Mode Serum here.

This Works Advanced Red Light LED System
This Works
Advanced Red Light LED System

If you're looking to try an LED panel, this one from This Works is well worth considering, especially with its early Black Friday deal. It offers the flexibility to enjoy the benefits of LED wavelengths across the face, scalp and body. Combining clinically proven red light and near-infrared light, it helps stimulate collagen production to improve skin elasticity, while also supporting the scalp to encourage healthy hair growth. Its flexible design means it can be used comfortably on different areas of the body, making it a versatile, hard-working addition to your beauty routine if you're considering investing in an LED device. My colleague Brittany has been testing this and has sold me on it with her results.

Manucurist Green Flash Starter Kit Gift Set
Manucurist
Green Flash™ Starter Kit Gift Set

If you're looking for an alternative to gel manicures, then this Manucurist Green Flash set is a great choice. It uses a nail polish formula that is activated with the LED lamp, helping to lock in your manicure for longer. It comes with a very good discount over Black Friday, especially if you want to pick up a few extra colours in your set.

Aesop Reverence Aromatique Hand Wash
Aesop
Reverence Aromatique Hand Wash

Who doesn't want an Aesop hand soap by their sink? I've currently been refilling my (long-empty) bottle with regular hand soap, but I'm now tempted to buy the real deal now it's on sale. In fact, all the Aesop Black Friday deals are so good. If you need a gift for someone who has everything, or you're not sure what to buy for them, a fancy hand soap will always go down well.

If there's a particular item you've been considering, check its price before the sale begins and compare offers across retailers. Shopping with a wish list in mind can also help you prioritise pieces you'll genuinely wear or use. Our recommendations are selected by our editors, who weigh up all the options for you, so you can trust their selections are, in their opinion, worth it.

Where Can I Find the Best Black Friday Fashion and Beauty Deals?

For the best Black Friday fashion and beauty deals, start with the brands and retailers you already love, then compare prices across different stockists. Who What Wear UK will be rounding up standout discounts, editor-approved buys and the fashion and beauty pieces worth shopping. Check our latest Black Friday coverage for updates on the best deals.

Why Trust Us

At Who What Wear UK, we know that beauty isn’t one-size-fits-all. Our editors have tested thousands of products, including skincare, makeup, hair and nails, over the years and work closely with trusted experts—dermatologists, make-up artists and leading industry insiders—to ensure every guide is well-researched, inclusive and relevant to you.

We focus on formulas that deliver, whether they’re affordable favourites or luxury investments. Our product selection is based on tangible results, ingredient know-how and what we’d truly recommend to a friend.

item.dc:description: <p><a href="https://www.eleanorvousden.com/"><u>Eleanor Vousden </u></a>is the beauty editor for <a href="https://www.whowhatwear.co.uk/author/eleanor-vousden"><u>Who What Wear UK</u></a>. She was previously deputy editor at <a href="https://hji.co.uk/author/eleanor"><u>Hairdressers Journal</u></a>, health writer at <a href="https://www.womanandhome.com/author/eleanor-vousden/"><u>Woman &amp; Home</u></a> and junior beauty editor at beauty website <a href="https://www.eleanorvousden.com/powder"><u>Powder. </u></a> She has also contributed to <a href="https://www.wallpaper.com/author/eleanor-vousden"><u>Wallpaper </u></a> and <a href="https://www.elle.com/uk/fashion/news/a24456/watch-elle-collections-x-central-st-martins-video/"><u>Elle </u></a><a href="https://www.elle.com/uk/fashion/news/a24456/watch-elle-collections-x-central-st-martins-video/"><u>Collections </u></a> with written and styling work.<br><br>Working as a beauty journalist since 2015 after graduating in fashion journalism at the London College of Fashion, she has been highly commended at the <a href="https://www.bsme.com/talent-awards-judge-comments"><u>BSME Talent Awards </u></a>for her work on Powder and also contributed to the title winning Website of the Year at the <a href="https://www.inpublishing.co.uk/articles/ppa-digital-awards-2016-the-winners-3808"><u>PPA Awards</u></a>. <br><br>Eleanor’s journalistic focus is to provide readers with honest and helpful beauty content. Through words, video and live broadcast, she has interviewed several celebrity makeup artists, hairstylists and top dermatologists throughout her career, as well as celebrities such as Hailey Bieber, Sarah Jessica Parker and Scarlett Johansson. <br><br>She has a particular interest in finding solutions for acne and eczema, which she has experienced firsthand. She has also amassed a large collection of fragrances and can never say no to a new candle. When she’s not writing or testing the latest beauty product or treatments, she’s on the seafront in her hometown of Brighton and Hove, where she lives with her partner and her miniature dachshund.</p>

item.content:encoded:
Black Friday 2026 is here. I've already bookmarked the early Black Friday beauty deals over the past week, but as the Black Friday and Cyber Monday weekend has now arrived, more deals are launching as we speak, and I've been keeping an eye out for the deals that are actually worth your attention this year.

As a beauty editor, I put hundreds of products to the test every year. From the latest beauty launches to cult-favourite classics, testing and discovering the best products on the market is all part of my day job. Whether it's skincare tools, including LED masks, or the best hair tools, from hair multi-stylers to hot brushes, I spend my days finding the products that are genuinely worth investing in. So, when friends ask me what to shop for during the Black Friday sales, I always recommend taking advantage of the discounts on beauty tech and devices, which can often be a bigger investment. However, it's also a great time to stock up on your everyday essentials, whether that's your go-to shampoo and conditioner, makeup staples or the products you rely on in your skincare routine.

I've been keeping a close eye on the best Black Friday beauty deals for 2026, and have bookmarked the products that have caught my attention. From tried-and-tested favourites that I've personally used to more expensive beauty investments with particularly impressive discounts, these are the deals I'd recommend snapping up if you've had your eye on something special. I'll be updating this story with new deals and finds throughout the weekend to help take the stress out of your Black Friday shopping. Scroll on for the best deals I've found so far.

Best Black Friday Beauty Deals 2026

  • Best Makeup Deal: Maybelline Lash Sensational Sky High Mascara (Was £12, Now £7)
  • Best Body Care and Nails Deal: OPI Repair Mode Bond-Repairing Serum (Was £29, Now £19)
  • Best Hair Tool Deal: Dyson Airwrap Co-Anda 2x (Was £580, Now £450)
  • Best Beauty Tool Deal: CurrentBody Series 3 LED Mask (Was £500, Now £400)
  • Best Skincare Deal: Biodance Bio-Collagen Hydrogel Overnight Face Masks (Was £15, Now £9)
  • Best Fragrance Deal: Byredo Les Miniatures Set (Was £145, Now £116)

Best Black Friday Makeup Deals

Maybelline Lash Sensational Sky High Mascara
Maybelline
Lash Sensational Sky High Mascara

I spotted one of my favourite Maybelline mascaras on sale. Honestly, the Sky High formula remains one of the best mascaras I've ever tried. It's already an affordable buy, but over Black Friday, it comes with an extra-generous discount, making it a great time to top up or pick up a tube if it's been a while since you last tried it.

Victoria Beckham Beauty Satin Kajal Liner
Victoria Beckham Beauty
Satin Kajal Liner

Victoria Beckham Beauty is rarely discounted, so now is the prime time to pick up its iconic Satin Kajal Liners. These glide on unlike any other kohl eyeliners and blend out beautifully. Cocoa is my go-to shade (and VB's personal favourite) for a deep brown eyeliner shade, but I've got my eye on Cocoa Pavé for party season too.

Merit Beauty Flush Balm
Merit Beauty
Flush Balm

Merit only ever goes on sale once a year, so now is the time to take advantage of Merit's Black Friday 20% off deal. Our beauty team has collectively tested hundreds of blushers, and we agree that the Flush Balm (perhaps Merit's most iconic product) is one of the best out there. Sheer and creamy, these glide on to leave you with a natural-looking flush, and the dome applicator means you can apply effortlessly—no brush required.

Hourglass Ambient Lighting Edit Unlocked
Hourglass
Ambient Lighting Edit Unlocked

Each year, Hourglass's iconic (and limited-edition) Ambient Lighting Edit Unlocked palettes always sell out. And for good reason. Past being absolutely beautiful, inside are the illuminating powders that bestow the effect of great lighting on your skin—think blurring, smoothing and radiance-boosting all in one. Right now, all three of the palettes are in stock with a generous discount, and they make a great gift if you're looking to buy something for the beauty lover in your life.

Best Black Friday Hair Deals

GHD Chronos Curve Max Wand

GHD
Chronos Curve Max Wand

I'm often asked what hair tool I use to create my loose waves hairstyle, and this is the curling wand behind it. Featuring a large 38mm barrel, it creates larger curls that leave a soft bend in the hair (and they're particularly good if you have long hair). GHD's sale is particularly good for Black Friday, with up to 30% off, so it's a great time to invest in a pair of the iconic GHD hair straighteners or other hair tools, too.

Kérastase Gloss Absolu Shampoo and Conditioner Duo
Kérastase
Gloss Absolu Shampoo and Conditioner Duo

Black Friday is the time I often top up on my favourite shampoo and conditioners, and the best savings often come in bundles that include both. These two are my current favourites; they leave your hair with a healthy, mirror-like shine and come with good savings in the sale right now.

Dyson Airwrap Co-Anda 2x
Dyson
Airwrap Co-Anda 2x

The Dyson Airwrap is undoubtedly a huge investment purchase. But if you've been considering it, Dyson has some very impressive discounts on its latest model right now, with £130 off. Wondering if it's worth it? It takes a bit of know-how to learn how to use the Dyson Airwrap, but it still remains one of my favourite hair tools when I want a bouncy blowdry. It's not often that Dyson does discounts on its hair tools, so now is the time to get the best savings out of the whole year.

Color Wow Dream Coat Supernatural Spray
Color Wow
Dream Coat Supernatural Spray

If you want a hair product that really works, then my suggestion would be to pick up a bottle of Color Wow's Dream Coat. This smoothing mist acts like a raincoat for your hair, helping to defy frizz and humidity, leaving you with an incredible shine. It's heat-activated, so you need to use it with your hair dryer to lock it in, but it lasts through several hair washes, so you don't have to use it each time. It's one of my favourite products for my frizz-prone hair.

K18 Airwash™ Dry Shampoo
K18 HAIR
Airwash™ Dry Shampoo

Having tested numerous dry shampoos as a beauty journalist, this is the only one I've tried that actually leaves greasy hair feeling cleaner. Unlike powder-based dry shampoos that leave a chalky residue in the hair, this water-based dry shampoo eliminates grease and feels totally traceless in your hair. It's expensive, so one I'd buy on offer whilst it has a good discount.

Best Black Friday Skincare Deals

Biodance Bio-Collagen Hydrogel Overnight Face Masks
BIODANCE
Bio-Collagen Hydrogel Overnight Face Masks

Face masks are one of the skincare buys I always look out for in the sales at this time of year. I was initially sceptical that this sheet mask might be more of a gimmick than anything else (as many TikTok-viral products), but I was pleasantly surprised by just how much glow it delivered. These Korean masks gradually turn transparent as they sit on the skin, leaving your complexion with the kind of radiance you'd expect after a facial. Plus, with four in a pack, they work out at less than £2.50 each right now.

CurrentBody LED Red Light Therapy Face Mask: Series 3
CurrentBody
LED Red Light Therapy Face Mask: Series 3

I review several LED masks every year, but the new CurrentBody Series 3 LED Mask is easily my favourite skincare innovation of 2026, and it's currently available with a huge £100 off. What sets it apart from other LED masks is that it offers six different LED wavelengths (red, near-infrared, deep near-infrared, green, blue and yellow), which you can tailor to specific areas of your face within a single treatment. Using the app, you can customise your routine right down to individual bulbs. Dealing with breakouts on your chin? Add blue light to that area. Want to boost collagen around your eyes? Opt for red light. I haven't been this excited about a skincare tool in a long time, and it's already delivered some promising results, making it one of my top recommendations if you're looking to invest in an LED mask during the sales.

SkinCeuticals C E Ferulic
SkinCeuticals
C E Ferulic

This is the expensive vitamin C serum that I hate to recommend, because it's eye-wateringly expensive. But I'm yet to try anything else that rivals the glow-boosting benefits of SkinCeuticals C E Ferulic (which is also a favourite of Sienna Miller's, FYI). If you've been thinking about trying it, or want to stock up, the best deal I've found in the Black Friday sales is on Space NK, with nearly £34 off.

Shark Cryoglow Under-Eye Cooling & LED Mask
Shark
Cryoglow Under-Eye Cooling & LED Mask

Another LED mask I'd recommend is the Shark CryoGlow Plus. What sets this apart from other LED masks is the cryotherapy-inspired under-eye pads that cool and depuff your under-eyes as the LED gets to work. It combines both red and blue LED, helping to treat fine lines and wrinkles as well as breakouts, making it a great all-rounder to invest in during the sale.

Medik8 Crystal Retinal
Medik8
Crystal Retinal 3

My go-to retinol serum, Medik8 Crystal Retinal, is currently 25% off in the Black Friday sale, so now is the perfect time for me to stock up. I've used this for years, and it always gives me clear, radiant skin.

Best Black Friday Fragrance Deals

Byredo Les Miniatures Set
Byredo
Les Miniatures Set

Byredo perfumes are rarely, rarely discounted, so I was amazed to see that SpaceNK has 20% off all Byredo night now. Plus, if you spend £140, you also get a free Byredo Body Lotion worth £23. It makes a great time to pick up a new bottle of your favourite scent, or gifting the fragrance-lover in your life. How cute are these mini Byredo perfume bottles?

Escentric Molecules Molecule 01 Eau de Toilette
Escentric Molecules
Molecule 01 Eau de Toilette

Escentric Molecules Molecule 01 is the original skin scent, which enhances your natural scent with a single Iso E Super note. It creates a halo-like effect, radiating a clean-smelling, woody scent that is a total compliment-magnet. Many of our editors call this their signature scent, and it's a totally safe blind-buy as it's not only a crowd-pleaser, but can also be layered with other perfumes to enhance their scent, too.

Parfums de Marly Valaya
Parfums de Marly
Valaya Eau de Parfum

If you want to smell luxurious and attract multiple compliments, then there's no perfume I could recommend more than Parfums de Marly's Valaya or Valaya Exclusif. The former is the most goddess-coded mix of creamy florals and peach skin, whilst the Exclusif brings in an almond nuttiness that is so addictive. You can save 20% on both right now.

The White Company Winter Signature Candle
The White Company
Winter Signature Candle

The Who What Wear UK beauty team have been testing so many winter candles lately, and this one from The White Company is one of our all-time favourites thanks to the fragrant blend of cinnamon, clove and orange. With 30% off, this would also make the chicest Christmas gift.

Best Black Friday Nails and Body Care Deals

OPI Repair Mode Bond Building Nail Serum
OPI
Repair Mode™ Bond Building Nail Serum

This is the product I single-handedly credit for bringing my broken, weak and bendy nails back from the brink, and finally being able to grow them long as strong. This repairing serum makes a noticeable difference to the strength of my nails, and I usually see results in a couple of weeks. It's a great one to have to hand if you get regular gel nails, or want to help grow your nails longer and stronger. I'm never without a bottle, and you can see my before and after pics in my review of the OPI Repair Mode Serum here.

This Works Advanced Red Light LED System
This Works
Advanced Red Light LED System

If you're looking to try an LED panel, this one from This Works is well worth considering, especially with its early Black Friday deal. It offers the flexibility to enjoy the benefits of LED wavelengths across the face, scalp and body. Combining clinically proven red light and near-infrared light, it helps stimulate collagen production to improve skin elasticity, while also supporting the scalp to encourage healthy hair growth. Its flexible design means it can be used comfortably on different areas of the body, making it a versatile, hard-working addition to your beauty routine if you're considering investing in an LED device. My colleague Brittany has been testing this and has sold me on it with her results.

Manucurist Green Flash Starter Kit Gift Set
Manucurist
Green Flash™ Starter Kit Gift Set

If you're looking for an alternative to gel manicures, then this Manucurist Green Flash set is a great choice. It uses a nail polish formula that is activated with the LED lamp, helping to lock in your manicure for longer. It comes with a very good discount over Black Friday, especially if you want to pick up a few extra colours in your set.

Aesop Reverence Aromatique Hand Wash
Aesop
Reverence Aromatique Hand Wash

Who doesn't want an Aesop hand soap by their sink? I've currently been refilling my (long-empty) bottle with regular hand soap, but I'm now tempted to buy the real deal now it's on sale. In fact, all the Aesop Black Friday deals are so good. If you need a gift for someone who has everything, or you're not sure what to buy for them, a fancy hand soap will always go down well.

What Is Black Friday?

Black Friday is an annual shopping event when brands and retailers offer discounts across fashion, beauty, homeware, technology and more. Originating in the United States, it takes place the day after Thanksgiving and has become one of the biggest shopping events of the year in the UK. Today, Black Friday sales often begin weeks before the official date, allowing shoppers to find deals on everything from wardrobe staples to Christmas gifts.

When Is Black Friday 2026?

Black Friday 2026 falls on Friday, 27 November. However, many brands launch their Black Friday sales in the weeks leading up to the date, with some offers available throughout November. The Black Friday shopping period typically continues over the weekend and into Cyber Monday on Monday, 30 November.

When Do Black Friday Sales Start in 2026?

Black Friday sales in 2026 are expected to begin at different times depending on the brand or retailer. While Black Friday itself takes place on Friday, 27 November, many brands launch early offers in the weeks beforehand. Check back regularly for the latest Black Friday deals from your favourite fashion and beauty retailers.

When Do Black Friday sales End in 2026?

There is no official end date for Black Friday sales. Many retailers extend their offers throughout the Black Friday weekend and into Cyber Monday on Monday, 30 November 2026, whilst others may end their promotions earlier or continue discounting into December. Always check individual retailers for confirmed sale dates and terms.

What Should I Buy During the Black Friday Sales?

Black Friday is a good opportunity to invest in beauty pieces you've had your eye on, replenish everyday essentials or get ahead with Christmas shopping. Look out for discounts on beauty tools, skincare, make-up and fragrance. Before buying, compare prices and check the terms of each offer to make sure you're getting a worthwhile deal.

Are Black Friday Deals Worth It?

Black Friday can be a useful time to shop for beauty at reduced prices, but not every offer represents the best value. If there's a particular item you've been considering, check its price before the sale begins and compare offers across retailers. Shopping with a wish list in mind can also help you prioritise pieces you'll genuinely wear or use. Our recommendations are selected by our editors, who weigh up all the options for you, so you can trust their selections are, in their opinion, worth it.

Where Can I Find the Best Black Friday Fashion and Beauty Deals?

For the best Black Friday fashion and beauty deals, start with the brands and retailers you already love, then compare prices across different stockists. Who What Wear UK will be rounding up standout discounts, editor-approved buys and the fashion and beauty pieces worth shopping. Check our latest Black Friday coverage for updates on the best deals.

Why Trust Us

At Who What Wear UK, we know that beauty isn’t one-size-fits-all. Our editors have tested thousands of products, including skincare, makeup, hair and nails, over the years and work closely with trusted experts—dermatologists, make-up artists and leading industry insiders—to ensure every guide is well-researched, inclusive and relevant to you.

We focus on formulas that deliver, whether they’re affordable favourites or luxury investments. Our product selection is based on tangible results, ingredient know-how and what we’d truly recommend to a friend.

item.title: We Try Before You Buy: How Fashion Insiders Are Wearing Knee-High Boots Now
item.dc:content:
Our We Try Before You Buy series aims to take the stress out of shopping and eliminate the number of Post Office visits you make each month to return failed online orders. We test new-season buys and styling ideas so you don’t have to, and this month, our editors experimented with this season's trending colour, purple, to see how to make it work for their wardrobes and yours.

Ask any seasoned fashion editor, and they'll tell you that one of the few things really worth investing your time (and money) in is building a capsule shoe-drobe. Microtrends may come and go, but a great selection of shoes will last you far longer than one season, and as we head into the coldest months, a practical but polished style is worth its weight in gold. Enter: the knee-high boot.

Tall boots are striding back into the spotlight for 2026, and they're worth getting excited about. Whilst the timeless silhouette remains an eternal winter-wardrobe staple, fresh interpretations like wedges, lace-ups, second-skin finishes and relaxed, slouchy shapes are giving the classic boot a modern feel. The round-toe, block heel shape has been a go-to for, well, forever, but the new way to approach one of fashion's most enduring footwear styles is all about drama. Equally versatile as they are elegant, knee-high boots are proving the perfect partner to everything from miniskirts to tucked-in denim, and whether you're looking to invest in a timeless pair or experiment with something a little more directional, the 2026 collections make a very convincing case for bringing this style back into your rotation.

There were plenty of memorable moments in Sarah Burton's autumn/winter 2026 Givenchy show (leather neckerchiefs and stiff collars, anyone?), but look a little lower, and you'll notice the return of the razor-sharp Shark Pinch boot: a glossy, sculptural knee-high with plenty of CEO energy. Then at Miu Miu, Tod's and Celine came the unexpected knee-high flat boot, pared-back, sleek and unassuming, but still a scene-stealer nonetheless. Elsewhere, Chloé's shearling-lined boots were rolled down to showcase the lining (and the leather trousers underneath), and the viral moment from Chanel's off-season show? What could only be described as pop-art, thigh-grazing waders, but how do such directional styles translate to street style?

Some of our favourite celebrity muses are long-term devotees to the power of the tall boot, and often incorporate the slim silhouettes into their very best off-duty looks. Kendall Jenner is just as known for her long boots and sunglasses combinations as she is for jeans and tanks, and take a cursory scroll through Victoria Beckham's best winter outfits and I guarantee it won't be long before you hit a leather knee-high (usually in an arresting pop of colour). In fact, in the past month alone we've spotted Lola Bute, Julia Garner, Elizabeth Debicki and Poppy Delevingne all sporting knee-high boots for work, rest and play with everything from trench coats and day dresses to silk and leather. The consensus? Why commit to an ankle boot when you can invest in a knee-high that does it all?

So, as a team of fashion editors who are often ahead of the trends before they gain traction, we discussed the knee-high boots we'd buy for our own wardrobes and how we'd actually wear them now. Whether you’re ready to dust off the boots in the back of your wardrobe, or looking for something new, our editors have styled up the pairs they have their eye on to give you plenty of inspiration. Keep scrolling to see how to wear knee-high boots now. They might just be good enough to give up your loafers for.

How Who What Wear UK Editors Are Wearing Knee High-Boots Now

Knee-High Boots With Jeans

Style Notes: No matter how much the topic of skinny jeans keeps being revived, it's clear that a relaxed straight-leg is still the preferred silhouette. Instead of leaving them with low-top trainers and loafers, though, they work just as well tucked into boots, intentionally left looser at the knee for just the right amount of slouch.

"A Sloane Ranger I am not, but there’s something so undeniable about the great tradition of tucking the hem of your jeans into a pair of knee-high boots that this cohort does so well. So, in the spirit of Princess Diana strolling through the grounds of a Berkshire Polo club, I’ve decided to embrace this silhouette as an alternate way of wearing knee-high boots and jeans amid cooler months. The benefit of dressing like your local watering hole is Fulham’s The White Horse, and you exclusively shop on Chelsea’s King’s Road?

"Well, it’s a bit of a fantasy, isn’t it? Adding a shearling coat for good measure, this look does a lot of heavy lifting to convince you that I’ve just come from my country home in the Cotswolds, despite strolling through the depths of West London. (As Amanda Cronin said, 'Back to Paddington!') Plus, when you have boots as chic as these, why not show them off à la the Kensington Palace set?" — Ava Gilchrist, fashion writer
Dune London
Shasa Black
AEYDE
Medea 40 Leather Knee Boots
Givenchy
Shark Pinch Boots in Leather

Knee-High Boots With Skirts

Style Notes: Thanks to Miuccia Prada, the knee-length skirt is huge this year, but exactly how to wear it has become the biggest talking point. Leaning into the ladylike energy and teaming it with a slingback always works, but for something a little more subversive, take tips from the Miu Miu show and make pencil skirts feel cooler with an unexpected, edgy boot.

"As a '90's style fanatic, a knee-length leather skirt worn with leather knee-high boots feels so classic and cohesive (I also love the glossiness running seamlessly from hem to heel), but I decided to swap my usual minimalist pair for something a little chunkier. Styled with an easy black polo-neck, it's an outfit that can be thrown on in minutes whilst still looking refined, but these Miista boots are all about the buckle detail, which helps to toughen up the back-to-back black."— Kitty Bovaird, social media editor
Miista
Jarmila Boots
Gianvito Rossi
Hiro Leather Knee-High Boots
Charles & Keith
Aether Knee-High Boots

Knee-High Boots for Evening

Style Notes: You don't need us to tell you that it's cold out there, and whilst party season is usually synonymous with a sparkly sandal, this season we're hooked on the idea of "after-dark boots". Prints, patterns, colour—you name it, a striking style is all you need to take your outfit to the next level; just keep things relatively simple up top and let your party feet do the talking.

"Much lyrical has been waxed about the coat being the outfit this party season. However, I'm here to counter that by asserting a pair of knee-high boots as the outfit this year. An instant talking point at any soirée that's booked in the calendar, a pair of bold boots are a surefire way to ensure you're the most memorable person in any room. And whilst it's easy to let this power get to your head, take a more measured approach by wearing something captivating yet still approachable.

"Those crystal rhinestone Saint Laurent boots may be a way to turn heads, but they might not be the most practical thing for an evening of dancing. Instead, opt for a pair rendered in an animal print. They're bold enough to make an impact, yet neutral enough to be styled under a pair of jeans the following morning." — Ava
Kurt Geiger London
Westbury Pull On High Boots
TOTEME
Croco-Embossed Wide Shaft Boots
Reformation
Remy Flat Knee Boot

Knee-High Boots for the Office

Style Notes: Why not make the most of a longline boot by pairing it with a short hemline? (And yes, you can wear them to the office too.) Miniskirts might not be the right dress code for every workplace, but you can make longer, tailored shorts feel that much smarter by adding a knee-high boot to play with the proportions.

"Office dressing should be fun. There, I said it. If you have to do it every day, you should feel your chicest, and long black shorts sit neatly above these classic kitten heel boots, whilst a boxy suede jacket adds a softly tailored layer on top. The result feels polished for meetings, comfortable at your desk and very chic for a post-work pub visit." — Kitty
M&S
Leather Knee High Boots
Loeffler Randall
Indy Espresso Leather Tall Boot
Penelope Chilvers
Sinatra Patent Leather Boot

Knee-High Boots for the Weekend

Style Notes: If your idea of knee-high boots solely focuses on slimmer, glove-like styles, think again. Bigger, bolder heavy-duty boots are reaching new heights this season, and the sturdier style is perfectly suited to layered-up knits and cosy, off-duty outfits. Shearling boots might have the market on comfort, but they don't stand up to the inclement weather quite like a tough boot, so it's lucky for us that the biker boot has undergone a glow-up and now comes in more luxe, pared-back iterations in sumptuous suede and glossy leather. Now that's how to dress up a casual 'fit.

"Perhaps I'm dreaming of escaping London, but these soft suede boots from Dear Frances have me firmly in countryside mode, ideal for chilly weekends away. Worn with jeans (with one leg tucked into the boot for that touch of je ne sais quoi), they give the outfit a relaxed, lived-in feel. My go-to V-neck and tartan scarf add a little extra cosy warmth and texture—an unbeatable combination. Prepare to see me in this exact outfit most weekends until May." — Kitty
Dear Frances
Dante Knee Boot in Espresso
Miu Miu
Suede Boots
Jimmy Choo
Tamsin Knee Boot Flat

Statement Knee-High Boots

Style Notes: Is it a shoe? Is it a boot? If the lines are blurred, it's because you have a very special piece on your hands, and if the runways have taught us anything this season, it's that what you're wearing on your feet requires just as much attention as the rest of your outfit. If wedges, floating heels, and PVC weren't enough, we're banking heavily on the rise and rise of the lace-up boot this season, as kinky corsetry crosses over into footwear. But the key to pulling off such a directional style? Start with a pair that feels as good as it looks (wearability is key), and work your way up, building your outfit from the ground upwards, literally.

"Miuccia Prada famously said that her version of a white T-shirt was a knee-length skirt. This season, I'm embracing this philosophy by making a pair of knee-high boots the most fundamental thing in my wardrobe. Though it might sound oxymoronic to do this by opting for a pair of boots as wonderfully freaky as this Miista pair, after taking them for a test drive, I can assure you that they're less intimidating than they may seem.

"My first impression was that I looked like Maggie Gyllenhaal's character Lee in Secretary, which is exactly the point. The interwoven laces and razor-sharp point feel both witchy and kinky (Robert Eggers, eat your heart out!), making for a juxtaposition that you'll not find in any other pair of knee-high boots. And when a shoe is taking up that much real estate on your body, why not take advantage of it?" — Ava
Miista

Naked Wolfe

item.dc:description: <p>Remy Farrell is a London-based shopping editor with nearly 10 years of editorial experience covering fashion, beauty and lifestyle. After graduating with a journalism degree and working on the editorial and fashion teams for titles such as Grazia, Elle, Cosmopolitan and British Vogue, she moved into the luxury e-commerce sector, working as fashion assistant at <a href="http://outnet.com/">TheOutnet.com</a>, styling for the social media channels and helping to develop the collections for the in-house brand Iris & Ink. After expanding an assisting and styling portfolio that includes shooting talent such as Gigi Hadid, Victoria Beckham and Miquita Oliver, she also branched out into beauty, following a lifelong passion for the field, creating tried-and-tested reviews and diverse beauty content. </p><p>In her newly appointed role as Fashion Editor at Who What Wear starting in 2024, Remy is interested in discovering new and exciting fashion and beauty brands to share with the Who What Wear readership. Although she has luxury experience, her main focus is uncovering hidden gems at affordable prices to make shopping accessible to everyone, no matter their budget. In her spare time you can find her reading, attending boxing classes, but most likely, shopping. </p>

item.content:encoded:
Our We Try Before You Buy series aims to take the stress out of shopping and eliminate the number of Post Office visits you make each month to return failed online orders. We test new-season buys and styling ideas so you don’t have to, and this month, our editors experimented with this season's trending colour, purple, to see how to make it work for their wardrobes and yours.

Ask any seasoned fashion editor, and they'll tell you that one of the few things really worth investing your time (and money) in is building a capsule shoe-drobe. Microtrends may come and go, but a great selection of shoes will last you far longer than one season, and as we head into the coldest months, a practical but polished style is worth its weight in gold. Enter: the knee-high boot.

Tall boots are striding back into the spotlight for 2026, and they're worth getting excited about. Whilst the timeless silhouette remains an eternal winter-wardrobe staple, fresh interpretations like wedges, lace-ups, second-skin finishes and relaxed, slouchy shapes are giving the classic boot a modern feel. The round-toe, block heel shape has been a go-to for, well, forever, but the new way to approach one of fashion's most enduring footwear styles is all about drama. Equally versatile as they are elegant, knee-high boots are proving the perfect partner to everything from miniskirts to tucked-in denim, and whether you're looking to invest in a timeless pair or experiment with something a little more directional, the 2026 collections make a very convincing case for bringing this style back into your rotation.

There were plenty of memorable moments in Sarah Burton's autumn/winter 2026 Givenchy show (leather neckerchiefs and stiff collars, anyone?), but look a little lower, and you'll notice the return of the razor-sharp Shark Pinch boot: a glossy, sculptural knee-high with plenty of CEO energy. Then at Miu Miu, Tod's and Celine came the unexpected knee-high flat boot, pared-back, sleek and unassuming, but still a scene-stealer nonetheless. Elsewhere, Chloé's shearling-lined boots were rolled down to showcase the lining (and the leather trousers underneath), and the viral moment from Chanel's off-season show? What could only be described as pop-art, thigh-grazing waders, but how do such directional styles translate to street style?

Some of our favourite celebrity muses are long-term devotees to the power of the tall boot, and often incorporate the slim silhouettes into their very best off-duty looks. Kendall Jenner is just as known for her long boots and sunglasses combinations as she is for jeans and tanks, and take a cursory scroll through Victoria Beckham's best winter outfits and I guarantee it won't be long before you hit a leather knee-high (usually in an arresting pop of colour). In fact, in the past month alone we've spotted Lola Bute, Julia Garner, Elizabeth Debicki and Poppy Delevingne all sporting knee-high boots for work, rest and play with everything from trench coats and day dresses to silk and leather. The consensus? Why commit to an ankle boot when you can invest in a knee-high that does it all?

So, as a team of fashion editors who are often ahead of the trends before they gain traction, we discussed the knee-high boots we'd buy for our own wardrobes and how we'd actually wear them now. Whether you’re ready to dust off the boots in the back of your wardrobe, or looking for something new, our editors have styled up the pairs they have their eye on to give you plenty of inspiration. Keep scrolling to see how to wear knee-high boots now. They might just be good enough to give up your loafers for.

item.title: Grace Van Patten's 30th Birthday Trip Photo Diary: Where She Stayed, What She Ate, and What She Wore
item.dc:content:
If you've been having Grace Van Patten withdrawals since Tell Me Lies ended earlier this year, you're not alone. While we await her next project—the based-on-a-true-story movie Rubber Hut—perhaps a behind-the-scenes look at her 30th birthday celebrations will tide you over.

Last weekend, Van Patten took a girls' trip to the Hudson Valley for her milestone birthday, and she kindly brought us along for the ride (virtually, that is). She shared her photo diary with Who What Wear, detailing where she stayed, what she ate, and what she wore. Her lodging of choice? The posh Wildflower Farms, an Auberge Collection property set on 140 acres. (Yes, the same hotel Timothée Chalamet name-dropped in a Vogue interview.)

As for her weekend wardrobe, that was all Moncler. She wore pieces from the new Moncler Teddy Collection, "an irresistibly soft collection of teddy pieces that celebrates the cozy texture of a teddy bear through luxurious fleece and considered functionality," the brand explains. Scroll down to see Van Patten's 30th birthday travel diary and shop the exact pieces she wore.

item.dc:creator: Erin Fitzpatrick
item.dc:description: <p>Erin got her start as a Who What Wear intern in 2011—back when the site only published a single story per day. (We have since increased that number twentyfold.) She graduated magna cum laude from USC and lives in Los Angeles. In college, she also interned at Refinery29, where she was promoted to editorial assistant and then assistant editor. After nearly three years at R29, she came back to WWW in 2015, where she is now the Associate Director of Fashion News. From the Oscars to the Met Gala, she leads the site's entire red carpet coverage strategy. She specializes in celebrity and fashion news but also enjoys writing travel features and runway reports. She frequently contributes to WWW's social accounts and has a sizable following on <a href="https://www.tiktok.com/@fitz.erin">her personal TikTok</a>. </p>

item.title: Do Wrinkle Fillers Actually Work? Here's What the Industry's Best Derms Have to Say
item.dc:content:
If wrinkles are one of your primary skincare concerns, chances are you come across dozens of products on a regular basis promising you smooth, wrinkle-free skin. At the end of the day, there's no magical potion in a bottle that eliminates wrinkles completely or slows down the natural aging process (and that's ok!). However, there is something to be said about finding products that are specifically suited for your skin type to reduce the appearance of wrinkles.

"[Topical] wrinkle fillers and correctors work by combining hydrating humectants with active peptides that signal the skin to behave younger," says licensed master esthetician and founder of Luminous Skin Lab Katelyn Fitzgerald. "They plump the surface temporarily while nudging collagen and elastin production over time, so you get an immediate smoothing effect layered on top of a slower, cumulative one."

In fact, there are several high-performing options out there that editors, dermatologists, and estheticians co-sign for their efficacy in this category. So I figured why not create a list of the best in the business to help make your hunt that much easier. Ahead, find the eight wrinkle fillers beauty experts rely on to get the job done for smoother, plumper skin.

The Best Wrinkle Fillers, at a Glance

  • Best Overall: Peter Thomas Roth Instant Firmx® ​Temporary Face Tightener
  • Best Splurge: Skinmedica Tns® Advanced+ Serum
  • Best Drugstore: Olay Regenerist Micro-Sculpting Serum Fragrance Free Face Moisturizer
  • Best for Dullness: Medik8 Liquid Peptides Advanced Mp Wrinkle Reduction Serum
  • Best Brightening: Mad Hippie Vitamin C Serum

The Best Wrinkle Fillers of 2026

Best Overall: Peter Thomas Roth Instant Firmx® ​Temporary Face Tightener
Peter Thomas Roth
Peter Thomas Roth Instant Firmx® ​Temporary Face Tightener Easy Wear Formula

Our top pick is also a viral hit for how quickly it improves the appearance of wrinkles. The blend of Firm-A-Tite, vitamins E and B5, glycerin, and comfrey extract work together to tighten skin in just minutes. If you don't believe us, just do a quick search, and you'll find dozens of jaw-dropping before and after videos. Granted, these results only last for about a day, but it's still a great temporary fix that works especially well for special occasions.

Pros: Instantly reduces look of fine lines, blurs pores, includes bonus brush

Cons: Temporary effect, requires you to stay expressionless during application

Key ingredients: Firm-A-Tite, vitamins E and B5, glycerin, comfrey extract

Fragrance-free: No

Customer review: "My granddaughter bought it for me and I couldn’t believe how it covered my deep wrinkles on my checks!! I looked ten years younger."

Best Splurge: Skinmedica Tns® Advanced+ Serum
SkinMedica
Tns® Advanced+ Serum 

If you're willing to splurge a bit, consider this Tns® Advanced+ Serum  from SkinMedica. "This is a powerhouse for anyone serious about line correction, this formula combines growth factors with peptides and antioxidants to visibly improve skin texture and firmness over time," says Fitzgerald. The TNS-MR, Renessensce (RSC) Advanced in this serum works overtime for fast results, making it well worth the splurge.

Pros: Smooths coarse wrinkles, lifts sagging skin, fast results

Cons: Expensive

Key ingredients: TNS-MR, Renessensce (RSC) Advanced

Fragrance-free: Yes

Customer review: "Two weeks in, and I see a difference. Pricey, but seems worth it since I won't be purchasing multiple other products while using this."

Best Lightweight Formula: The Ordinary Multi-Peptide + Copper Peptides 1% for Wrinkles and Skin Elasticity
The Ordinary
Multi-Peptide + Copper Peptides 1% for Wrinkles and Skin Elasticity

If you want a multi-tasking product that's also lightweight, this serum from The Ordinary should be on your list. "This is a good product that contains copper peptides to stimulate collagen production and hyaluronic acid for hydration," says board-certified dermatologist and assistant clinical professor at the Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai Debra Jaliman, MD. Bonus: it's non-comedogenic, meaning you won't have to worry about it clogging your pores and causing acne.

Pros: Targets multiple signs of aging, improves skin texture, non-comedogenic

Cons: Can't pair with acids or retinoids

Key ingredients: GHK-Cu, SYN-AKE, Matrixyl Synthe'6, Matrixyl 3000, Argirelox peptide, hyaluronic acid

Fragrance-free: Yes

Customer review: "This is a staple in my skincare routine! I won't go without it. I can tell a difference in my fine lines and overall appearance of my face after using for a month."

Best Drugstore: Olay Regenerist Micro-Sculpting Serum Fragrance Free Face Moisturizer

Olay
Micro-Sculpting Serum Fragrance Free Face Moisturizer

As a beauty editor, one thing I know is that a good drugstore product can go a long way. That's exactly the case for this non-greasy, lightweight formula from Olay. "This is a well-researched, accessible option built on amino-peptides that consistently delivers measurable smoothing results, particularly around forehead lines and crow's feet," says Fitzgerald.

Pros: Lightweight and non-greasy, non-comedogenic, fast results

Cons: Not ideal for dry skin

Key ingredients: Amino-Peptide Complex II, vitamin B5

Fragrance-free: Yes

Customer review: "My skin overall feels a lot smoother, and I think it's helped marginally with my under eye wrinkles. It smooths the skin, and my usual temperamental sensitive skin did not react badly to it."

Best Plumping: Neutrogena Rapid Wrinkle Repair Regenerating Cream
Neutrogena
Rapid Wrinkle Repair Regenerating Cream

Neutrogena has been a staple in the skincare cabinet of millions, so it's no surprise that our experts love it too. "This contains retinol, which helps to decrease fine lines and wrinkles," says Jaliman. "It also helps the skin texture and evens the skin color, reducing sun damage." She adds that it contains key ingredients like glycerin and hyaluronic acid for a boost of hydration, and it’s fragrance-free.

Pros: Retinol plus hyaluronic acid, fast results

Cons: Retinol may be too strong for some

Key ingredients: Retinol, hyaluronic acid, vitamin C

Fragrance-free: Yes

Customer review: "Love this product! It actually works! I've used other creams before but this one really works. I see results the first week and am very happy."

Best for Dullness: Medik8 Liquid Peptides Advanced Mp Wrinkle Reduction Serum
Medik8
Liquid Peptides Advanced Mp Wrinkle Reduction Serum

Dull skin requires extra TLC, which is why Jaliman is a big fan of this formula from Medik8. "This product contains 10 peptides, including Matrixyl 3000, which is well-studied," she says. "It also contains hyaluronic acid and glycerin for hydration." While it does take longer to see results as it relates to wrinkles, many users agree that it's worth the wait considering all the other benefits.  

Pros: Reduces deep wrinkles in 8 weeks, suits sensitive skin

Cons: Takes a while to see results

Key ingredients: Peptides, Expression Line MiniProtein, GF MiniProtein

Fragrance-free: Yes

Customer review: "High-end packaging and pump works well. I think it has made a difference in my lines which are mainly on my forehead. I’ve been using it for a little over a month twice a day as directed. It is not scented and hasn’t caused any breakouts."

Best Night Serum: Strivectin Advanced Retinol Nightly Multi-Correct Serum
Strivectin
Advanced Retinol Nightly Multi-Correct Serum

If you haven't come across this brand, let this be your official introduction. "This formula pairs retinol with StriVectin's proprietary NIA-114 technology to accelerate cell turnover while keeping the barrier intact, which makes it one of the more tolerable retinol-based correctors for sensitive skin," says Fitzgerald. The result is radiant skin with fewer fine lines and reduced textured skin.

Pros: Boosts radiance, treats fine lines and textured skin

Cons: Takes a while to see results

Key ingredients: NIA-114, polyglutamic acid, retinol

Fragrance-free: No

Customer review: "I started using the nightly multi correct serum a year ago and definitely see a difference. My skin always looks fresh and smooth. It has a very light fragrance but nothing that is overbearing. Sometimes I forget to put moisturizer on top because it feels great. Does not have that taut feeling."

Best Brightening: Mad Hippie Vitamin C Serum
Mad Hippie
Vitamin C Serum

An effective wrinkle filler doesn't have to break the bank and this serum from Mad Hippie is the perfect example. "This contains glycerin and hyaluronic acid for hydration," says Jaliman. "It also contains Vitamin C to stimulate collagen production and even out brown discoloration." More hydration means less superficial fine lines and wrinkles. It also promotes brighter, more even skin.  

Pros: Affordable, promotes softer and brighter skin, vegan

Cons: May feel stick to some

Key ingredients: Vitamin C and E, clary sage, grapefruit, ferulic acid, konjac root powder, chamomile extract

Fragrance-free: No

Customer review: "Holy grail! I've been using this one for years. It makes my skin glow, gives me an even skin tone, and visibly lightens aging spots. Great for my sensitive skin!!"

Who should invest in wrinkle fillers?

When it comes to wrinkle fillers, there's no need to set up a criteria for whether or not it's right for you. It's more about the overall appearance of your skin. "Honestly, anyone starting to notice expression lines, crepey texture, or dullness — usually mid-30s onward, though preventative use in your late 20s isn't unreasonable if the formula is gentle," says Fitzgerald. "They're also a smart add for anyone already doing microneedling or nano-infusion, since correctors layer beautifully under those treatments."

How We Chose

As with all of our buying guides at Who What Wear, we compile our edits based on original testing and expert recommendations. To find the best wrinkle fillers, we leaned heavily on first-hand testing and our knowledge as beauty experts. We also considered several factors, including key ingredients, fragrance, and customer reviews. We're aware of how important these factors are for a wide range of needs and preferences, so we made sure to list out all the helpful details.

Why Trust Who What Wear

At Who What Wear, we know that beauty isn't one-size-fits-all. Since 2006, our editors have tested thousands of products—including skincare, makeup, haircare, and nails—while also working closely with trusted experts, like renowned dermatologists, celebrity makeup artists, and other leading industry insiders. Together, this ensures every guide is well-researched, inclusive, and relevant to you.

item.content:encoded:
If wrinkles are one of your primary skincare concerns, chances are you come across dozens of products on a regular basis promising you smooth, wrinkle-free skin. At the end of the day, there's no magical potion in a bottle that eliminates wrinkles completely or slows down the natural aging process (and that's ok!). However, there is something to be said about finding products that are specifically suited for your skin type to reduce the appearance of wrinkles.

"[Topical] wrinkle fillers and correctors work by combining hydrating humectants with active peptides that signal the skin to behave younger," says licensed master esthetician and founder of Luminous Skin Lab Katelyn Fitzgerald. "They plump the surface temporarily while nudging collagen and elastin production over time, so you get an immediate smoothing effect layered on top of a slower, cumulative one."

In fact, there are several high-performing options out there that editors, dermatologists, and estheticians co-sign for their efficacy in this category. So I figured why not create a list of the best in the business to help make your hunt that much easier. Ahead, find the eight wrinkle fillers beauty experts rely on to get the job done for smoother, plumper skin.

  • Best Overall: Peter Thomas Roth Instant Firmx® ​Temporary Face Tightener
  • Best Splurge: Skinmedica Tns® Advanced+ Serum
  • Best Drugstore: Olay Regenerist Micro-Sculpting Serum Fragrance Free Face Moisturizer
  • Best for Dullness: Medik8 Liquid Peptides Advanced Mp Wrinkle Reduction Serum
  • Best Brightening: Mad Hippie Vitamin C Serum

Best Overall: Peter Thomas Roth Instant Firmx® ​Temporary Face Tightener
Peter Thomas Roth
Peter Thomas Roth Instant Firmx® ​Temporary Face Tightener Easy Wear Formula

Our top pick is also a viral hit for how quickly it improves the appearance of wrinkles. The blend of Firm-A-Tite, vitamins E and B5, glycerin, and comfrey extract work together to tighten skin in just minutes. If you don't believe us, just do a quick search, and you'll find dozens of jaw-dropping before and after videos. Granted, these results only last for about a day, but it's still a great temporary fix that works especially well for special occasions.

Pros: Instantly reduces look of fine lines, blurs pores, includes bonus brush

Cons: Temporary effect, requires you to stay expressionless during application

Key ingredients: Firm-A-Tite, vitamins E and B5, glycerin, comfrey extract

Fragrance-free: No

Customer review: "My granddaughter bought it for me and I couldn’t believe how it covered my deep wrinkles on my checks!! I looked ten years younger."

Best Splurge: Skinmedica Tns® Advanced+ Serum
SkinMedica
Tns® Advanced+ Serum 

If you're willing to splurge a bit, consider this Tns® Advanced+ Serum  from SkinMedica. "This is a powerhouse for anyone serious about line correction, this formula combines growth factors with peptides and antioxidants to visibly improve skin texture and firmness over time," says Fitzgerald. The TNS-MR, Renessensce (RSC) Advanced in this serum works overtime for fast results, making it well worth the splurge.

Pros: Smooths coarse wrinkles, lifts sagging skin, fast results

Cons: Expensive

Key ingredients: TNS-MR, Renessensce (RSC) Advanced

Fragrance-free: Yes

Customer review: "Two weeks in, and I see a difference. Pricey, but seems worth it since I won't be purchasing multiple other products while using this."

Best Lightweight Formula: The Ordinary Multi-Peptide + Copper Peptides 1% for Wrinkles and Skin Elasticity
The Ordinary
Multi-Peptide + Copper Peptides 1% for Wrinkles and Skin Elasticity

If you want a multi-tasking product that's also lightweight, this serum from The Ordinary should be on your list. "This is a good product that contains copper peptides to stimulate collagen production and hyaluronic acid for hydration," says board-certified dermatologist and assistant clinical professor at the Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai Debra Jaliman, MD. Bonus: it's non-comedogenic, meaning you won't have to worry about it clogging your pores and causing acne.

Pros: Targets multiple signs of aging, improves skin texture, non-comedogenic

Cons: Can't pair with acids or retinoids

Key ingredients: GHK-Cu, SYN-AKE, Matrixyl Synthe'6, Matrixyl 3000, Argirelox peptide, hyaluronic acid

Fragrance-free: Yes

Customer review: "This is a staple in my skincare routine! I won't go without it. I can tell a difference in my fine lines and overall appearance of my face after using for a month."

Olay
Micro-Sculpting Serum Fragrance Free Face Moisturizer

As a beauty editor, one thing I know is that a good drugstore product can go a long way. That's exactly the case for this non-greasy, lightweight formula from Olay. "This is a well-researched, accessible option built on amino-peptides that consistently delivers measurable smoothing results, particularly around forehead lines and crow's feet," says Fitzgerald.

Pros: Lightweight and non-greasy, non-comedogenic, fast results

Cons: Not ideal for dry skin

Key ingredients: Amino-Peptide Complex II, vitamin B5

Fragrance-free: Yes

Customer review: "My skin overall feels a lot smoother, and I think it's helped marginally with my under eye wrinkles. It smooths the skin, and my usual temperamental sensitive skin did not react badly to it."

Neutrogena
Rapid Wrinkle Repair Regenerating Cream

"This contains retinol, which helps to decrease fine lines and wrinkles," says Jaliman. "It also helps the skin texture and evens the skin color, reducing sun damage." Cons: Retinol may be too strong for some

item.title: Jennifer Aniston's Favorite Pajamas Are 47% Off—and They're Somehow Still in Stock
item.dc:content:
I've seen a lot of TikTok videos lamenting the days when Black Friday deals were actually mind-boggling. Listen, I have no desire to line up at Walmart at midnight for a flat-screen TV, but these days, some retailers offer 15% off and expect customers to get excited. Sorry, but I don't get out of bed for discounts less than 40%! Luckily, if you're in the market for some very cute pajamas, Eberjay understood the assignment.

Jennifer Aniston just posted an Instagram photo of herself wearing Eberjay's Nautico Long PJ Set. Originally retailing for $198, the set now costs $104 after you factor in the extra 25% taken off at checkout. Yep, that means Aniston's adorable striped pajamas are a whopping 47% off right now. Now that's the kind of thrilling discount I'm looking for this week. Scroll down to see Aniston wearing the pajamas on the set of her Christmas movie, Naughty, which will be released in November 2027.

item.title: My Mom and I Have Very Different Taste—But We'd Both Gift These Nordstrom Finds
item.dc:content:
My mom and I can walk into the same store and leave with nothing in common. I'll be holding an edgy leather jacket, and she's three racks over in eyeing a classic pair of gold hoops. We've shopped together long enough that I can call her picks before she even touches the hanger, and she can do the same to me. Although we can disagree on a lot of items, we do occasionally find common ground and gifting is one of those places that we agree. Especially in the midst of Black Friday season.

So when Nordstrom's Cyber Week sale started, I gave us a challenge: find gifts we'd both happily wrap. A few debates got heated, but we ended up with a list that works for the classic dresser and the more daring one in your life. It's all on sale right now, so I wouldn't wait long.

Her Picks:
ST. JOHN
Multicolor Check Tweed Sheath Dress

Tweed is my mom's love language, and this is the dress she'd wear to every holiday dinner on the calendar.
COS
Collarless Wool-Twill Coat

A collarless wool coat is the kind of clean, classic outerwear she reaches for every winter.
Rothy's
The Double Bit Driver

Comfort is non-negotiable for my mom, and this driving loafer checks that box without looking sporty.
Nordstrom
Cashmere Blend Assorted 2-Pack Crew Socks

Two cashmere crewnecks that arrive already boxed, which my mom sees as a major gifting win.
Treasure & Bond
Cable Stitch Pom Beanie

A cable-knit pom beanie is the cozy kind of classic she'll wear on every winter walk.
UGG®
Tasman Ii Slipper

She'd happily live in these slippers all season, from the couch to the coffee shop.
DÔEN
Henri Organic Cotton Voile Top

She lives in blouses like this.
Bombas
Sunday Faux Shearling Slipper

Any shearling slipper made her list.
Tory Burch
Field Sneaker

A bold sneaker with a subtle logo is her idea of a good gift.

My Picks:
Steve Madden
Ronie Leather Loafer

A pointed penny loafer is classic enough for me.
Open Edit
Long Sleeve Polo Sweater

A polo sweater looks a little retro in just the right way.
Thread & Supply
Stretch Cotton Twill Chore Coat

A barn coat is the easy layer to throw on for weekend errands.
Tory Burch
The Eleanor Crystal Bracelet Watch

This watch is pretty enough to wear as a bracelet.
Reformation
Santino Knit Top

A boat-neck knit top is the simple layer to wear this winter with jeans on repeat.
LESET
The Margo Tee

A fun twist on the tee I've been wearing every day.
Tory Burch
Mellow Mule

A soft slip-on I'd wear around the house or out to brunch.
Lafayette 148 New York
Charles Cotton & Linen Wide Leg Pants

My Mom does swear by a good wide-leg trouser, but this one is my pick.
7 For All Mankind
Calie Ankle Straight Leg Jeans

A straight-ankle jean I'd wear with loafers, sneakers, or boots depending on the day.
Princess Polly
Brieanna Cropped Trench Coat

Anything under $100 on sale is going in my cart.
Vince
Cameron Genuine Shearling Boot

Sleek enough for dinner and warm enough for a New York winter.

UGG®
Tazzette Genuine Shearling Collar Slipper

I keep seeing these on my feed, and one wear explains why.
Reformation
Olina Wide Leg Cropped Pants

The pant trend I'm into right now.
Jeffrey Campbell
Fathom Flat

These flats are too edgy for my Mom but perfect for me.
All in Favor
Stretch Faux Suede Bomber Jacket

A suede bomber gives an instant vintage feel.
Sam Edelman
Summer Pointed Toe Kitten Heel Pump

Kitten heels are my everyday shoe right now, finding one with a Cyber Week price tag is a real win.

Where we agree:
MOTHER
The Hustler Roller Sneaker Flare Leg Jeans

The full flare is the real selling point for us both on these jeans.
Rains
The Dry High Waterproof Rain Boot

Rain boots can be cool, and this glossy pair is proof.
Free People
Quick Step Drawstring Flare Track Pants

Track pants are having a moment.
WAYF
X Rose Lola Bleecker Bouclé Jacket

This is the playful take that helps us meet in the middle on tweed.
Treasure & Bond
Favorite T-Shirt

A relaxed cotton tee at under $20 is an easy one to buy in multiples this time of year.
L'AGENCE
Tyler Silk Blouse

A silk blouse that goes from work to dinner. I'd wear it with leather pants all holiday season.
WAYF
X Rose Lola Lucille Minidress

A black minidress with feather trim is my holiday party uniform this year.
Treasure & Bond
Scallop Wool & Cashmere Cardigan

A ruffle-trim cardigan is the sweet, slightly unexpected knit everyone needs.
Nike
Essentials W Barrel Pants

Barrel-leg track pants are the comfy option I'd actually wear on a flight.
Madewell
V-Neck Lace Cotton Blend Tank

This is something I'd gift to my Mom to make her match my personal style.
7 For All Mankind
The Slim Slim Straight Jeans

A slim straight jean is a denim shape my mom and I both agree on.
NAADAM
Lightweight Cashmere Quarter Zip Sweater

A cashmere quarter zip is cozy enough for her and cool enough for me.
Beyond Yoga
Rest Day Waffle Stitch Wrap Cardigan

A waffle-knit wrap cardigan for lazy Sundays is something we can both get behind.
Rothy's
The Teddy Slipper

We can debate a lot of things, but never a teddy slipper.
Nordstrom
Draped Cowl Neck Halter Top

A cowl-neck halter looks dressy for the holidays without trying too hard, so it made both of our lists.

item.title: Global Searches for Cinnamon Nails Are Up 100%—10 Warm, Velvety, and Spice-Tinged Nail Ideas for Winter ’27
item.dc:content:
Winter conjures up images of smoke-swirled candles, fluffy baked goods, and warm foam-topped lattes. What do all three often have in common? Why, a dash of cinnamon, of course. There's a reason we're drawn to the spicy-sweet scent and flavor of cinnamon in the cold season: its key compound, cinnamaldehyde, triggers a biological warming sensation. However, I'd argue the color alone has similar effects, making us feel all warm and cozy inside. Cinnamon's red-brown color is a winter classic, but this year, it's destined to be more popular than ever...at least when it comes to the most stylish manicures.

According to a new analysis by Fresha, a beauty and wellness booking platform, global searches for "cinnamon nails" have increased by 100% YOY, with celebrities like Jennifer Lawrence, Dakota Johnson, and Hailey Bieber all cosigning the color. "Cinnamon nails are a lovely way to embrace warmer, seasonal shades without opting for the darker burgundy and chocolate colors we typically see trending," says Annabelle Taurua, a Fresha beauty expert. "The reddish-brown undertones give the manicure plenty of warmth and depth, while still keeping it really wearable." Ahead, see 10 warm, velvety, and spice-tinged nail ideas for winter. Plus, shop a selection of on-trend nail polishes.

Cinnamon Nail Inspo

Classic Cinnamon

Celebrity nail artist Zola Ganzorigt created this classic cinnamon manicure for Hailey Bieber. The red-brown color looks elegant on long, almond-shaped nails.

Cinnamon Spice

Use a shimmery cinnamon nail polish if you want your digits to catch the light.

Cinnamon Aura

Whatever you call them, aura or halo nails, they literally emanate warmth.

Molten Cinnamon Cat-Eye

This molten cinnamon set, by celebrity nail artist Queenie Nguyen, are so chic.

Cinnamon Fade

Recreate this ombre set with a couple of cinnamon shades and a blending sponge.

Cinnamon Hot Cocoa Nails

For a deeper, more chocolatey take, try using a red-tinged medium brown.

Cinnamon Cowboy

Cinnamon nail polish and cow print? Yes, please.

Cinnamon-Dipped French Tips

This manicure is so elegant and the perfect way for minimalists to play with color.

Cinnamon Sugar

Take this as your sign to add chunky, frosty, silver sparkle to the top of each nail.

Cinnamon Metal

A metallic finish never fails to elevate a standard, monochromatic manicure.

Cinnamon Nail Polish & Press Ons
Essie
Essie Salon-Quality Vegan Nail Polish - Boho Rodeo

Essie's Boho Rodeo is the perfect classic cinnamon color.

Essie
Gel Couture Liquid Diamonds Metallic Nail Polish Collection - Marquise Please

Try the brand's Marquise Please for a toasty, shimmery take.

Olive and June
Goal Getter - Gel

Olive & June's gel polish lasts for weeks with zero chips or touch-ups needed.

Tenoverten
Non-Toxic, Chip-Resistant Nail Polish - Cliff

If you like more orange-toned cinnamon shades, try this earthy color.

LONDONTOWN
Oud Mood

A milky cinnamon nail polish.

Manucurist
Brique

This is one of my favorite cinnamon nail polishes on the market.

Dazzle Dry
Cinnamon Spice – Nail Lacquer

Dazzle Dry's Cinnamon Spice Nail Lacquer is an immediate add-to-cart.

Sally Hansen
Insta-Dri Nail Polish - 393 Cinna-Snap

A moody, red-leaning nail polish.

OPI
Xpress/on Fall Press-On Nail Collection

These press ons deliver a cat-eye effect—no salon visit necessary.

LastingImpressons1
Sparkling Cinnamon | Press-On Nails

Don't sleep on Etsy for press-on nails. There are so many stunning, artistic sets.
Nail Reformation
Cinnamon Swirl

A true cinnamon-swirl set.

item.dc:description: <p>Kaitlyn McLintock is a Beauty Editor at Who What Wear. She has 10 years of experience in the editorial industry, having previously written for other industry-leading publications, like Byrdie, InStyle, The Zoe Report, Bustle, and others. She covers all things beauty and wellness-related, but she has a special passion for creating skincare content (whether that's writing about an innovative in-office treatment, researching the benefits of a certain ingredient, or testing the latest and greatest at-home skin device). Having lived in Los Angeles, California, and Austin, Texas, she has since relocated back to her home state, Michigan. When she's not writing, researching, or testing beauty products, she's working through an ever-growing book collection or swimming in the Great Lakes. </p>
